#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Verifier.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), -1.0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(CmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));

     
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(!SI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use.");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "The function containing the CallInst must be marked as nounwind.");
    assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(SI) && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    assert(cast<IntrinsicInst>(SI)->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic && "It must be a memory intrinsic.");
     

    std::cout << "All constraints are satisfied." << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

using namespace llvm;

void createFunction(LLVMContext &ctx, Module &mod) {
     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), {Type::getInt32Ty(ctx)}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", mod);
    
     
    func->getBasicBlockList().push_back(BasicBlock::Create(ctx, "entry", func));
    BasicBlock &BB = func->front();
    
     
    IRBuilder<> builder(&BB);
    Value *arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 10);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&mod, Intrinsic::abs, {Type::getInt32Ty(ctx)}), {arg}, "", &BB);
    
     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);  
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext ctx;
    Module mod("testModule", ctx);
    
    createFunction(ctx, mod);
    
     
    std::cout << mod << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB->getTerminator());
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have any uses. Aborting.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(Builder.CreateICmpULT(CI, Builder.getInt32(2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB->getTerminator());

     
    if (!TrueVal || !FalseVal || SI->getType()->isVectorTy()) {
        errs() << "Invalid SelectInst operands or type. Aborting.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->print(errs());
    CI->print(errs());
    SI->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("myModule", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "myFunction", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *One = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *Vec = InsertElementInst::Create(UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)), One, Zero, "", BB);

     
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Vec, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "", BB);
    Value *TrueVal = FNegInst::create(FAbsInst::create(Vec), "", BB);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, TrueVal, "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getCondition() && SI->getTrueValue() && SI->getFalseValue() && "SelectInst does not have valid operands");
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy() && "SelectInst type is not a scalar or vector integer type");

     
    F->getEntryBlock().push_back(SI);
    assert(!F->use_empty() && "Function does not have any uses, ensure CI has at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    CallInst *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(SI);
    assert(CI && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not have 'nounroll' attribute set");

     
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {
        int NumBytes = 0;  
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % getElementTypeSize(SelType) != 0 && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of element size");
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(SI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument((CallInst *)SI);
    assert(Pos.getKind() == IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct kind");

     
    Function *Func = Pos.getFunction();
    assert(Func && "Associated function must exist");

     
     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *VecVal = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    VecVal = InsertElementInst::Create(VecVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), "", BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {VecVal->getType(), VecVal}, {VecVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *Intr = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(Intr && Intr->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call for memory operations");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CI, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");

     
    Function *Func = F;
    assert(Func && "Function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed successfully!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
from llvm import *
import llvm.core as core

def create_module():
    m = Module(None)
    fnty = FunctionType(VoidType(), [], False)
    fn = Function(m, fnty, "test_function")
    
    # BasicBlock and Instruction setup
    bb = BasicBlock("entry", fn)
    builder = Builder.to_module(bb, m)
    
    ci = CallInst.create_call(fn, [], "", bb)
    
    # Adding attributes to ensure specific properties
    fn.add_attr("nounwind")
    ci.set_doesnotthrow(False)
    
    return m

def main():
    m = create_module()
    print(str(m))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());
    
     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    Value* Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    std::vector<Value*> Args;
    Args.push_back(Zero);
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::abs, { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }), Args, "", BB);
    
     
    Use& U = CI->use_begin();
    assert(!U.getUser()->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow(false);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    IntrinsicInst* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic* AMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMI && "Intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    if (AMI->isZeroLength()) {
         
    } else {
         
    }
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::unique_ptr<CallInst> SimplifiedCI = simplifyCall(CI);
        if (SimplifiedCI) {
            CI->replaceAllUsesWith(SimplifiedCI.get());
            CI->eraseFromParent();
            CI = SimplifiedCI.release();
        }
    }
    
     
    assert(F->hasFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst itself must not be marked as nounwind");
    
     
    
    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy->getPointerTo(), {}, "", BB);
    CI->addOperand(Arg);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: The CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    if (F->doesNotThrow() || CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: The function or call instruction should be marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: The CallInst should be an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: The intrinsic call should be a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: The context instruction should be a CallBase instance." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::abs, {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Value::use_empty());  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::abs) {
             
        }
    }

    std::cout << "Generated function with a call instruction:\n" << *F;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::memcpy, {CI}, {}, BB);

     
    II->setAtomicOrdering(llvm::AtomicOrdering::Unordered);
    II->setSyncScopeID(llvm::SyncScopeID::SingleThread);
    II->setVolatile(true);

     
    Mod->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/TargetTransformInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Instruction *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, "", BB);

     
    Value *User = CI;
    if (User->use_empty()) {
        User = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
        CI->replaceAllUsesWith(User);
    }

     
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be marked as nounwind");

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *AII = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(AII)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!AII->onlyAccessesMemory()) {
        errs() << "AnyMemIntrinsic does not only access memory\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Constant *C = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI2 = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {C}, "", BB);

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    if (!AI.hasAttrList()) {
        errs() << "Function must have an argument with the returned attribute\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI2);
    if (!CB) {
        errs() << "Context instruction is not a CallBase\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CI2);
    if (!Pos.isValid()) {
        errs() << "IRPosition is not valid\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Function *Func = Pos.getAssociatedFunction();
    if (!Func) {
        errs() << "Associated function does not exist\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    TreeEntry *E = new TreeEntry(Instruction::InsertElement, {}, {});
    E->Scalars.push_back(TypeBuilder<int32_t, false>::get(Context));

     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry *, int> MinBWs;
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        Type *ScalarTy = E->Scalars.front();
        assert(ScalarTy && "Scalar type is not valid");
    }

     
    if (E->State != TreeEntry::SplitVectorize || E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() != 2) {
        errs() << "TreeEntry state or CombinedEntriesWithIndices size is incorrect\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(FalseVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    if (!simplifySelectInst(SI) && !canonicalizeSelectToShuffle(SI) && !canonicalizeScalarSelectOfVecs(SI)) {
        errs() << "SelectInst simplification failed\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!isa<CallInst>(FalseVal) || !isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal)) {
        errs() << "SelectInst conditions are not met\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
    assert(SelType->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type is not integer");
    assert((SelType->isVectorTy() || SelType->isIntegerTy()) && "SelectInst type is not vector or scalar");
    assert((CondType->isVectorTy() || CondType->isIntegerTy()) && "Condition type is not vector or scalar");

     
    if (E->getOperand(1).back()->getType()->isVectorTy()) {
        errs() << "Operand type is vector, expected scalar\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Type *ScalarTy = E->Scalars.front();
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarType is not valid");

     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        Type *ScalarTy = E->Scalars.front();
        assert(ScalarTy && "Scalar type is not valid");
    }

     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;
    if (Depth > MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth) {
        errs() << "Recursion depth exceeds maximum allowed\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    FPClassTest KnownFPClass();
    FPClassTest DemandedMask = FPClassTest::getZero();
    if (!adjustDemandedMaskFromFlags(DemandedMask, KnownFPClass)) {
        errs() << "Adjusting demanded mask failed\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;
    BasicBlock *Preheader = BB;
    BasicBlock *Latch = BB;
    L = new Loop();
    L->addBasicBlockToLoop(BB, LI);

     
    unsigned SliceSize = 16;
    unsigned Part = 8;
    uint64_t MaskBase = computeMaskBase(SliceSize, Part);
    assert(MaskBase == (SliceSize - Part) && "MaskBase calculation is incorrect");

    return 0;
}

        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;

#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    auto *AMI = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMI && "The CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic.");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "The context instruction must be a CallBase instance.");

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Basic Block: " << BB->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;

        errs() << "The CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;  
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), Args, "", BB);

     
    BB->push_back(new StoreInst(CI, ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), false, BB));
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function should be marked as nounwind");
    assert(CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == IntrID && "CI must be an intrinsic call");

     

    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

    CallBase *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1)}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::Local);

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << *F << "\n";

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Use.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Callee, {}, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst has uses.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow());
    assert(F->isNoUnwind());

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), {}, "", BB);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCI)) {
        errs() << "Intrinsic call detected.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    CI->simplify();

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
    assert(AMII->getLength() <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(AMII->getLength()) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB);
    assert(Pos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");

     
    Function *Func = Pos.getFunction();
    assert(Func && "Function must be non-null");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;

  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test_module", Context);

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

   
  Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
  Arg->setParamAttribute(0, AttributeSet::getWithDefaultAttributes(F, (unsigned)0));

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {Arg}, "", BB);
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

   
  assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
  IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
  assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

   
  legacy::PassManager PM;
  PM.add(createInstructionSimplifierPass());
  PM.run(*F->getParent());

  std::cout << "Test case created successfully!\n";
  return 0;
}

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *VecVal = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    ConstantInt *Index = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Instruction *InsertElem = InsertElementInst::Create(VecVal, Arg, Index, "", BB);

     
    assert(!InsertElem->use_empty() && "InsertElementInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memset;  
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, ID), VecVal, Arg, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
     

    std::cout << "Test input generated successfully!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    F->setCallingConv(CallingConv::C);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg1 = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg1", (Value *)F);
    Arg1->addAttr(AttributeForCallSite(&M));

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    BB->insertInstrBefore(CI, BB->begin());

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call\n";
    }

     
    if (F->hasFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind)) {
        errs() << "Function is marked as nounwind\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "CallInst is marked as doesNotThrow\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not marked as doesNotThrow\n";

    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->setCalledFunction(F);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind while CallInst is not");

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    CallInst *IntrCall = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, ID), {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCall) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCall);
    assert(II && "IntrinsicInst must be castable from CallInst");
    assert(!II->use_empty() && "IntrinsicInst must have at least one use");

     
    CI->print(errs());
    std::cout << "\n";
    IntrCall->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    
     
    Value *ZeroVal = Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    Args.push_back(ZeroVal);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, Args, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgNo() + 1);
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindBehavior(Function::UnwindNone);
    
     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() != Intrinsic::memset) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not a memset intrinsic!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses, cannot test undefined behavior handling!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (!dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

    Module Mod("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind while CallInst itself is not");

     
    CallInst *MI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {}, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(MI) && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    IRPosition Pos(CB, IRKind::IK_Argument);
    assert(Pos.getPositionKind() == IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have a positions kind of IKP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     
    Function *Func = Pos.getFunction();
    assert(Func && "Associated function must be non-null");

     
    TreeEntry *E = new TreeEntry();
    E->Scalars.push_back(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");

    MinBWs[E] = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    assert(MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end() && "MinBWs map must contain an entry for E");
    assert(((IntegerType*)MinBWs[E])->getBitWidth() == 32 && "Entry must provide a valid bit width");

    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(std::make_pair(E, 0));
    assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");

     
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI->getArgOperand(0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    Value *TrueVal = F->arg_begin();
    Value *FalseVal = new BinaryOperator(Instruction::FNeg, new CallInst(Intrinsic::fabs, {CI->getArgOperand(0)}, "", BB), "", BB);
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    assert(CondVal && "SelectInst condition must be a valid Value");
    assert(TrueVal && "SelectInst true value must be a valid Value");
    assert(FalseVal && "SelectInst false value must be a valid Value");
    assert(SelType && "SelectInst type must be correctly retrievable");

     
    assert(isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal) && cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal)->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && "SelectInst condition must be an icmp ult comparison");

     
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && "SelectInst type must be either scalar or vector integer type");

     
    Value *X = CI->getArgOperand(0);
    BinaryOperator *BO = new BinaryOperator(Instruction::FNeg, new CallInst(Intrinsic::fabs, {X}, "", BB), "", BB);
    assert(!BO->hasNoSignedWrap() && !BO->hasNoUnsignedWrap() && "Function's logic must disable wrap flags");

     
    E->Idx = 1;
    assert(E->Idx > 0 && "TreeEntry *TE must have a non-zero Idx");

     
    E->UserTreeIndex = 1;
    assert(E->UserTreeIndex != UINT_MAX && "TreeEntry *TE must have a valid UserTreeIndex");

     
    Loop *L = new Loop();
    L->setLoopPreheader(BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F));
    L->setLoopLatch(BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F));
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop must have a valid preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have a valid latch block");

     
    L->setIsSafeToClone(true);
    assert(L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() == false && "Loop header's address must not be taken");

     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

     
    Instruction *I = new BinaryOperator(Instruction::Add, CI->getArgOperand(0), CI->getArgOperand(1));
    assert(I && "Instruction *I must be non-null");
    assert(I->getType()->isIntegerTy() && I->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() == 32 && "Instruction *I must have a valid type with scalar size in bits equal to the bit width of DemandedMask and Known");

     
    unsigned Depth = 1;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must be less than or equal to MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

     
    Value *MaskBase = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    assert(MaskBase && "MaskBase must be correctly computed and used in further logic");

    std::cout << "All assertions passed." << std::endl;
    return 0;

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memset", FTy);
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    Args.push_back(ConstantExpr::getBitCast(Arg, Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));
    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1));
    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(*F->arg_begin());

     
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function should not be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst should be an intrinsic call");

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
    assert(AMII->getNumElements() <= 0 && "Length must be non-positive");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction should be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*F, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition should have the correct position kind");

     
    Function *Func = F;
    assert(Func && "Function associated with IRPosition should not be null");

     
    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", &M);

    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setParamAttribute(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI;
    if (true) {
        Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
        CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, Callee, "", BB);
         
        F->setDoesNotThrow();
        F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Failed to create CallInst" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    } else {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    M.print(errs());

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "foo", M);
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    std::vector<Value*> Args;
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), Args, "", BB);
    
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind.");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "Intrinsic must be AnyMemIntrinsic.");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        auto* AIM = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        assert(AIM->getNumOperands() == 0 && "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic must have zero-length operation.");
    }
    
     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    if (AI != F->arg_end()) {
        AI->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    }
    
     
    Value* CtxI = CI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CtxI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase.");
    
     
    auto PosKind = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CI);
    assert(PosKind.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the call site argument position kind.");
    
     
    auto* Funct = PosKind.getFunction();
    assert(Funct != nullptr && "Associated function must be non-null.");
    
     
    
    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test", Context);
  
   
  FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
  
   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
  
   
  Value* Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
  std::vector<Value*> Args = {Arg};
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, Args, "", BB);
  
   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
  
   
  Value* TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
  Value* FalseVal = Builder.CreateNeg(TrueVal, "neg_true");
  ICmpInst *Cmp = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
  SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(Cmp, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
  
   
  Type* SelType = SI->getType();
  assert(SelType->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type must be integer");
  
   
  
  std::cout << "Test function and instructions created successfully.\n";
  return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&Mod, Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function should be marked as nounwind but it isn't." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Mod.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
bool handleConstraints(Function &F) {
     
    for (auto &arg : F.args()) {
        if (arg.hasReturnedAttr()) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

 
int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    Argument *arg = F->addArg(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    arg->addAttr(::Attribute::Returned);

     
    if (handleConstraints(*F)) {
        std::cout << "Constraints handled successfully!\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Failed to handle some constraints.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function* createExampleFunction(LLVMContext &ctx, Module &M) {
     
    FunctionType *FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "exampleFunc", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(ctx, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI->getType(), CI, ConstantInt::get(CI->getType(), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

    return F;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext ctx;
    Module M("exampleModule", ctx);

    Function *F = createExampleFunction(ctx, M);
    if (F) {
        std::cout << "Function created successfully." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Failed to create function." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());
    
     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value* Arg = &*(F->arg_begin());
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::memset), { Arg }, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "Intrinsic call must be memset");
    
     
    CallBase* CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    auto IRRet = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB);
    assert(IRRet.getPositionKind() == IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");
    
     
    Function* Funct = IRRet.getFunction();
    assert(Funct && "Associated function must be non-null");
    
     
    auto E = std::make_unique<TreeEntry>();
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<const TreeEntry*, Type*> MinBWs;
    if (!MinBWs.empty()) {
        auto Entry = MinBWs.find(E.get());
        assert(Entry != MinBWs.end() && "MinBWs map must contain an entry for E");
        assert(Entry->second->isIntegerTy() && static_cast<IntegerType*>(Entry->second)->getBitWidth() > 0 && "Valid bit width must be provided");
    }
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize && "TreeEntry state must be SplitVectorize");
    assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "Exactly two entries must be in CombinedEntriesWithIndices");
    
     
    Value* CondVal = ConstantInt::getTrue(Context);
    Value* TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(1.0));
    Value* FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::fabs), { TrueVal }, "", BB);
    FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::ctpop), { FalseVal }, "", BB);
    SelectInst* SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    Type* SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType && "SelectInst type must be correctly retrievable");
    
     
    assert(CondVal && "SelectInst condition must be a valid Value object");
    assert(TrueVal && "SelectInst true value must be a valid Value object");
    assert(FalseVal && "SelectInst false value must be a valid Value object");
    
     
    assert(!simplifySelectInst(SI) && !canonicalizeSelectToShuffle(SI) && !canonicalizeScalarSelectOfVecs(SI) && "SelectInst should not simplify or transform further");
    
     
    ICmpInst* Cmp = dyn_cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal);
    assert(Cmp && Cmp->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && "Condition must be an icmp ult comparison");
    assert(TrueVal == Cmp->getOperand(0) && "Condition operand 0 must be TrueVal");
    assert(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2) == Cmp->getOperand(1) && "Condition operand 1 must be the integer constant 2");
    
     
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && "SelectInst type must be an integer type or an integer vector type");
    assert((Cmp->getType()->isScalarTy() == CondVal->getType()->isScalarTy()) && "Condition and selection types must match");
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && "TreeEntry state must be Vectorize");
    assert(E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement && "Instruction opcode must be InsertElement");
    
     
    Value* Operand = E->getOperand(1).back();
    assert(!Operand->getType()->isVectorTy() && "Last operand must not be a vector type");
    
     
    Type* ScalarTy = VL[0];
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy must be a valid element type");
    
     
    if (!MinBWs.empty()) {
        auto Entry = MinBWs.find(E.get());
        assert((Entry != MinBWs.end() && static_cast<IntegerType*>(Entry->second)->getBitWidth() > 0) || (E->Idx == 0 && E->isReducedBitcastRoot()) && "ScalarTy must be updated based on precomputed smaller type");
    }
    
     
    Instruction* I = BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(BinaryOperator::Create(Instruction::FABS, Arg, "", BB));
    assert(I->getOpcode() == Instruction::FNEG && "Instruction must be a FNeg");
    
     
    uint64_t MaskBase = 0;
     
    assert(MaskBase > 0 && "MaskBase must be correctly computed and used in further logic");
    
    std::cout << "All assertions passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Callee}, "call", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memcpy;  
    CallInst *MemCpy = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, ID), Callee, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MemCpy) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *MI = cast<IntrinsicInst>(MemCpy);
    assert((ID == Intrinsic::memcpy || ID == Intrinsic::memmove || ID == Intrinsic::memset) && "Intrinsic should be one of memcpy, memmove, or memset");

     
    if (MI->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy || MI->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memmove || MI->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);  
        assert(NumBytes->isNotMultipleOfElementSize() && "NumBytes must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(MemCpy);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRP = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CI);
    assert(IRP.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition should have position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     
    Function *F2 = IRP.getAnchorScope();
    assert(F2 && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");

     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");

     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E].getBitWidth() > 0 && "Precomputed type bit width must be valid");
    }

     
    if (E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize) {
        assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");
    } else if (E->isGather() || E->in(TransformedToGatherNodes)) {
         
    }

     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(F, {TrueVal}, "false_val", BB);  
    assert(CondVal && TrueVal && FalseVal && "SelectInst conditions must be valid");
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    assert(SelType && "SelType must be correctly retrievable");

     
    if (SelType->isIntegerTy()) {
        Value *CTPop = CallInst::Create(F, {TrueVal}, "ctpop", BB);  
        assert(Ctpop && "FalseVal must be a ctpop operation of TrueVal");
    }

     
    unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;  
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask = FPClassTest::all();  
    assert(DemandedMask.isValid() && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop must be safe to clone");
    assert(!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop header's address must not be taken");

     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    Value *Args[] = {
        ConstantExpr::getPointerNull(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)),
        ConstantExpr::getPointerNull(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)),
        Builder.getInt64(0)
    };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), makeArrayRef(Args), "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Function is marked as nounwind.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "CallInst is not marked as nounwind.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is marked as nounwind.\n";
    }

     
    F->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemory()) {
        errs() << "Failed to create a valid intrinsic call\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CI) && "CI must be a CallBase");

     

    std::cout << "Test program setup completed.\n";
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrId = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrId), Args, "", BB);

     
    Use &U = F->args().front();  
    new StoreInst(CI, &U, false, BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    if (II) {
        switch (II->getIntrinsicID()) {
            case Intrinsic::memset:
                 
                break;
            case Intrinsic::atomic_load:
            case Intrinsic::atomic_store:
                 
                break;
            default:
                assert(false && "Unsupported intrinsic type");
        }
    }

     

    std::cout << "Module: " << M << "\n";
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    AllocaInst *Alloca = new AllocaInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, "arg_alloca", BB->getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    LoadInst *Load = new LoadInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Alloca, "load_arg", false, BB);
    StoreInst *Store = new StoreInst(Load, Alloca, BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Func, {Alloca}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrinID = Intrinsic::fabs;  
    CallInst *IntrinsicCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), IntrinID), {Alloca}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrinsicCI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

int main() {
    llvm::LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> Module = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("test", Context);
    llvm::Function *Func = llvm::Function::Create(llvm::FunctionType::get(llvm::Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    
     
    llvm::IRBuilder<> Builder(&Func->getEntryBlock(), Func->getEntryBlock().begin());
    llvm::Value *Size = llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4);
    llvm::Value *Val = llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0);
    llvm::CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(llvm::Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), llvm::Intrinsic::memset), { Val, Size }, "", true  );
    
     
    CI->addUse(Func->arg_begin());
    
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
        
         
        if (Func->doesNotThrow() && !CI->doesNotThrow()) {
            std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind and CallInst does not throw." << std::endl;
            
             
            if (llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
                std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
                
                 
            } else {
                std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
            }
        } else {
            std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind or CallInst throws." << std::endl;
        }
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, Args, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Expected a CallInst to be intrinsic\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
     

    std::cout << "Test setup completed.\n";
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

int main() {
    llvm::LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> Module = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("test", Context);
    
     
    auto *FnType = llvm::FunctionType::get(llvm::Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    auto *Fn = llvm::Function::Create(FnType, llvm::GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_fn", Module.get());
    Fn->setDoesNotThrow();
    Fn->setUnwindBehavior(llvm::Function::Unwind);

     
    auto *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Fn);
    auto *CallInst = llvm::CallBase::Create(FnType, llvm::Instruction::OtherOps, BB);
    
     
    CallInst->addUse(*BB);

     
    auto *Intrinsic = llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::IntrinsicInst>(CallInst);
    if (!Intrinsic || !Intrinsic->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Module->print(llvm::outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    arg->setName("inputArg");

    IntrinsicInst *intrinsic = IntrinsicInst::Create(module.getContext(), intrinsicID, { ci }, "", bb);

    Value *numBytes = anyMem->getArgOperand(1);
    assert(isa<ConstantInt>(numBytes) && "Memory intrinsic must have a constant zero or negative length.");

     
    module.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test", &TheModule);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Builder.getInt32Ty());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *MemIntrin = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    Value *Dst = Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt8Ty(Context));
    Value *Src = Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt8Ty(Context));
    CallInst *MI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, {Dst, Src}, "", BB);

     
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MI) && "Expected an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *AnyMemIntrin = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MI);
    assert(AnyMemIntrin->getIntrinsicID() == MemIntrin && "Expected a memcpy intrinsic");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat::fltOne));
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateFNeg(Builder.CreateFAbs(TrueVal));
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 2.0));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Expected integer type for condition");
    assert(TrueVal->getType() == SI->getCondition()->getType() && "TrueVal type mismatch");
    assert(FalseVal->getType() == TrueVal->getType() && "FalseVal type mismatch");

     
    F->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setReturnValueFlag(true);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    Value *CallVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&Mod, IID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CallVal->addUse(*F);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (verifyModule(Mod, &outs())) {
        errs() << "Verification failed!\n";
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "Test passed successfully.\n";
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (!isa<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II->isMemIntrinsic()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    M.print(llvm::outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 5);
    Argument *A1 = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg1", BB);
    A1->addIncoming(Arg1, BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, { A1 }, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(A1);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, { CI }, "", BB);

     
    if (auto *AI = dyn_cast<AtomicRMWInst>(II)) {
        AI->setOrdering(AtomicRMWInst::Unordered);
    } else if (auto *SI = dyn_cast<StoreInst>(II)) {
        SI->setAlignment(16);  
    }

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &module);
    func->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);
    IRBuilder<> builder(entryBB);

     
    Value *arg1 = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, Intrinsic::memset), {arg1}, "", entryBB);

     
    CI->addUse(func->getArg(0));

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setUnwindDest(&module.getContext().createBasicBlock("unwind"));

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        errs() << "Intrinsic call detected.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "No intrinsic call detected.\n";
    }

     
    assert(func->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    CallBase *CI;
    if (F->isIntrinsic()) {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Function is not an intrinsic!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgNo());
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(&*F->begin()->begin());
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function does not have 'nounwind' attribute set correctly!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic and has at least one use." << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Function marked as nounwind and does not throw." << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopPass.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
bool attemptLoopUnrolling(Function &F) {
     
    auto *LI = getAnalysisIfAvailable<LoopInfoWrapperPass>(F).getLoopInfo();
    if (!LI || LI->empty()) return false;

    for (auto &L : *LI) {
        if (!L->isLoopExit(L->getHeader())) continue;  

        auto *Unroll = new UnrollLoopPass(*L);
        bool Changed = Unroll.run();
        if (Changed) {
            outs() << "Loop was successfully unrolled.\n";
            return true;
        } else {
            outs() << "Failed to unroll the loop.\n";
            return false;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Zero = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    StoreInst *Store = new StoreInst(Zero, nullptr, BB);
    LoadInst *Load = new LoadInst(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), Zero, "", false, BB);

     
    BasicBlock *PreHeader = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    BranchInst *Br = BranchInst::Create(BB, PreHeader);

     
    std::unique_ptr<LoopInfoWrapperPass> LIP(new LoopInfoWrapperPass());
    LIP->getLoopInfo().push_back(std::make_unique<Loop>(BB));

    attemptLoopUnrolling(*F);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Type *IntTy = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);

     
    Argument *Arg = new Argument(IntTy, "arg", F);
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, AttributeSet::getWithParam(Context, 0, Attribute::Returned));

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->takeName(nullptr);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow() && !CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function and CallInst are correctly marked as nounwind and doesNotThrow." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function or CallInst is not correctly marked as nounwind or doesNotThrow." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Instruction *CtxI = CI;
    if (isa<CallBase>(CtxI)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase instance." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is not a CallBase instance." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (IRPosition::callsite_argument(CtxI).getKind() == IRPosition::CallSiteArgument) {
        std::cout << "IRPosition is correctly set to callsite argument." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "IRPosition is not correctly set to callsite argument." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (Function *Func = CtxI->getFunction()) {
        std::cout << "Associated function exists." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "No associated function found." << std::endl;
    }

     
     

     
     

     
     

    return 0;
}

    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
            errs() << "Intrinsic detected: memset\n";
        }
    }

     
    bool simplified = CI->hasOneUse();  
    if (simplified) {
        CI->dump();
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have enough uses to be simplified.\n";
    }

     
    Type *argType = F->getArg(0)->getType();
    if (isValidElementType(argType)) {
        errs() << "Valid element type detected.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Invalid element type.\n";
    }

     

    return 0;

    A->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
