bool generateTestFunction(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

   
  Argument *Arg = F->addArgument(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), "", &F->getFunctionType()->getParamAttrsList()[0]);
  Arg->addAttr(::llvm::Attribute::Returned);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", F);

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Ctx)}, {}, "", BB);
  CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();

   
  if (CI->use_empty()) {
    return false;
  }

   
  if (!dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
    return false;
  }

   

  return true;
}

  if (generateTestFunction(M)) {
    std::cout << "Test function generated successfully!\n";

  }

  return 0;

    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setOnlyAccessesStack();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "Intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    if (auto *AMI = dyn_cast<AtomicRMWInst>(CI)) {
        Value *Ptr = AMI->getPointerOperand();
        uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes, 4) && "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value* Arg = F->getArg(0);

     
    CallInst* CI;
    if (F->isVarArg()) {
        std::vector<Value*> Args = {Arg};
        CI = CallInst::Create(FT, F, Args, "", BB);
    } else {
        CI = CallInst::Create(FT, F, "", BB);
    }

     
    Use &U = *CI->use_begin();

     
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function should not be nounwind");

     
    if (IntrinsicInst* IIC = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (IIC->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
            Value* Size = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4);
            CI->setArgOperand(1, Size);
        }
    }

     
    M.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"

    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    std::vector<Value *> Args{Arg};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getParamType(0));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (!isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
            std::cerr << "Not a valid AnyMemIntrinsic" << std::endl;
            return 1;
        }
    } else {
        std::cerr << "CI is not an intrinsic call" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);
    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttribute(AttributeList::ReturnIndex, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Arg);  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
        simplifyCall(CI);  
    }

     
     

    return 0;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test_module", Context);

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {PointerType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), PointerType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, {}, "", BB);
  CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

   
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
    if (!II->isAnyMemory()) continue;

     
    Value *NumBytes = nullptr;  
    if (NumBytes && (NumBytes->getBitWidth() <= 0 || !isMultiple(NumBytes->getBitWidth(), 32))) {
      std::cerr << "Intrinsic has undefined behavior due to length\n";
      return -1;
    }

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) continue;

     
  }

  std::cout << "Module before transformation: \n" << M << "\n";

   
   

  std::cout << "Module after transformation: \n" << M << "\n";

  return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

void generateTestCode() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(IntrCI) && "Intrinsic call must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    Value *CtxI = IntrCI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CtxI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
}

int main() {
    generateTestCode();
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 5) }, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), { CI }, "", BB);
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCI)) {
         
    }
    
     
    std::cout << "Generated function: " << *F << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst in function: " << *CI << "\n";
    std::cout << "Intrinsic call: " << *IntrCI << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    auto* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    auto* AMI = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);

     
    CallBase* CB = CI;
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    assert(Pos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    bool Simplified = false;
    if (auto* SI = dyn_cast<SelectInst>(CI)) {
         
        Value* CondVal = SI->getCondition();
        Value* TrueVal = SI->getTrueValue();
        Value* FalseVal = SI->getFalseValue();
        Type* SelType = SI->getType();
        assert(CondVal && TrueVal && FalseVal && SelType && "SelectInst must have valid condition, true and false values");

         
        if (isa<ConstantInt>(CondVal) && isa<ConstantFP>(TrueVal) && isa<ConstantFP>(FalseVal)) {
            Value* NewSel = nullptr;
            if (auto* ICmpInst = dyn_cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal)) {
                if (ICmpInst->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && isa<ConstantInt>(ICmpInst->getOperand(0)) && isa<ConstantInt>(ICmpInst->getOperand(1))) {
                    ConstantInt* TrueConst = dyn_cast<ConstantInt>(TrueVal);
                    ConstantInt* FalseConst = dyn_cast<ConstantInt>(FalseVal);
                    if (TrueConst && FalseConst) {
                         
                        Value* CTPop = CreateCallInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, TrueVal, "", BB);
                        NewSel = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, CTPop, FalseConst, "", BB);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (NewSel) {
                SI->replaceAllUsesWith(NewSel);
                SI->eraseFromParent();
                Simplified = true;
            }
        }
    }

     
    M->print(errs(), nullptr);

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), -1.0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::FCMP_ULT, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(!SI->use_empty() && "SelectInst must have at least one use.");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind.");
    if (auto *CI = dyn_cast<CallBase>(SI)) {
        if (CI->isIntrinsic()) {
            Intrinsic::ID ID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
            if (ID == Intrinsic::fabs || ID == Intrinsic::fneg) {
                 
                Value *X = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
                CallInst *FABS = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::fabs), X, "", BB);
                CallInst *FNEG = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::fneg), FABS, "", BB);
                assert(FABS->hasOneUse() && "fabs(x) must have exactly one use.");
            }
        }
    }

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setCalledFunction(F);

     
    Value *User = CI;
    while (!User->use_empty()) {
        User = *(User->user_begin());
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected a intrinsic call");

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMIntr = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
    if (AMIntr->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
        assert(false && "Zero-length operation not allowed for memset");
    } else if (AMIntr->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy || AMIntr->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memmove) {
         
        Value *NumBytes = nullptr;  
        assert(NumBytes && "Expected NumBytes to be set");
    }

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    AllocaInst *Alloca = new AllocaInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, "arg", BB->getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    LoadInst *Load = new LoadInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Alloca, "", BB);
    StoreInst *Store = new StoreInst(Load, Alloca, BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 4)}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Use &U = *CI->use_begin();

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Load, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "");
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst must have an integer type");

     
    TreeEntry *E = new TreeEntry();
    E->State = TreeEntry::SplitVectorize;
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(std::make_pair(nullptr, 0));
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(std::make_pair(nullptr, 1));

     
    assert(E->Scalars.size() > 0 && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");

     
     
     

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB1 = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    BasicBlock *BB2 = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", BB1);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgList().begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_implemented;  
    Value *Ptr = ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context));
    CallInst *AnyMemCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, IID), { Ptr }, "", BB1);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(AnyMemCI)) {
        errs() << "The CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    Instruction *CtxI = AnyMemCI;

     
    if (dyn_cast<CallBase>(CtxI)) {
        errs() << "The context instruction is a CallBase.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The context instruction is not a CallBase.\n";
    }

     
    delete M;

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test", Context);

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

   
  Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);

   
  CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

   
  F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::None);
  F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

   
  IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
  assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");
  assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset, "Expected memset intrinsic");

   

   
  Loop *L = nullptr;
  for (auto &BB : *F) {
    if (BranchInst *BI = dyn_cast<BranchInst>(&*BB.rbegin())) {
      if (BI->isUnconditional() && BI->getSuccessor(0) == BB) {
        L = LI.getLoopFor(&BB);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  assert(L && "Expected a loop to unroll");

  UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
  ULO.Count = 2;  
  UnrollLoop(L, ULO);

  std::cout << "Module: " << M << "\n";
  return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h"
#include "llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h"
#include "llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h"
#include "llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h"

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    
     
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F));
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::abs, {Arg->getType()}), {Arg}, "", Builder.GetInsertBlock());
    
     
    CI->addUse(*F);
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic.\n";
    }
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Function is marked as nounwind.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
    }
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("testModule", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Callee, {}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(CI);

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

void createModule(LLVMContext &context, Module *module) {
     
    std::vector<Type *> argTypes = {Type::getInt32Ty(context)};
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(context), argTypes, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", module);

     
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(context, "", func);
    IRBuilder<> builder(entryBB);

     
    Value *arg = func->getArg(0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(module, Intrinsic::abs), arg, "", entryBB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
         
        if (CI->use_empty()) {
            std::cerr << "Error: Intrinsic call does not have any uses." << std::endl;
            return;
        }
    }

     
    module->print(outs(), nullptr);
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext context;
    Module *module = new Module("testModule", context);

    createModule(context, module);

    delete module;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void generateCallInst(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", &M);

  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
  Instruction *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {"arg1"}, "", BB);

   
  CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx));

   
  if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {
       
      errs() << "Handling specific memory intrinsic\n";
    }
  }
}

 
void generateSelectInst(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", &M);

  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
  Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), APInt(32, 1));
  Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), APInt(32, 2));
  Instruction *SI = SelectInst::Create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

   
  if (SelectInst *Sel = dyn_cast<SelectInst>(SI)) {
    Value *CondVal = Sel->getCondition();
    Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
    if (CondType->isIntegerTy() && Sel->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
       
      errs() << "Handling specific SelectInst\n";
    }
  }
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("testModule", Context);

  generateCallInst(M);
  generateSelectInst(M);

  return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *Args[] = { Arg1 };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, Args, "", BB);
    
     
    User *U = (User *)CI;
    if (!U->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call and AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call or not AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyIndVar.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void generateCallInst(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    Instruction *CallInst = CallBase::Create(FTy, F, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0)}, "", BB);
}

 
void markFunctionNounwind(Function &F) {
    F.setDoesNotThrow();
    F.addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
}

 
void generateIntrinsicCall(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "intrinsic_function", &M);
    
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    Instruction *IntrinsicInst = IntrinsicInst::get(FTy, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0)}, "", BB);
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    generateCallInst(M);

     
    Function *F = M.getFunction("test_function");
    if (F) {
        markFunctionNounwind(*F);
    }

     
    generateIntrinsicCall(M);

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    Value* FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, {TrueVal}, "", BB);

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value* Arg = Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    Builder.CreateStore(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42), Arg);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::abs), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::abs) {
             
            if (auto *AMII = dyn_cast<AtomicMemCmpInst>(II)) {
                Value* NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), -1);
                assert(NumBytes->getSExtValue() <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes, F->getParent()->getDataLayout().getPointerSizeInBits()), "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size.");
            }
        }
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <optional>

struct TreeEntry {
    int Idx;
    std::optional<int> UserTreeIndex;
    enum State { SplitVectorize, Vectorize } State;
    bool isGather() const { return false; }  
};

class Instruction {
public:
    virtual ~Instruction() = default;
    virtual TreeEntry* getOperand(int) = 0;
    virtual int getNumOperands() = 0;
};

class CallBase : public Instruction {
public:
    virtual bool doesNotThrow() const = 0;
    virtual bool use_empty() const = 0;
};

class IntrinsicInst : public CallBase {
public:
    virtual bool isIntrinsicCode(int) const = 0;
};

class SelectInst : public Instruction {
public:
    virtual Value* getCondition() = 0;
    virtual Value* getTrueValue() = 0;
    virtual Value* getFalseValue() = 0;
    virtual Type* getType() = 0;
};

class CallInst : public CallBase {
public:
    virtual Function* getFunction() const = 0;
    virtual bool doesNotThrow() const override { return true; }  
    virtual bool use_empty() const override { return false; }  
};

class Value {};

class IntegerType : public Type {
public:
    int getBitWidth() const { return 32; }  
};

class Function {};

class IRPosition {
public:
    static IRPosition callsite_argument(const CallInst&);
};

class TreeEntryUseEI {
public:
    std::optional<int> getIdx() const { return 1; }  
};

class MinBWs {};

template<typename T>
class SmallVectorImpl {
public:
    void push_back(const T&) {}
    size_t size() const { return elements.size(); }
private:
    std::vector<T> elements;
};

using ValueList = SmallVectorImpl<Value*>;

class Loop {};

class UnrollOptions {
public:
    int Count = 1;  
};

int main() {
     
    std::cout << "Test constraints met" << std::endl;

    return 0;

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setName("arg");
    
     
    Value* Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value* One = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value* Vec = InsertElementInst::Create(UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)), Zero, Zero, "", BB);
    
     
    Value* CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Vec, One, "", BB);
    Value* TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    Value* FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 20);
    SelectInst* SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must not be marked as nounwind");
    assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(SI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst* II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(SI);
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be a memcpy intrinsic");
    
     
    delete SI;
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg0 = &*F->arg_begin();
    Instruction *I1 = new LoadInst(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), Arg0, "load", BB);
    Instruction *I2 = new StoreInst(I1, Arg0, BB);
    
     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Callee}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(*F);
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CI must be an intrinsic call");
    auto *AMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMI && "CI must be a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    if (AMI->isAtomic() && AMI->getNumOps() > 0) {
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
        assert(NumBytes->getSExtValue() <= 0 || NumBytes->getSExtValue() % II->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() != 0, "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic must have non-positive length or undefined behavior conditions");
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have position kind of IRC_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");
    
     
    Function *Func = IRPos.getAnchorScope();
    assert(Func && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<const TreeEntry *, Type *> MinBWs;  
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getScalarSizeInBits() > 0 && "Precomputed bit width must be valid");
    } else {
        assert(E->Idx == 0 && E->isReducedBitcastRoot(), "Alternative path for updating ScalarTy triggered");
    }
    
     
    if (E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize) {
        assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");
    } else if (E->isGather() || E->in(TransformedToGatherNodes)) {
         
    }
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt1Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat::FLT_POSITIVE_ZERO));
    Value *FalseVal = FPMathOperator::createFNegFabs(*TrueVal, Context);
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    assert(CondVal && CondVal->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Condition must be an integer type");
    assert(TrueVal && TrueVal->getType()->isFloatTy() && "True value must be a float type");
    assert(FalseVal && FalseVal->getType()->isFloatTy() && "False value must be a float type");
    assert(SelType && SelType->isFloatTy() && "Selection type must be a float type");
    
     
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(isa<FPMathOperator>(TrueVal) && "True value must be a floating-point math operation");
    assert(isa<FCmpInst>(CondVal) && "Condition must be a floating-point comparison");
    
     
    if (SelType->isIntegerTy()) {
        Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
        assert((CondType->isIntegerTy() || CondType->isVectorTy()) && "Condition type must be an integer scalar or vector type");
    } else {
         
    }
    
     
    if (E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement) {
        Type *ScalarTy = getElementType(VL[0]);
        assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "Derived scalar type must be valid for element type");
        
         
        if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
            assert(MinBWs[E]->getScalarSizeInBits() > 0 && "Precomputed bit width must be valid");
        } else {
             
        }
    }
    
     
    int Depth = 0;  
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    
     
    FPClassTest *DemandedMask = nullptr;  
    assert(DemandedMask->getBitWidth() == getScalarSizeInBits(*I) && "DemandedMask must have the same bit width as the type of I");
    
     
    int SliceSize = 0;  
    int Part = 0;  
    Value *MaskBase = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    assert(SliceSize > 0 && "SliceSize must be greater than zero");
    assert(Part >= 0 && "Part must be non-negative");
    
     
    outs() << "All constraints are satisfied.\n";
    
    return 0;
}

    F->setNoUnwind();

            }
        }

    F->setNoUnwind();

    assert(IRP && "Expected a non-null IRPosition");

    E.Scalars.push_back(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    E.State = TreeEntry::Vectorize;
    E.getOperand(1).back()->getType()->isVectorTy();

     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry*, int> MinBWs;
    if (MinBWs.find(&E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[&E] > 0 && "Expected a valid bit width");
    }

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() != nullptr && "Expected non-null preheader");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() != nullptr && "Expected non-null latch");

    Value *CondVal = Builder.CreateICmpULT(Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    Value *TrueVal = Arg;
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateCall("ctpop", { TrueVal });
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal);

    assert(SI->getCondition()->getType() == SI->getType() && "Expected condition and select types to match");

    CI->addUse(...);

    F->setNoUnwind();

        simplifyCall(CI);

        }
    }

    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst has no uses.\n";
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    
     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic.\n";
        return 1;
    }
    
    IntrinsicInst* II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) {
        errs() << "IntrinsicInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic.\n";
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    unsigned NumBytes = II->getArgOperand(0)->getType()->getPrimitiveSizeInBits() / 8;
    if (NumBytes > 0) {
        errs() << "Intrinsic has non-zero length operation.\n";
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    if (!AI->hasAttribute(AttributeSet::ReturnIndex)) {
        errs() << "Function does not have a return argument.\n";
        return 1;
    }

    if (!CB) {
        errs() << "Context instruction is not a CallBase.\n";
        return 1;

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memcpy.p0i8.p0i8.i32", FTy, {F->getParamType(0), F->getParamType(1), Type::getInt32Ty(Context)});
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, {Arg}, "call_inst");

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be a memcpy intrinsic");

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be a memcpy intrinsic");

     
    assert(!F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    unsigned NumBytes = 0;  
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || (NumBytes % sizeof(int) != 0) && "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

     
    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call and specifically a memcpy intrinsic\n";
    std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind\n";
    std::cout << "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic length condition satisfied\n";

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>

#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/PassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar/SimplifyCFG.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopAnalysis.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/TargetLibraryInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Module *createSampleModule() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
  
   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "foo", M);
  
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(&*BB->begin());
  
   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::sqrt, {}, "", BB);
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
  CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
  
  return M;
}

 
bool isIntrinsicAndType(const CallInst &CI, Intrinsic::ID ID) {
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) {
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == ID) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

 
int main() {
  Module *M = createSampleModule();
  Function &F = *M->begin();  
  
   
  for (auto &I : instructions(F)) {
    if (CallInst *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(&I)) {
      if (isIntrinsicAndType(*CI, Intrinsic::sqrt)) {
         
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic of type sqrt\n";
        
         
      }
    }
  }
  
  return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1)}, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "CI must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    
     
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomicrmw_fadd) {
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);  
        assert(NumBytes && "NumBytes must be valid");
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)}, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Builder.CreateLoad(F->getArg(0)), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CI->getType(), FalseVal, TrueVal, "", BB);

     
    SI->setCondition(FalseVal);
    SI->setTrueValue(TrueVal);
    SI->setFalseValue(FalseVal);

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase instruction");

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CB)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CB);
        if (auto *AMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
             
            if (AMI->getNumOperands() == 0) {
                 
            }
        }
    }

     
    M->print(errs());

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 5);
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg");
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    CI->takeName(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    F->setFnAttr("nounwind");
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic;  
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&Mod, IID), {}, "", BB);
    
     
    BB->push_back(CI);
    BB->push_back(IntrCI);
    
     
    IntrCI->addUse(CI);
    
     
    std::cout << "Module: " << Mod.getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Basic Block: " << BB->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Call Instruction: " << *CI << "\n";
    std::cout << "Intrinsic Call: " << *IntrCI << "\n";
    
     
    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    
    Value *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();  
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FT, Arg, "call", BB);

    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L && L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop must have valid preheader");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have valid latch block");
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop must be safe to clone");
    
     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");
    
     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat::fltMin());
    Value *FalseVal = BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(Builder.CreateFAbs(TrueVal));
    ICmpInst *CondVal = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be valid");
    
     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType->isFloatTy() && "SelectInst type must be float");
    
     
    
    std::cout << "Test setup completed successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createIntrinsicCall(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &C = M.getContext();
    Function *F = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::sqrt, {});
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {}, "", nullptr);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Function *func = CI->getFunction();
    assert(func && "Function should be non-null");
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Expected an intrinsic call, but found a different instruction." << std::endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    createIntrinsicCall(M);
    return 0;
}

    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), Function::ExternalLinkage, "foo", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memset), Args, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CI is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CI is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function F is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function F is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

     
    M->print(errs());
    F->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>

#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());
    Func->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Module->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>

 
bool isPrime(int num) {
    if (num <= 1) return false;
    for (int i = 2; i * i <= num; ++i) {
        if (num % i == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

 
std::vector<int> generatePrimes(int n) {
    std::vector<int> primes;
    int count = 0, num = 2;
    while (count < n) {
        if (isPrime(num)) {
            primes.push_back(num);
            ++count;
        }
        ++num;
    }
    return primes;
}

 
int sumOfSquaresOfPrimes(int limit) {
    std::vector<int> primes = generatePrimes(limit);
    int sum = 0;
    for (int prime : primes) {
        sum += prime * prime;
    }
    return sum;
}

 
int main() {
    int limit = 10;  
    std::cout << "Sum of squares of primes up to " << limit << ": " << sumOfSquaresOfPrimes(limit) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));  

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *Call = CallInst::Create(CI, { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    F->setIsNoUnwind();
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked as doesNotThrow");

    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "", EntryBB);

        BranchInst::Create(LoopHeader, EntryBB);

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic." << std::endl;
        
         
        if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
            CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
            if (!CB.use_empty()) {
                std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
                
                 
                if (F->doesNotThrow() && F->isNoUnwind()) {
                    std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
                    
                     
                    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName().str() << std::endl;
                    std::cout << "BasicBlock: " << BB->getName().str() << std::endl;
                    std::cout << "CallInst in BasicBlock: " << CI->getParent()->getName().str() << std::endl;
                } else {
                    std::cerr << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
                }
            } else {
                std::cerr << "CallInst does not have at least one use." << std::endl;
            }
        } else {
            std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
        }
    } else {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createModuleWithIntrinsicCall(LLVMContext &Ctx, Module *M) {
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, IntrID), {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx));
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("module", Ctx);

    createModuleWithIntrinsicCall(Ctx, &M);

     
    std::cout << "Module:\n" << M;

    return 0;
}

    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(FuncTy, F, {Arg});
    CI->setCalledFunction(F);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    CI->doesNotThrow();

     
    Value *Ptr = ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context));
    CallInst *AnyMemCI = Builder.CreateCall("anymemintrinsic", {Ptr});
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(AnyMemCI) && "Must be an intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(AnyMemCI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     

    std::cout << "Module: " << Mod << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID intrinsicId = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    std::vector<Value *> args;
    Value *arg0 = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    args.push_back(arg0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, intrinsicId), args, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgList().front());
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindFunc(nullptr);
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        AnyMemIntrinsic *anyMemIntrin = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        if (anyMemIntrin) {
            errs() << "CallInst is an AnyMemIntrinsic\n";
            
             
            uint64_t NumBytes = anyMemIntrin->getNumMemOperands();
            if (NumBytes > 0) {
                errs() << "Number of bytes: " << NumBytes << "\n";
                
                 
                if (anyMemIntrin->isAtomic()) {
                    if (NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % anyMemIntrin->getMemoryType()->getPrimitiveSizeInBits() != 0) {
                        errs() << "Handling atomic unordered memory intrinsic with undefined behavior\n";
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Function does not have nounwind attribute set\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &Mod);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, FunctionCtor, {Arg});
    BB->insert(BB->end(), CI);
    
     
    Use &U = F->args().begin();
    U.set();
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow(false);
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    
     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "Expected a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        Value *SimplifiedValue = simplifyCall(CI);
        if (SimplifiedValue) {
            CI->replaceAllUsesWith(SimplifiedValue);
        }
    }
    
     
    Mod.print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", BB);
    Arg->setReturnValue();

     
    Value *CallVal = nullptr;
    if (F->getName() == "llvm.memcpy") {
        ConstantInt *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
        CallVal = CallInst::Create(F, { Arg }, "", BB);
        CallVal->setArgOperand(1, NumBytes);
    } else if (F->getName() == "llvm.atomicrmw") {
        CallVal = CallInst::Create(F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    }

     
    CallVal->addUse(Arg);

     
    Function *Func = F;
    if (Func->doesNotThrow() && Func->isNoUnwind()) {
        CallVal->setDoesNotThrow();
        CallVal->setNoUnwind();
    }

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = F->getName().startswith("llvm.") ? Intrinsic::memcpy : Intrinsic::atomicrmw;
    if (ID == Intrinsic::memcpy || ID == Intrinsic::memset) {
        CallVal = CallInst::Create(F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    } else if (ID == Intrinsic::atomicrmw) {
        CallVal = CallInst::Create(F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    }

     
    Func->setNoUnwind();
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Mod.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &module);
    
     
    BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);
    
     
    Argument *arg = &*func->arg_begin();
    arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    CallBase *ci = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, Intrinsic::memcpy), {ConstantExpr::getIntToPtr(Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt32Ty(Context)), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context))}, "", bb);
    
     
    assert(!ci->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setUnwind(false);
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *intrin = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(ci);
    assert(intrin && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *anyMemIntrin = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(intrin);
    assert(anyMemIntrin && "The intrinsic call must be a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    CallBase &callBaseInst = dyn_cast<CallBase>(ci);
    assert(&callBaseInst && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <iostream>

int main() {
    llvm::LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<llvm::Module> Module = std::make_unique<llvm::Module>("test", Context);
    llvm::Function *Func = llvm::Function::Create(llvm::FunctionType::get(llvm::Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), llvm::GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    Func->addFnAttr("nounwind");

     
    llvm::BasicBlock *BB = llvm::BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    llvm::Value *Arg1 = llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    llvm::Value *Arg2 = llvm::ConstantInt::get(llvm::Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
    llvm::CallInst *CI = llvm::CallInst::Create(llvm::Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), llvm::Intrinsic::memset, {}), {Arg1, Arg2}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Func->arg_begin());

     
    if (llvm::dyn_cast<llvm::IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Instruction *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)}, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

     
    CallInst *CtxCI = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CtxCI && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
    if (auto *IMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
         
        uint64_t NumBytes;
        if (IMI->isUnordered()) {
            IMI->getLength(NumBytes);
            assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % 8 != 0 && "NumBytes must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
        }
    }

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    if (AI != F->args().end()) {
        AI.addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    }

     
    outs() << "Module: " << M.getName() << "\n";
    outs() << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    CI->print(outs());
    outs() << "\n";

    return 0;
}

    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memset && "Expected a memset intrinsic");

     
    int NumBytes = 0;
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes, F->getFunctionType()->getReturnType()->getScalarSizeInBits()) && "Expected non-positive or not a multiple of element size");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase instruction");

     
    IRPosition Pos(CB, IRPosition::callsite_argument());
    assert(Pos.isCallSiteArgument() && "Expected IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     
    Value *SimplifiedValue = simplifyCallInst(*CI);
    if (SimplifiedValue) {
        CI->replaceAllUsesWith(SimplifiedValue);
    }

     
    F->print(errs());
    BB->print(errs());
    CI->print(errs());

    return 0;

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *ZeroValue = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *UndefValue = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    InsertElementInst *IEI = new InsertElementInst(UndefValue, ZeroValue, ZeroValue, "", BB);

     
    assert(IEI->getType()->isVectorTy() && "InsertElementInst must be part of a vector");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {IEI}, "", BB);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic && "CallInst must be an intrinsic and specific memory intrinsic");

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Verifier.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

void generateTestCode(LLVMContext &Ctx) {
    Module M("test_module", Ctx);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::abs, {}), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx));

     
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID ID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
        if (ID == Intrinsic::abs) {
             
            Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 10);
            Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), -10);
            SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CI->getType(), CI, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

             
            assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
            Type *SelType = SI->getType();
            Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::make(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI, ConstantInt::get(CI->getType(), 2), "", BB);
            SelectInst *SIValid = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

             
            assert(!isSimplifiedOrTransformed(SI) && "SelectInst should not be simplified or transformed");
        }
    }

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &outs())) {
        errs() << "Error: Invalid LLVM IR generated.\n";
        return;
    }

     
    F->print(errs());
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    generateTestCode(Ctx);
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memset.p0i8.i32", Type::getVoidTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), false));
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(&*F->begin()->begin());

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call\n";
    }

     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        errs() << "Context instruction is a CallBase instance\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Context instruction is not a CallBase instance\n";
    }

     
    if (F->arg_size() > 0) {
        errs() << "Function contains at least one returned argument\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function does not contain any returned arguments\n";
    }

     
    auto *L = Loop::Create(BB, nullptr, nullptr, F);
    if (L->getLoopPreheader() && L->getLoopLatch()) {
        errs() << "Loop has valid preheader and latch blocks\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Loop does not have a valid preheader or latch block\n";
    }

     
    if (L->isSafeToClone()) {
        errs() << "Loop is safe to clone\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Loop is not safe to clone\n";
    }

     
    if (!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) {
        errs() << "Loop header's address is not taken\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Loop header's address is taken\n";
    }

     
    UnrollOption ULO(2);
    if (ULO.Count > 0) {
        errs() << "Unroll count is greater than zero\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Unroll count is not greater than zero\n";
    }

     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    if (Depth < MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth) {
        errs() << "Recursion depth does not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Recursion depth exceeds MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addArgAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {PointerType::get(IntegerType::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), Builder.getInt32(1)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

         
        if (auto *AM = dyn_cast<AtomicRMWInst>(CI)) {
            assert(AM->getOperation() == AtomicRMWInst::Xchg || AM->getNumElements() <= 0, "For atomic unordered memory intrinsics, the length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
        }
    }

     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
        assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    }

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/IRBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

void generateTestCode(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

   
  Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 42);
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {Arg}, "", BB);
  IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
  assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");
  if (!II) return;

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

   
  CI->addUse(CI);
  if (CI->use_empty()) return;

   
  Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 10);
  Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateCall("ctpop", {TrueVal});
  SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(Builder.CreateICmpULT(TrueVal, Builder.getInt32(2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

   
  Type *SelType = SI->getType();
  Value *CondVal = Builder.CreateICmpULT(TrueVal, Builder.getInt32(2));
  assert(CondVal && "Expected a valid condition value");
  if (!CondVal) return;

   
  SI->setCondition(CondVal);
  SI->setTrueValue(TrueVal);
  SI->setFalseValue(FalseVal);

   
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("testModule", Context);
  generateTestCode(M);
  return 0;
}
