#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyLibCalls.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::abs, {Arg->getType()}), {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind while CallInst is not");

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::abs) {
            errs() << "Intrinsic: abs\n";
        }
    }

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(CI);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    std::unique_ptr<TargetLibraryInfo> TLIM = std::make_unique<TargetLibraryInfo>();
    legacy::PassManager Passes;
    Passes.add(TLIM.get());
    Passes.run(*Module);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 5);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::ctpop, {TrueVal->getType()}), {TrueVal}, "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CI->getContext(), CI->isTrueUndef(), TrueVal, FalseVal, "select", BB);

     
    SI->setCondition(ICmpInst::make(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, SI->getTrueValue(), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)));

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(SI);
    assert(!SI->use_empty() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");

     
    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &F->getArgumentList().front();
    
     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, FunctionCallee("test_func", FuncTy), {Arg}, "", BB);
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *MemCpyCall = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {Arg}, "", BB);
    
     
    MemCpyCall->addUse(*CI);
    
     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(TrueVal, "", BB);
    ICmpInst *Cmp = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(Cmp, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    SI->setCondition(Cmp);
    SI->setTrueValue(TrueVal);
    SI->setFalseValue(FalseVal);
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Callee, {}, "", BB);
    CI->setCallingConv(CallingConv::C);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setOnlyRetUnsignedIntrinsicCall();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Instruction::AnyMem, {}, "", BB);
    II->setCalledFunction(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic);

     
    if (auto *AMII = dyn_cast<AtomicRMWInst>(II)) {
        AMRI->setAlignment(MaybeAlign(0));
    } else if (auto *AMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        AMI->setAlignment(MaybeAlign(0));
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(!CB.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     

    return 0;
}

        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;

        std::cout << "Function contains the CallInst and has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function does not contain the CallInst or has no uses." << std::endl;
    }

        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;

        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;

        std::cout << "CallInst is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Type *FloatTy = Type::getFloatTy(Context);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(FloatTy, 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(FloatTy, -1.0);

     
    Value *X = ConstantFP::get(FloatTy, 3.5);
    Instruction *FAbs = BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(X, "", BB);
    FAbs->insertBefore(BB->getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    Value *CTPop = InstCombine工(BinaryOperator::CreateAnd(FAbs, ConstantInt::get(FloatTy, 1)), "", BB);
    CTPop->insertBefore(BB->getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    Instruction *CondInst = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, X, ConstantInt::get(FloatTy, 2), "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondInst, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    SI->insertBefore(BB->getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    if (auto *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(SI)) {
        if (!CI->use_empty()) {
            std::cout << "SelectInst created successfully with specific conditions." << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "SelectInst has no uses, which is not desired." << std::endl;
        }
    } else {
        std::cout << "The instruction is not a SelectInst or was not created correctly." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setReturnValueFlag(true);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Arg);  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
         
        auto *AnyMem = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        AnyMem->setLength(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0));

         
        if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
             
            Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(1.0f));
            Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(-1.0f));
            SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

             
            assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
            Value *CondVal = SI->getCondition();
            Type *SelType = SI->getType();

             
            assert(CondVal && SelType && "Invalid SelectInst values or types");

             
            SI->eraseFromParent();
        }
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, { Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1) }, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    Arg->addUse(CI);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is a valid intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    F->addUse(CI->getType(), CI);

     
    assert(!F->isDeclaration() && "Function should not be external");
    assert(F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function should have NoUnwind attribute");

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *operand = CI->getOperand(0);
    if (!operand->getType()->isVectorTy()) {
        std::cout << "Last operand's type is not a vector type." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Last operand's type is a vector type." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->print(llvm::outs());
    M.print(llvm::outs());

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, AttributeKind::Returned, Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        outs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }
    
     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
            outs() << "Handling memcpy intrinsic.\n";
        } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
            outs() << "Handling memset intrinsic.\n";
        }
    }
    
     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && !CI->doesNotThrow() && "Function or CallInst should be marked as nounwind");
    
    return 0;
}

void generateTestModule(LLVMContext &Ctx) {
    Module *Mod = new Module("test", Ctx);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Ctx), {Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    assert(!CI.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "Must be AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomicrmw) {
         
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0);
        assert(NumBytes && "Length must be non-positive for atomic intrinsics");
    }

     
    Mod->print(errs(), nullptr);
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    generateTestModule(Ctx);
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
 
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());
    
     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setName("arg");
    
     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }
    
     
    Value* TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
    Value* FalseVal = BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(BinaryOperator::CreateFABS(Arg), "", BB);
    ICmpInst* Cmp = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst* SI = new SelectInst(Cmp, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    if (SI->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        errs() << "SelectInst type is an integer type.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "SelectInst type is not an integer type.\n";
    }
    
     
     
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IRBuilder.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void simplifyAndIntrinsic(Function &F) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = F.getContext();
    IRBuilder<> Builder(&F.getEntryBlock(), F.begin());

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::not_intrinsic;  
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Builder.getInt32Ty(), {}, false);
    Function *IntrinsicFunc = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&F, IntrID, FTy);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(IntrinsicFunc, {});

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must have at least one use." << std::endl;
        return;
    }

     
    if (F.doesNotThrow() || CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function or CallInst must be marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return;
    }

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must be an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return;
    }

     
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Builder.getInt32Ty(), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "simplifyAndIntrinsic", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    simplifyAndIntrinsic(*F);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createFunction() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("testModule", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", M);
    return F;
}

 
Instruction *createMemoryIntrinsic() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("testModule", Context);
    Function *F = createFunction();
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memset), {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, "", BB);
    return CI;
}

 
Value *createSelectInst() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("testModule", Context);
    Function *F = createFunction();
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Builder.getInt32(2), TrueVal);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    return SI;
}

int main() {
    try {
        Function *F = createFunction();
        Instruction *CI = createMemoryIntrinsic();
        Value *SI = createSelectInst();

        if (CI->use_empty()) {
            std::cerr << "Error: Memory intrinsic does not have any uses." << std::endl;
            return 1;
        }

         
        Function *func = CI->getFunction();
        if (!func->doesNotThrow()) {
            std::cerr << "Error: Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
            return 1;
        }

         
        IntrinsicInst *MI = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (!MI || MI->getIntrinsicID() != Intrinsic::memset) {
            std::cerr << "Error: The instruction is not a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
            return 1;
        }

         
        std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName().str() << std::endl;
        std::cout << "Memory Intrinsic: " << *CI << std::endl;
        std::cout << "SelectInst: " << *SI << std::endl;

    } catch (const std::exception &e) {
        std::cerr << "Exception: " << e.what() << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"

#include "llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h"

using namespace llvm;

 
void createTestModule(LLVMContext &Ctx) {
     
    Module *M = new Module("test", Ctx);

     
    std::vector<Type *> FuncTyArgs;
    FuncTyArgs.push_back(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx));
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Ctx), FuncTyArgs, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    Value *Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {Zero}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 2);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CI, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Select type must be integer");

     
    delete SI;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    createTestModule(Ctx);
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/KnownBits.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar/LoopUnrollPass.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CFG.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool satisfiesConstraints(CallInst &CI, Function &F) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;

     
    if (!F.doesNotThrow()) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) return false;
    auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (!II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) return false;

     
    if (II->getNumOperands() > 0) {
        Value *Op = II->getOperand(0);
        if (Op->getType()->isVectorTy()) {
            uint64_t NumBytes = cast<FixedVectorType>(Op->getType())->getNumElements();
            if (NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % Op->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() != 0) return false;
        }
    }

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F.arg_begin();
    for (; AI != F.arg_end(); ++AI) {
        if (AI->hasRetAttr()) break;
    }
    if (AI == F.arg_end()) return false;

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) return false;

     
    auto *CB = cast<CallBase>(&CI);
    auto IP = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    if (IP.getPositionKind() != IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT) return false;

     
    auto *FPtr = IP.getAnchorScope();
    if (!FPtr) return false;

     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    if (E->Scalars.size() == 0) return false;

     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry *, Type *> MinBWs;
    auto MI = MinBWs.find(E);
    if (MI != MinBWs.end() && !MI->second->isIntegerTy()) return false;

     
    if (E->State != TreeEntry::SplitVectorize || E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() != 2) return false;

     
    Value *CondVal = nullptr, *TrueVal = nullptr, *FalseVal = nullptr;
    Type *SelType = nullptr;
    if (!CondVal || !TrueVal || !FalseVal || !SelType) return false;

     
    if (isa<ConstantInt>(CondVal) && CondVal->getBitWidth() == 1 && TrueVal->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        Value *fabsX = nullptr;  
        auto *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(fabsX);
        if (!CI || CI->use_empty()) return false;
    }

     
    Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
    if (!(CondType->isIntegerTy() || (CondType->isVectorTy() && CondType == SelType))) return false;

     
    Value *Op = E->getOperand(1)->back();
    if (Op->getType()->isVectorTy()) return false;

     
    Type *ScalarTy = nullptr;  
    if (!isValidElementType(ScalarTy)) return false;

     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end() && !MinBWs[E]->isIntegerTy()) return false;

     
    Instruction *I = nullptr;  
    if (!isa<FNegInst>(I)) return false;
    auto *fabsX = dyn_cast<CallInst>(I->getOperand(0));
    if (!fabsX || fabsX->use_empty()) return false;

     
    KnownBits Known;
    if (Known.count() != 0) return false;

     
    if (!isFPClassTest(DemandedMask)) return false;

     
    DenseMap<BasicBlock *, Schedule *> BlocksSchedules;
    if (BlocksSchedules.empty()) return false;

     
    if (!VectorizableTree.contains(E)) return false;

     
    Instruction *ReductionRoot = nullptr;  
    if (!ReductionRoot->getParent()) return false;

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    UnrollOption ULO;
    if (!L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch() || ULO.Count <= 0) return false;

     
    if (L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) return false;

     
    TreeEntry *TE = nullptr;  
    if (TE->Idx == 0 || TE->UserTreeIndex == UINT_MAX) return false;

     
    Value *VL = nullptr, *Mask = nullptr;  
    uint64_t SliceSize = 0, Part = 0;
    if (!VL || !Mask || SliceSize == 0 || Part == 0) return false;

    return true;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Args[1] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42) };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, Args, "", BB);
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));
    }
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID MemIntr = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *MemCI = CallInst::CreateMalloc(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 10), MemIntr, {}, CI);
    
     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    }
    
     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(0.0));
    ICmpInst *Cmp = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(Cmp, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    if (!SI->hasOneUse() || !SI->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        SI->setOperand(0, CI);
        SI->setOperand(1, TrueVal);
        SI->setOperand(2, FalseVal);
    }
    
     
    F->print(errs());
    BB->print(errs());
    CI->print(errs());
    MemCI->print(errs());
    SI->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->getArg(0);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1)}, "call", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgNo());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    Value *Ptr1 = ConstantExpr::getBitCast(CI, Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context));
    Value *Ptr2 = ConstantExpr::getBitCast(CI, Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context));
    CallInst *IntrCall = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), Ptr1, Ptr2, CI->getNumOperands(), "", BB);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(IntrCall)) {
        std::cout << "Intrinsic call created successfully." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Failed to create an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
     

     

    return 0;
}

        I.simplify();
    }

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyIndVar.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool testFunction(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

   
  Value *Callee = nullptr;
  std::vector<Value *> Args;
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, Args, "", BB);

   
  if (CI->use_empty()) {
    return false;  
  }

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->setNoUnwind();

   
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
    switch (II->getIntrinsicID()) {
      case Intrinsic::memcpy:
      case Intrinsic::memmove:
      case Intrinsic::memset:
         
        if (atomic_load(const_cast<Value *>(CI->getOperand(0))) != AtomicOrdering::Unordered) {
          return false;  
        }
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  } else {
    return false;  
  }

   

  std::cout << "Test function setup completed." << std::endl;
  return true;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *MI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, ID), {CI}, "", BB);

    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: The instruction is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test program generated successfully!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
             
            assert(CI->getFunction()->isNounwind());
            assert(!CI->doesNotThrow());
            assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI));
            assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy);
        }
    }

     

    return 0;
}

However, I can help you understand what these constraints mean in practical terms:

These constraints are part of a larger set of requirements for generating test cases or code snippets where certain behaviors must be met. They include various conditions that need to be checked before and during the execution of functions involving `CallInst`, intrinsic calls, and other instructions. Here's a breakdown of what they mean in practical terms:

1. **Use of Instruction (`!CI.use_empty()`)**: This means that the instruction (`CI`) must have at least one user so that it can be simplified or updated in some way. This is crucial for testing the simplification logic within functions.

2. **Function Marking (`nounwind` and `doesNotThrow()`):** The function containing the call instruction should not throw exceptions, and it should be marked as `nounwind`. This ensures that no unexpected exceptions disrupt the intended behavior being tested.

3. **Intrinsic Call (`AnyMemIntrinsic`)**: The call instruction must be an intrinsic call, specifically handling memory operations like atomic loads or stores. It should also handle cases where the length is zero (for undefined behaviors) and when it involves unordered memory operations.

4. **Argument with `returned` Attribute**: For certain intrinsic calls, especially those involving memory operations, the function must have at least one argument marked as `returned`. This is necessary for specific initialization or handling logic within the function.

5. **Context Instruction (`CallBase`)**: The context instruction should be a call-like instruction that can be cast to `CallBase` for further processing. This ensures compatibility with certain functions and checks involving call sites.

6. **IRPosition and IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT**: These refer to positions in the intermediate representation (IR) where specific operations occur. The code should handle these positions appropriately, potentially updating or simplifying operations based on their context.

7. **TreeEntry and Scalar Type Handling**: For vectorization and other transformations, certain entries (`TreeEntry`) must be processed with valid scalar types derived from vector lengths. This includes handling cases where the type needs to be adjusted due to specific conditions like unrolled loops or reduction roots.

8. **SelectInst and Folding Pattern**: The `SelectInst` should not be simplified and should follow a particular pattern involving comparisons and arithmetic operations that cannot be folded easily. This ensures that more complex patterns are handled correctly by the code.

9. **Loop Conditions and Unrolling**: Loops must meet specific conditions to ensure they can be safely cloned or unrolled, such as having valid preheader and latch blocks, being safe to clone, not having their address taken, and having a count greater than zero for unrolling.

10. **Type Consistency and Bit Widths**: Throughout the function, type consistency and bit width handling must be maintained, especially in cases where undefined behaviors are handled or when specific operations require particular scalar types derived from vector lengths.

These constraints are part of a larger framework for code generation that ensures certain logical paths within functions are covered during testing. They do not directly translate into executable C++ code but rather define the scope and behavior expected from such a program.

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::abs, {Arg->getType()}), {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    F->setHasNoThrow(true);

     
    Builder.CreateAdd(CI, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1));

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    assert(F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind) && !CI->doesNotThrow() && "Function should be marked as nounwind and CallInst should not throw");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::abs && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateFNeg(Builder.CreateFAbs(TrueVal));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
    Value *CondVal = SI->getCondition();
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType->isIntegerTy() && "Selection type must be an integer type");
    
     
    assert(isa<ConstantInt>(TrueVal) && isa<ConstantInt>(FalseVal) && "TrueVal and FalseVal must be constant integers");
    assert(isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal) && cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal)->getOperand(0) == TrueVal && cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal)->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && "Condition must be an icmp ult comparison of TrueVal with 2");

     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test_module", Context);

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::sqrt, {}, "", BB);
  CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

   
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

   
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");
  } else {
    std::cerr << "Not an intrinsic call!" << std::endl;
    return 1;
  }

   
  legacy::PassManager PM;
  PM.add(createSimplificationPass());
  PM.run(*M.get());

  std::cout << "Module after simplification:" << std::endl;
  M.print(outs(), nullptr);

  return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>

#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/Debug.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &module);
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);

     
    Value *arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(funcType, Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, Intrinsic::abs), {arg}, "", entryBB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *anyMemCI = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(anyMemCI && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(anyMemCI) && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    BasicBlock *loopHeader = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);
    BranchInst::Create(loopHeader, entryBB);
    LoopInfo pass(*func);
    Loop *L = &pass.getLoopsInPreorder()[0];
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop must have a preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have a latch block");

     
    UnrollOptions UO;
    UO.Count = 2;
    LoopUnrollPass *unrollPass = new LoopUnrollPass();
    unrollPass->doInitialization(L, ScalarEvolution(), &module);
    unrollPass->runOnLoop(L, UO);

     
    Instruction *ctxI = CI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(ctxI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
    func->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    Value *trueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *falseVal = ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, CmpInst::ICMP_ULT, trueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "", entryBB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(falseVal, trueVal, falseVal, "", entryBB);
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type must be integer");

     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

     
    FPClassTest demandedMask;
    FPC_FMA | FPC_NAN;
    assert(demandedMask.isValid() && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");

     
    Instruction *reductionRoot = BinaryOperator::CreateNeg(UnaryOperator::CreateFABS(arg), "", entryBB);
    assert(reductionRoot->getParent() && "Reduction root instruction must have a parent block");

     
    legacy::PassManager PM;
    PM.add(createPrintModulePass(errs(), "After Optimizations"));
    PM.run(*func);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("my_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    std::vector<Value*> Args = { Arg1 };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, Args, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), "", BB);

     
    if (!IntrCI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must have at least one use to be simplified.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     

     
     
     

     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;  
    if (ULO.Count <= 0) {
        std::cerr << "Unroll count must be greater than zero.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test case generated successfully!\n";
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

 
void printEvenNumbers(int n) {
    std::vector<int> evenNumbers;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            evenNumbers.push_back(i);
        }
    }
     
    std::cout << "Even numbers up to " << n << ": ";
    for (int num : evenNumbers) {
        std::cout << num << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;
}

 
void greet(const std::string& name) {
    if (!name.empty()) {
        std::cout << "Hello, " << name << "!" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Hello, World!" << std::endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    int number = 20;  
    printEvenNumbers(number);
    
    std::string userName = "Alice";  
    greet(userName);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    Function *TestFunc = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *EntryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", TestFunc);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(EntryBB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Arg, "", EntryBB);

     
    Use &U = CI->use_begin();
    if (!U.getUser()->isTerminator()) {
        U.getUser()->replaceUsesOfWith(CI, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42));
    }

     
    TestFunc->setDoesNotThrow();
    TestFunc->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    if (IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (AnyMemIntrinsic *AMIntrin = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
            errs() << "Detected AnyMemIntrinsic: " << AMIntrin->getIntrinsicID() << "\n";
        }
    }

     
    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    std::vector<Value*> Args;
    Args.push_back(Arg);
    CallBase* CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, Callee, Args, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst* IIC = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(IIC && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic* AMI = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(IIC);
    assert(AMI && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");

     

     
    Value* TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value* FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2);
    SelectInst* SI = SelectInst::Create(ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI && "SelectInst creation failed");

     

     
    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || (NumBytes % sizeof(uint8_t) != 0) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::CreateNUWNSW(Instruction::Cast, TrueVal, Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "", BB);  
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
    Value *CondVal = SI->getCondition();
    ICmpInst *ICmp = dyn_cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal);
    assert(ICmp && ICmp->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && "Condition must be an 'ult' icmp");
    Value *TrueVal2 = SI->getTrueValue();
    Value *FalseVal2 = SI->getFalseValue();
    assert(TrueVal2 && FalseVal2 && "TrueVal and FalseVal must be valid values");
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType && "SelectInst type must be correctly retrievable");

     
     

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = F->getArg(0);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    std::vector<Value *> Args = {ConstantExpr::getIntToPtr(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)), ConstantExpr::getIntToPtr(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMIntr = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMIntr && "Expected a memory intrinsic");

     
    uint64_t NumBytes = AMIntr->getNumElements() * 2;  
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || (NumBytes % 2 != 0) && "Expected non-positive length or not a multiple of element size");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase instruction");

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst in function: " << CI->getFunction()->getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Is nounwind: " << (F->doesNotThrow() ? "Yes" : "No") << "\n";
    std::cout << "Intrinsic ID: " << IntrID << "\n";
    std::cout << "Number of arguments: " << CI->getNumOperands() << "\n";

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    F->addArgAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    IntrinsicInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::memset, {}, "", BB);
    CI->setOperand(0, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0));
    CI->setOperand(1, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt64Ty(Context), 8));
    CI->setOperand(2, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1));

     
    BB->push_back(CI);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        assert(!II->isZeroLength() && "Expected non-zero length operation");
    } else {
        errs() << "Expected an intrinsic call\n";
        return 1;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createTestModule(LLVMContext &context, Module *module) {
   
  FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(context), {}, false);
  Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", module);

   
  BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(context, "", func);

   
  Intrinsic::ID intrinsicID = Intrinsic::abs;  
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(module, intrinsicID), {}, "", bb);

   
  CI->addUse(func->arg_begin());

   
  func->setDoesNotThrow();
  func->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

   
  if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
    outs() << "The CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
  } else {
    outs() << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
  }
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext context;
  Module module("testModule", context);

  createTestModule(context, &module);

  return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrId = CI->getIntrinsicID();
    if (IntrId == Intrinsic::memset || IntrId == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
        std::cout << "CI is a valid memory intrinsic" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CI is not a recognized memory intrinsic" << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (IntrId == Intrinsic::atomic_load || IntrId == Intrinsic::atomic_store) {
        Value *Length = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
        CI->setArgOperand(2, Length);  
    }

     
    if (CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CI is a CallBase" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CI is not a CallBase" << std::endl;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("input");

    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;

    F->setDoesNotThrow();

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setParamAttribute(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI;
    if (Intrinsic::isAnyMaxOrRetMinIntrinsic(F->getIntrinsicID())) {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, F->getIntrinsicID()), {Arg}, "", BB);
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Unsupported intrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Use &U = CI->getOperandUse(0);
    Value *UserVal = U.getUser();
    if (!UserVal) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any user." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::Global);
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->setSubprogram(nullptr);
    F->setPersonalityFn(nullptr);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    FunctionType *AnyMemIntrinsicTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {PointerType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, true);
    Intrinsic::ID AnyMemIntrinsicID = Intrinsic::experimental_memcpy;  
    CallInst *IntrinsicCI = CallInst::Create(AnyMemIntrinsicTy, Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, AnyMemIntrinsicID), {}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrinsicCI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    BB->insert(BB->begin(), IntrinsicCI);

     
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->setOperand(0, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1));
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::anymemset), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(123);  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMIntr = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMIntr && "Expected a memory intrinsic");

     
    Value *NumBytes = AMIntr->getArgOperand(1);
    if (isa<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)) {
        int64_t Val = cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().getLimitedValue();
        assert(Val <= 0 || !isMultipleOfMinimuTypeWidth(Val, F->getParent()->getDataLayout()) && "Expected non-positive length or not a multiple of element size");
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase instruction");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*F, 0);
    assert(Pos.getPositionKind() == IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "Expected IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     
    bool updated = false;
    if (CB) {
        simplifiedCalleeInfo calleeInfo = simplifyCall(CI);
        if (!calleeInfo.isNull()) {
            CB->setCalledOperand(calleeInfo.calleeReplacement);
            updated = true;
        }
    }

     
    outs() << (updated ? "CallInst simplified and updated\n" : "No simplification performed\n");

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID ID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
        assert(ID == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call of type AnyMemIntrinsic");
    } else {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Arg->getType(), Arg->getType()}, {Arg, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        
         
        if (AtomicOrdering AO = MemoryAtomic) {
            uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
            if (NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultiple(NumBytes, F->arg_begin()->getType()->getPrimitiveSizeInBits())) {
                std::cout << "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic conditions are met." << std::endl;
                
                 
                if (CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
                    std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase instance." << std::endl;
                    
                     
                    if (IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0)) {
                        std::cout << "IRPosition is correctly set." << std::endl;
                        
                         
                        Function *Funct = Pos.getFunction();
                        if (Funct) {
                            std::cout << "Associated function exists." << std::endl;
                            
                             
                            TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
                            assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry does not have a non-empty Scalars list");
                            
                             
                            if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
                                std::cout << "MinBWs map entry for E is valid." << std::endl;
                                
                                 
                                if (E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize && E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2) {
                                    std::cout << "TreeEntry split vectorization conditions are met." << std::endl;
                                    
                                     
                                    if (!E->isGather() && E->getOpcode() != Instruction::InsertElement) {
                                        std::cout << "Split vectorization path is taken." << std::endl;
                                        
                                         
                                        Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
                                        Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(0.0));
                                        Value *FalseVal = CallInst::CreateFNeg(CallInst::CreateFAbs(CI->getOperand(0)), "", BB);
                                        SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
                                        
                                         
                                        if (SI && SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && SI->getCondition()->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
                                            std::cout << "SelectInst meets specific folding pattern and type constraints." << std::endl;
                                            
                                             
                                            const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
                                            unsigned Depth = 5;  
                                            assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth exceeds limit");
                                            
                                             
                                            FPClassTest DemandedMask = FPClassTest::Zero;  
                                            KnownFPClass Known = KnownFPClass::Zero;  
                                            assert(DemandedMask.getBitWidth() == Known.getBitWidth() && "Demanded mask and known FP class do not match in bit width");
                                            
                                             
                                            Loop *L = nullptr;  
                                            assert(L->isSafeToClone() && !L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop is not safe to clone or has address taken");
                                            
                                             
                                            LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
                                            ULO.Count = 2;  
                                            assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count is not greater than zero");
                                            
                                             
                                            Instruction *I = CI;  
                                            assert(I->getType()->isIntegerTy() && I->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() == DemandedMask.getBitWidth() && "Instruction type or bit width does not meet constraints");
                                            
                                            std::cout << "All constraints are satisfied." << std::endl;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &module);

     
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);
    IRBuilder<> builder(entryBB);

     
    AllocationInst *alloca = new AllocaInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, "argAlloca", entryBB);
    Value *argValue = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 42));
    new StoreInst(argValue, alloca, entryBB);

     
    LoadInst *load = new LoadInst(alloca, "loadedArg", false, entryBB);

     
    CallInst *call = CallInst::Create(funcType, func, { load }, "", entryBB);

     
    assert(!call->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    func->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *intrinsic = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(call);
    assert(intrinsic && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(intrinsic) && "Intrinsic must be AnyMemIntrinsic");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createFunctionWithCallInst() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &module);
    BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);

     
    Intrinsic::ID intrinID = Intrinsic::memset;  
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, intrinID), {}, "", bb);

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();

    return func;
}

 
void createSelectInstWithConditions(BasicBlock *bb) {
    Value *trueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(bb->getContext()), APInt(32, 1));
    Value *falseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(bb->getContext()), APInt(32, 2));
    Value *condVal = ICmpInst::Create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, trueVal, falseVal, "", bb);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(condVal, trueVal, falseVal, "", bb);
}

int main() {
    Function *func = createFunctionWithCallInst();
    if (func) {
        std::cout << "Function created successfully with CallInst.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Failed to create function with CallInst.\n";
    }

     
    if (func->getBasicBlockList().begin() != func->getBasicBlockList().end()) {
        BasicBlock *bb = &*(func->getBasicBlockList().begin());
        createSelectInstWithConditions(bb);
        std::cout << "Added SelectInst with conditions in the function.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Failed to add SelectInst, no basic block found.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createCallInst(Function &F, Module &M) {
     
    Intrinsic::ID intrinsicType = Intrinsic::pow;
    std::vector<Value *> args;
    args.push_back(ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(M.getContext()), 2.0));
    args.push_back(ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(M.getContext()), 3.0));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, intrinsicType), args, "", F.getEntryBlock().getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    CI->addUse(F.arg_begin());
}

 
bool checkCallInstConstraints(CallInst &CI) {
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;  

    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow() || func->isNounwind()) return false;  

    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) return false;  

     
    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function &F = *Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", M);

     
    createCallInst(F, M);

     
    for (auto &BB : F) {
        for (auto &I : BB) {
            if (CallInst *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(&I)) {
                if (checkCallInstConstraints(*CI)) {
                    errs() << "All constraints satisfied!\n";
                    return 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    errs() << "Not all constraints satisfied.\n";
    return 1;
}

void createTestModule(LLVMContext &Ctx, Module *M) {
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memset;
    auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    auto *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic.");

     
    unsigned NumBytes = 0;
    if (ID == Intrinsic::atomicrmw || ID == Intrinsic::cmpxchg) {
        NumBytes = -1;  
    }

     
    Argument *Arg = F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Return);
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("testModule", Ctx);
    createTestModule(Ctx, &M);

     
    legacy::PassManager PM;
    PM.add(createPrintModulePass([](raw_ostream &OS, const Module *M) {
        OS << *M;
        return false;
    }));
    PM.run(M);

    return 0;
}

void createTestFunction(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::sqrt, {Type::getFloatTy(Ctx)}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    assert(CI->getType()->isFloatTy() && "Intrinsic call must be of float type");
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "Intrinsic call should not be marked as doesNotThrow");
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("testModule", Context);

    createTestFunction(M);

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &errs())) {
        errs() << "Module verification failed.\n";
        return 1;
    } else {
        outs() << "Module verified successfully.\n";
        return 0;
    }
}
