int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {nullptr}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), IntrID), {nullptr, nullptr}, "", BB);
    
     
    if (auto *MI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(IntrCI)) {
        MI->setVolatile(false);
        MI->setUnordered(true);
        MI->setLength(16);  
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(IntrCI);
    
     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    if (auto Result = simplifyCall(Pos)) {
        std::cout << "Simplification successful\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Simplification failed\n";
    }
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    
     
    F->getBasicBlockList().push_back(new BasicBlock("entry", F));
    IRBuilder<> Builder(F->getEntryBlock());
    
     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), { Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)) }, "", Builder.GetInsertBlock());
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst has no uses, which is required for simplification.\n";
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
        auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
            std::cout << "It's a memset intrinsic.\n";
            
             
            uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
            if (NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes)) {
                std::cout << "Condition met: non-positive length or not a multiple of element size.\n";
            } else {
                std::cerr << "No valid condition found for memset intrinsic.\n";
                return 1;
            }
        }
    } else {
        std::cerr << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    M.print(llvm::outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/InstrTypes.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);

     
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB->getTerminator());

     
    Instruction *SelectI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(SelectI);

     
    SelectI->addUse(SelectI->getType());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(SelectI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::experimental_vector_reduce_fadd) {
            std::cerr << "Valid vector reduce intrinsic detected." << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cerr << "Not a valid vector reduce intrinsic." << std::endl;
        }
    } else {
        std::cerr << "SelectInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Value::use_empty());  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    unsigned NumBytes = AMII->getNumElements();  
    assert(!NumBytes || (NumBytes % 2 == 0) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of element size");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), false);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType->isIntegerTy() && "Select type must be integer");

     

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, Arg, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(CI->getType());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindPredecessor(&*F->begin()->getFirstInsertionBlock(), BB);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemset) {
         
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemcpy) {
         
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anyread || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anywrite) {
         
    }

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be a memcpy intrinsic");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI->getType(), CI, ConstantInt::get(CI->getType(), 2), "", BB);

    assert(SI->getCondition()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Condition type must be integer");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "True value type must be integer");
    assert(SI->getFalseValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "False value type must be integer");

     
    assert(!isa<SimplifyableSelectInst>(SI) || !"SelectInst should not be simplifiable at this point");

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/PassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

void createCallInst(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &C = M.getContext();

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "exampleFunc", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(C, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(C));

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {
             
            F->setDoesNotThrow();

             
            if (auto *AMII = dyn_cast<AtomicRMWInst>(CI)) {
                Value *Ptr = AMII->getPointerOperand();
                Type *Ty = Ptr->getType();
                unsigned NumBytes = 0;  
                if (NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes, Ty->getScalarType()->getPrimitiveSizeInBits())) {
                     
                    std::cerr << "Handling undefined behavior for atomic unordered memory intrinsic" << std::endl;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M(Context);

    createCallInst(M);

     
    M.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setReturnValue(true);

     
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memcpy.p0i8.p0i8.i32", FTy);
    std::vector<Value *> Args = { ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4) };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

     
    IntrinsicInst *Intr = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(Intr && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AnyMI = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(Intr);
    assert(AnyMI && "Expected a memory intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Expected a call base instruction");
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB);
    assert(!Pos.isNull() && "IRPosition should not be null");

     
     
    Function *Func = F;
    if (Func) {
         
    }

     
    M.print(llvm::outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &Mod);
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value* Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(FT, F->getName(), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) return -1;

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) return -1;
    IntrinsicInst* IIC = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (IIC->getIntrinsicID() != Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) return -1;

     
    legacy::PassManager Passes;
    Passes.add(createInstructionCombiningPass());
    Passes.run(*F);

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) return -1;
    CallBase* CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);

     
    SimplifyQuery SQ(Simplification::AllowRedundantBackwardTransformations);
    Value* SimplifiedCB = simplifyCall(CB, SQ);
    if (SimplifiedCB != nullptr) {
        CB->replaceAllUsesWith(SimplifiedCB);
    }

     
    Mod.print(outs(),  false);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Verifier.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), { Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1) });
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "Specific intrinsic must be used");

     
    std::string Error;
    raw_fd_ostream OS("output.ll", Error);
    if (Error.empty()) {
        ModulePassManager MPM;
        MPM.addPass(PrintModulePass(OS));
        MPM.run(*M);
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Failed to write IR to output: " << Error << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 4)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMIntr = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMIntr && "The intrinsic call must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || (NumBytes % 8 != 0) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB);
    assert(Pos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = cast<Function>(M.getOrInsertFunction("foo", FTy));

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", F);

     
    Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getName(), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    if (!isa<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Expected an intrinsic call, but got a different instruction." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II->isAnyMemory()) {
        std::cerr << "Expected an AnyMemIntrinsic, but got a different intrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    M.print(llvm::outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Use.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->getArg(0);
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, AttributeSet::ReturnIndex, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Constant::getInt32(Type::getInt32Ty(Context)), Constant::getInt32(Type::getInt32Ty(Context))});
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    BB->getInstList().push_back(CI);

     
    Use &U = F->arg_begin()->use_begin();
    assert(!U.getUser()->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow(true);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    IntrinsicInst *AII = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(AII && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(AII);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    Value *Simplified;
    bool SimplifiedSuccess = simplifyCallInst(*CI, Simplified);

     
    assert(SimplifiedSuccess && "simplifyCallInst must be successful");

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    Argument* Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value* VecVal = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    ConstantInt* Index = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Instruction* InsertInst = new InsertElementInst(VecVal, Arg, Index, "", BB);

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(InsertInst, "", BB);
    assert(!CI.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst* II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::memcpy, CI, 0, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "Intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createIntrinsicCall(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    Function *F = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::your_intrinsic, {});
    if (!F) return;  

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "entry", Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Ctx), {}, false), Function::ExternalLinkage));
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(F, {});
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
         
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx), 0);  
        CI->setArgOperand(0, NumBytes);  
    } else if (dyn_cast<AtomicRMWInst>(CI) || dyn_cast<AtomicCmpXchgInst>(CI)) {
         
        Value *Ptr = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Ctx), 0);  
        CI->setArgOperand(0, Ptr);  
    }

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    if (AI != F->args().end()) {
        AI->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    }
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

    createIntrinsicCall(M);  

     
    M.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memset.p0i8.i32", 
        FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {PointerType::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false));
    Value *Ptr = Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt8Ty(Context));
    Value *Val = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {Ptr, Val}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->setCallingConv(CallingConv::C);

     
    IntrinsicInst *Intr = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(Intr && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    assert(Intr->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "Expected llvm.memset intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CallBaseInst = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CallBaseInst && "Expected a call base instruction");

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    Value* Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FT, F, makeArrayRef(Args), "", nullptr);
    CI->addUse(0);  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memcpy;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Args[] = {};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, FunctionCtor::get(&M, "test_func"), Args, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    Intrinsic::ID MemCpyIntrinsic = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *MemCI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, MemCpyIntrinsic), Args, "", BB);

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MemCI)) {
        errs() << "Error: Expected a memory intrinsic but got a different kind.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    Value *FalseVal = Constant::getAllOnesValue(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    if (!TrueVal || !FalseVal || !SI->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        errs() << "Error: Invalid operands or type for SelectInst.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->dump();
    CI->dump();
    MemCI->dump();
    SI->dump();

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>  
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>

int main() {
     
     
    Function *F = nullptr;  
    CallBase CI(nullptr, {}, "", F);  

    if (!CI.use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must have at least one use." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    if (F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) {
        std::cerr << "Function must be marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    if (CI.doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst itself must not be marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must be an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (!isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        std::cerr << "The intrinsic call must be an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;

#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createCallInst(Function &F) {
     
    Argument *Arg = F.addArg(Type::getInt32Ty(F.getContext()));

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(..., ..., ..., ...);
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F.doesNotThrow() && !CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function and CallInst satisfy nounwind constraints." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function or CallInst does not satisfy nounwind constraints." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        if (auto *AII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
             
            if (AII->getNumBytes() <= 0) {
                std::cout << "CallInst is an AnyMemIntrinsic with non-positive length." << std::endl;
            }
        }
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }
}

int main() {
     
    Function *F = new Function("myFunction", ...);
    
     
    createCallInst(*F);

    delete F;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "CI must be an intrinsic call");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "CI must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     

    std::cout << *M;
    delete M;
    return 0;
}

    Module Mod("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, {Arg}, "", BB);

    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_memory, {}, "", BB);

     
    II->setDoesNotThrow();
    II->setNoUnwind();

     
    Mod.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

void exampleFunction(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "example", M);
  F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

   
  Value *Vec = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 4));
  Vec = InsertElementInst::Create(Vec, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0), "", BB);

   
  CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), Vec, nullptr, "", BB);
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
  assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
  assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and a memory intrinsic");

   
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
      uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
      assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes, getScalarTypeByteWidth(Vec->getType())) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }
  }

   
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Builder.getInt64(1)}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst itself must not be nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*F, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have a position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     
    Function *Func = F;
    assert(Func && "Function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    int64_t numBytesValue = cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getSExtValue();
    assert(numBytesValue <= 0 || (numBytesValue % 16 != 0) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

    assert(Func && "Function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");

    Value* FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::ctpop), {TrueVal}, "", BB);
    Value* CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    Type* SelType = Type::getFloatTy(Context);
    SelectInst* SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be created successfully");

     
    assert(SI->getCondition() == CondVal && "Condition of SelectInst must match CondVal");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue() == TrueVal && "True value of SelectInst must match TrueVal");
    assert(SI->getFalseValue() == FalseVal && "False value of SelectInst must match FalseVal");
    assert(SI->getType() == SelType && "SelectInst type must match SelType");

     
    assert(isa<CallInst>(FalseVal) && "FalseVal must be a ctpop operation of TrueVal");
    assert(isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal) && "CondVal must be an icmp ult comparison of TrueVal with integer constant 2");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getDoubleTy(Context), true);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &module);

     
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);

     
    Value *arg1 = func->getArg(0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, Intrinsic::sqrt), arg1, "call", entryBB);

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::sqrt) {
        errs() << "CallInst is a valid intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call or not the correct intrinsic.\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }

     
    module.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

 
bool hasAtLeastOneUse(const std::vector<int>& uses) {
    return !uses.empty();
}

 
bool isValidFunctionCall(bool nounwind, bool doesNotThrow) {
    return nounwind && !doesNotThrow;
}

 
bool isAnyMemIntrinsic(const std::vector<int>& intrinsicTypes) {
     
    return !intrinsicTypes.empty();
}

 
int main() {
    std::vector<int> uses = {1};  
    std::vector<int> intrinsicTypes = {2};  
    bool nounwind = true;
    bool doesNotThrow = false;

    if (hasAtLeastOneUse(uses)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }

    if (isValidFunctionCall(nounwind, doesNotThrow)) {
        std::cout << "Function call is valid according to constraints." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function call does not meet the required constraints." << std::endl;
    }

    if (isAnyMemIntrinsic(intrinsicTypes)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    FunctionCallee Callee = M->getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memcpy.p0i8.p0i8.i32", FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {PointerType::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), PointerType::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false));
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, {ConstantExpr::getBitCast(Arg, PointerType::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0)), ConstantExpr::getBitCast(Arg, PointerType::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0)), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)});
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && !CI->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind while CallInst is not");
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    Value *ArgValue = CB->getArgOperand(0);
    assert(ArgValue && "IRPosition must have a non-null value");
    
     
    Function *Func = CI->getFunction();
    assert(Func && "Associated function must be non-null");
    
     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::Local);
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->setCallingConv(CallingConv::C);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *AII = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(AII && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    assert(AII->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "Expected anymemintrinsic intrinsic");

     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::sqrt, {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    Use &U = F->getEntryBlock().back().use_begin();
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(simplifyCall(CI));  
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Value::use_begin(), Value::use_end());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not throw." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst throws." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *EntryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    std::vector<Value *> Args{Arg};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Func->getFunctionType(), Func, Args, "", EntryBB);

     
    CI->addUse(CI->getType());

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::get(Intrinsic::any_mem, Args, "", EntryBB);
    assert(II && "Failed to create an intrinsic instruction");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");

     

    std::cout << "Test program completed successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    AllocaInst *Alloca = new AllocaInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, "arg", BB->getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    LoadInst *Load = new LoadInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Alloca, "", BB);
    StoreInst *Store = new StoreInst(Load, Alloca, BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Alloca}, "", BB);
    CI->setCalledFunction(F);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    LoadInst *Use = new LoadInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Alloca, "", BB);
    Use->setName("use");
    CI->addUse(Use);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, "Expected an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    bool Simplified = llvm::simplifyCall(CI);
    if (Simplified) {
        outs() << "Call instruction simplified successfully.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Failed to simplify call instruction.\n";
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/IRBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    Function *Callee = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&Mod, Intrinsic::memcpy);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Builder.getInt32Ty(), 0);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase instance." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is not a CallBase instance." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instruction.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Value.h"
#include "llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h"
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CI must have at least one use");
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "CI must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Not an intrinsic call!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test passed." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    Value *Args[] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1) };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Value::use_iterator());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    Value *MemArgs[] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0) };
    CallInst *AtomicCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::atomic_load), MemArgs, "", BB);

     
    AtomicCI->setOperand(1, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0));

     
    Loop *L = new LoopInfo().InsertionSet.GetLoopFor(BB);
    if (!L) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to create loop" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) {
        std::cerr << "Invalid loop structure" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    if (!CB) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to cast CallInst to CallBase" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    TreeEntry *E = new TreeEntry();
    E->State = TreeEntry::SplitVectorize;
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(std::make_pair(nullptr, 0));
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(std::make_pair(nullptr, 1));

     
    if (!L->isSafeToClone() || L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) {
        std::cerr << "Loop safety or address taken check failed" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(1.0));
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, TrueVal, "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ConstantInt::getTrue(Context), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    if (!SI->getCondition() || !SI->getTrueValue() || !SI->getFalseValue()) {
        std::cerr << "Invalid SelectInst operands" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Instruction *ReductionRoot = new Instruction(Instruction::FNeg, TrueVal, "", BB);

     
    if (!ReductionRoot->getParent()) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to create reduction root instruction" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    outs() << "All constraints satisfied\n";
    return 0;
}

        return 1;

    }

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool testFunction() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("testModule", Context);
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

   
  Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)};
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::abs), Args, "", BB);

   
  if (CI->use_empty()) return false;

   
  if (!F->doesNotThrow() || F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) return false;

   
  if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) return false;

   
   

  return true;
}

int main() {
  if (testFunction()) {
    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
  } else {
    std::cout << "Test failed." << std::endl;
  }
  return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Verifier.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value* Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    Function* IntrinFunc = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset, {Arg->getType()});
    std::vector<Value*> MemSetArgs = {ConstantExpr::getBitCast(Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt32Ty(Context)), PointerType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)), Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)};
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(IntrinFunc, MemSetArgs, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &errs())) {
        std::cerr << "Module verification failed.\n";
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "Test module successfully created with constraints.\n";
    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "foo", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst must have at least one use.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    int NumBytes = 0;  
    if (NumBytes > 0 && !isMultiple(NumBytes, getElementTypeSize(CI->getType()))) {
        errs() << "Atomic unordered memory intrinsics must have length non-positive or not a multiple of element size.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    if (AI == F->arg_end()) {
        errs() << "Function must have at least one argument with the returned attribute.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        errs() << "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
     

     
     

     

    errs() << "All constraints satisfied.\n";
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "foo", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Instruction *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::abs), {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindPredecessor(BB);

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::abs) {
             
            auto *NumBytes = II->getArgOperand(0);
            if (!NumBytes || !NumBytes->isZero()) {
                return 1;  
            }
        }
    } else {
        return 1;  
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);

     
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "The intrinsic call is a memory operation." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The intrinsic call is not a memory operation." << std::endl;

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)}, Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "The CallInst is an intrinsic.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic.\n";
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Function is marked as nounwind.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "CallInst does not throw.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst throws.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *ZeroVal = Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    Value *VecVal = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    VecVal = InsertElementInst::Create(VecVal, ZeroVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), "", BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), VecVal, ZeroVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    Use &U = *CI->user_begin();
    assert(!CI.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "Intrinsic must be memset");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

 
void exampleFunction(Value *arg) {
    std::cout << "Example function called with argument: " << arg->getName() << "\n";
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("testModule", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context), false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "exampleFunc", module);
    
     
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);
    
     
    Value *arg = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", entryBB);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(func, arg, "", entryBB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(CI->getType(), 1);
    
    std::cout << "CallInst created with type: " << CI->getType()->getDescription() << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createTestFunction(LLVMContext &context) {
    Module *module = new Module("test", context);
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(context), {}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", module);

     
    func->front().getParent()->setName("entry");

     
    IRBuilder<> builder(&func->front(), func->front().begin());
    Value *arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, arg, "", &func->front());

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "Must be AnyMemIntrinsic");

     

    return func;
}

    Module *module = new Module("test", context);
    Function *func = createTestFunction(context);

     
    module->print(outs(), nullptr);

    delete func;
    delete module;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    IRBuilder<> Builder(&M.getFunction("func")->getEntryBlock(), M.getFunction("func")->getEntryBlock().end());
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", &M.getFunction("func")->getEntryBlock().back());

     
    CI->addUse(0);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "foo", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {Arg}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    
     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {
            errs() << "CallInst is a memory intrinsic.\n";
            
             
            if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomicrmw || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::cmpxchg) {
                Type *Ty = CI->getType();
                uint64_t NumBytes = Ty->getPrimitiveSizeInBits() / 8;  
                if (NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultiple(NumBytes, getElementTypeByteWidth(Ty))) {
                    errs() << "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic with valid length.\n";
                }
            }
            
             
            Value *CtxI = CI;
            if (auto *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CtxI)) {
                errs() << "Context instruction is a CallBase instance.\n";
            }
        }
    }
    
     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    delete M;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

int main() {
     
    int n = 10;  
    std::vector<int> fib(n);
    if (n >= 1) fib[0] = 0;
    if (n >= 2) fib[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; ++i) {
        fib[i] = fib[i - 1] + fib[i - 2];
    }

     
    std::cout << "Fibonacci sequence: ";
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cout << fib[i] << " ";
    }
    std::cout << std::endl;

     
    bool conditionMet = true;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; ++i) {
        if ((fib[i - 1] + fib[i - 2]) != fib[i]) {
            conditionMet = false;
            break;
        }
    }

     
    std::cout << "Condition met: " << (conditionMet ? "Yes" : "No") << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

class TreeEntry {
public:
    enum State { SplitVectorize, Vectorize };
    std::vector<Value *> Scalars;
    int Idx;
    State State;
    std::optional<uint32_t> UserTreeIndex;
    bool isGather() const { return false; }  
    Value *getOperand(int) const { return nullptr; }  
};

class MinBWs {
public:
    std::optional<uint32_t> get(const TreeEntry &) const { return {}; }
};

class InstructionCost {
public:
    static constexpr int getInvalid() { return -1; }
};

class FPClassTest {
public:
    bool isValid() const { return true; }
};

class BlockBase;
class BasicBlock;
class Loop;
class UnrollLoopOptions;

}

void canonicalizeScalarSelectOfVecs(SelectInst *SI);

Value *createFNegFabsPattern(Value *x);
void vectorizeLoop(Loop *L, const UnrollLoopOptions &ULO, int Depth, FPClassTest DemandedMask, KnownBits Known, MinBWs minBWs, std::vector<TreeEntry> &VectorizableTree, BlockBase *ReductionRoot = nullptr, std::vector<std::pair<Value *, Value *>> VectorValuesAndScales = {});
void unrollLoop(Loop *L, const UnrollLoopOptions &ULO, int Depth, FPClassTest DemandedMask, KnownBits Known, MinBWs minBWs, std::vector<TreeEntry> &VectorizableTree);

int main() {
     
     
     

    std::vector<Value *> args;
    MinBWs minBWs;
    std::vector<TreeEntry> vectorizableTree;
    Loop *loop = nullptr;  
    UnrollLoopOptions unrollOpts;
    int depth = 0;
    FPClassTest demandedMask;
    KnownBits knownBits;

    initialize(args, minBWs);

     
    vectorizeLoop(loop, unrollOpts, depth, demandedMask, knownBits, minBWs, vectorizableTree);

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void checkAndSatisfyConstraints(CallInst &CI, SelectInst &SI) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) {
        errs() << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
        return;
    }

     
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Error: Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
        return;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (!II || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        errs() << "Error: CallInst is not a valid intrinsic or memory intrinsic.\n";
        return;
    }

     
    Value *CondVal = SI.getCondition();
    Value *TrueVal = SI.getTrueValue();
    Value *FalseVal = SI.getFalseValue();
    if (!CondVal || !isa<Value>(CondVal) || !TrueVal || !isa<Value>(TrueVal) || !FalseVal || !isa<Value>(FalseVal)) {
        errs() << "Error: SelectInst does not have valid values.\n";
        return;
    }

     
    Type *SelType = SI.getType();
    if (!SelType->isIntegerTy()) {
        errs() << "Error: SelectInst type is not integer.\n";
        return;
    }

     
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = nullptr;
    SelectInst *SI = nullptr;

    if (F->empty()) {
        errs() << "Error: Function has no basic blocks.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", BB);
    SI = new SelectInst(Builder.getInt1(true), Builder.getFNeg(Builder.getFAbs(Builder.createFAdd(...))), Builder.getFNeg(Builder.getFAbs(Builder.createFAdd(...))), "select_op", BB);

     
    checkAndSatisfyConstraints(*CI, *SI);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Passes/PassBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/Passes/PassPlugin.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void exampleFunction(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "example", M);
  F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Ctx), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Ctx), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx), 1)}, "", BB);

   
  CI->addUse(Value::use_begin(), Value::use_end());

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->setNoUnwind();

   
  CallInst *AnyMemCI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::any_mem, {}, "", BB);

   
  AnyMemCI->addUse(Value::use_begin(), Value::use_end());
  AnyMemCI->setDoesNotThrow();

   
  LoopInfo LI;
  auto *L = LI.getLoopFor(BB);

   
  if (!L || !L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) {
    return;
  }

   
  UnrollOptions ULO;
  ULO.Count = 2;
  if (!L->isSafeToClone() || L->hasAddressTaken() || ULO.Count <= 0) {
    return;
  }

   
  const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
  unsigned Depth = 5;
  if (Depth > MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth) {
    return;
  }

   
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M(Context);
  exampleFunction(M);
  return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg0 = &*F->arg_begin();
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), { Arg0 }, "", BB);
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    
     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    if (!CB) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    auto IRP = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB);
    if (IRP.getKind() != IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT) {
        std::cerr << "Error: IRPosition does not have the correct position kind." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (!IRP.getAnchorScope()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Function associated with IRPosition is null." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    
    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (II->isMemoryOp()) {
             
            AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
            if (!AMII->isZeroLength() && !AMII->isAtomic()) {
                 
                std::cout << "CallInst satisfies all constraints." << std::endl;
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

    IRBuilder<> Builder(&BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", F));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::sqrt), {}, "", Builder.GetInsertBlock());

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic or not specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not throw." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst throws." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
