[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
 
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkConstraints(CallInst &CI) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;

    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
     
    if (!func->doesNotThrow() || func->isNounwind()) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) return false;
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (!II->isAnyMemory()) return false;

     
    uint64_t NumBytes = II->getArgOperand(0)->getZExtValue();
    if (NumBytes > 0 && !(NumBytes % 16 == 0)) return false;  

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = func->arg_begin();
    for (auto &Arg : func->args()) {
        if (Arg.hasParamAttribute(0, Attribute::Returned)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool checkLoopConstraints(Loop *L) {
     
    if (!L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) return false;

     
    if (!L->isSafeToClone()) return false;

     
    if (L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) return false;

    return true;
}

bool checkSelectConstraints(SelectInst &SI) {
    Value *CondVal = SI.getCondition();
    Value *TrueVal = SI.getTrueValue();
    Value *FalseVal = SI.getFalseValue();
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();

     
    if (!CondVal || !TrueVal || !FalseVal || !SelType) return false;
    if (SelType != FalseVal->getType()) return false;

     
    if (!isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal) || !cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal)->isEquality()) return false;
    ICmpInst *Cmp = cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal);
    if (Cmp->getPredicate() != CICMP_ULT || Cmp->getOperand(0) != TrueVal || Cmp->getOperand(1)->getZExtValue() != 2) return false;

     
    Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
    if (!CondType->isIntegerTy() || !SelType->isVectorTy()) return false;

    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", Func);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), false);
    Value *Callee = Constant::getNullValue(PointerType::get(FTy, 0));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "", BB);

     
    if (checkConstraints(*CI)) {
        std::cout << "Constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Constraints not satisfied." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Loop *L = new Loop();
    if (checkLoopConstraints(L)) {
        std::cout << "Loop constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop constraints not satisfied." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

    if (checkSelectConstraints(*SI)) {
        std::cout << "Select constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Select constraints not satisfied." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Type *IntTy = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);

     
    Value *CondVal = Builder.CreateICmpULT(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1));
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateFNeg(Builder.CreateFAbs(ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(0.0))));
    SelectInst *SI = Builder.CreateSelect(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI && "Failed to create SelectInst");
    assert(SI->getType() == IntTy && "SelectInst type mismatch");
    assert(!SI->use_empty() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->hasFnAttribute("nounwind") && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(!SI.doesNotThrow() && "CallInst itself is not nounwind");

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), {SI}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
         
        CI = cast<CallInst>(simplifyCall(CI));
    }

     
    F->removeFnAttr("nounwind");
    F->addFnAttr("nounwind");

     

    return 0;
}

                if (UO.Count > 0) {
                     
                }
            }
        }
    }

     
    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);

    II->setArgOperandNoWrap(0, 1);  
    
     
     
    
     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    delete M;
    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test_module", Context);
    Function *mainFunc = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), Function::ExternalLinkage, "main", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", mainFunc);

     
    Intrinsic::ID intrinsicID = Intrinsic::abs;
    Value *arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 5);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), intrinsicID), {arg}, "", entryBB);

    mainFunc->setDoesNotThrow();
    mainFunc->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CI must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "CI must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    uint64_t NumBytes = AMII->getNumElements() * sizeof(int32_t);
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultiple(NumBytes, sizeof(int32_t)) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

     
    CallBase *ctxCI = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(ctxCI && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *Intr = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(Intr && "CallInst must be an intrinsic");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *MemIntr = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(Intr);
    assert(MemIntr && "Intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    if (MemIntr->isUnordered()) {
        uint64_t NumBytes = MemIntr->getNumElements();
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !((NumBytes * 8) % MemIntr->getElementSize() == 0) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CtxCI = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CtxCI && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    auto IRP = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CtxCI, 0);
    assert(IRP.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the call site argument kind");
    
     
    Function *Func = F;
    assert(Func && "Function must be non-null");
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), Args, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
         
        F->setDoesNotThrow();
        F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

         
        legacy::PassManager Passes;
        Passes.add(createInstructionCombiningPass());
        Passes.run(*BB);

        std::cout << "Module has been modified with intrinsic calls and attributes." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Intrinsic call does not have any uses, test setup failed." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), IntrinsicType::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked with 'nounwind'");
    
     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (const auto *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
            assert(AMII->getDstAlign() == 0 && "Zero-length operation for atomic unordered memory intrinsic");
        }
    }
    
     
    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());

     
    BasicBlock &BB = F->front();

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", &BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Intrinsic call detected." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "No intrinsic call detected." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function marked as nounwind and CallInst does not throw." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function or CallInst does not meet the nounwind condition." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Specific intrinsic type detected." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "No specific intrinsic type detected." << std::endl;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void simplifyCallInst(CallInst &CI) {
    if (CI.use_empty()) return;  

    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->isNounwind() && !CI.doesNotThrow()) return;  

    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) return;  

    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    Value *Ptr = AMII->getPointerOperand();
    uint64_t NumBytes = AMII->getNumElements() * AMII->getElementType()->getPrimitiveSizeInBits();
    if (NumBytes > 0 && NumBytes % 8 == 0) return;  

     
    CI.setTailCall(true);  
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Value::getUndef(Type::getVoidTy(Context)), "", BB);

     
    simplifyCallInst(*CI);

    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName() << "\n";
    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setParamAttribute(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, { Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Builder.getInt64(10) }, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(Builder.CreateICmpULT(Arg, Builder.getInt32(2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getCondition() && "SelectInst must have a condition");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue() && "SelectInst must have true value");
    assert(SI->getFalseValue() && "SelectInst must have false value");
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType && "SelectInst type must be correctly retrievable");

     
     

    std::cout << "Test case setup completed." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttribute(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI;
    if (true) {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);
    } else {
         
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::other_intrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
         
        F->setDoesNotThrow();
        F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, FunctionCallee(&*M.getFunction("test_func")), { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setCalledOperand(FunctionCallee(&*M.getFunction("llvm.abs")));  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    CallBase *CB = CI;

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemory() || II->getIntrinsicID() != Intrinsic::memset) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not an intrinsic memory operation." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!F->getReturnType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Function does not have a integer type return value." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
     

     
    M.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkCallInst(CallInst &CI) {
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;  
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow() || func->isNoReturn()) return false;  
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI) || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(&CI)) return false;  
    return true;
}

bool checkLoopConditions(Loop *L) {
    if (!L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) return false;  
    if (!L->isSafeToClone()) return false;  
    if (L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) return false;  
    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), Args, "", BB);
    
    if (checkCallInst(*CI)) {
         
        std::cout << "CallInst is valid." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not meet the required conditions." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Loop *L = new Loop();  
    if (checkLoopConditions(L)) {
         
        std::cout << "Loop conditions are valid." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop does not meet the required conditions." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>  

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Instruction *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {}, "", BB);
    assert(CI && "Failed to create CallInst");
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has uses." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    } else {
        F->setNoUnwind();
    }
    
     
    Loop *L = new Loop(&BB, nullptr);
    UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;  
    if (ULO.Count > 0 && L->isSafeToClone()) {
        std::cout << "Loop is safe to clone and unroll count is valid." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop is not safe to clone or unroll count is invalid." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    delete L;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

void createCallInstWithUse(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Ctx), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    
     
    ConstantInt *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 42);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::abs, {Arg->getType()}, &Arg, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(CI->getType());
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    
    createCallInstWithUse(M);
    
    std::cout << "Module created with call instruction:\n" << M;
    
    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Args[1] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Args, "call_inst", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgList().front());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CI->setCalledFunction(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, static_cast<Intrinsic::ID>(IID)));

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        switch (II->getIntrinsicID()) {
            case Intrinsic::memset:
            case Intrinsic::memcpy:
            case Intrinsic::memmove:
                 
                break;
            default:
                llvm_unreachable("Unsupported intrinsic");
        }
    } else {
        llvm_unreachable("Not an intrinsic call");
    }

     
    std::cout << "Generated LLVM IR:\n";
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createExampleFunction(LLVMContext &ctx) {
    Module *mod = new Module("test", ctx);
    FunctionType *funcTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(funcTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "exampleFunc", mod);

     
     

    return F;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext ctx;
    Function *F = createExampleFunction(ctx);

    if (!F) {
        errs() << "Failed to create function\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    BasicBlock &entryBB = F->getBasicBlockList().push_back(new BasicBlock("entry", F));
    IRBuilder<> builder(&entryBB);

     
    Function *callee = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(F->getParent(), IntrinsicType::memcpy, {});
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(callee, {}, "", &entryBB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    CI->addUse({});  

    if (!CI) {
        errs() << "Failed to create CallInst\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow(false);
    F->setUnwindFunc("llvm.trap");

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CI is an intrinsic call\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CI is not an intrinsic call\n";
    }

     
    legacy::PassManager PM;
    PM.add(createPrintModulePass(outs()));
    PM.run(*F->getParent());

    return 0;
}

    CallInst *AtomicCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::atomic_load), {}, "", BB);

    Value *CtxI = AtomicCI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CtxI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    simplifyCall(CI);

     
     

    std::cout << "Test case generated successfully!" << std::endl;
    return 0;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &module);

     
    BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);

     
    Argument *arg = &(*func->arg_begin());
    arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, { Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0) }, "", bb);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

         
        if (II->isAtomic()) {
            int NumBytes = 0;  
            assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % II->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() != 0, "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
        }
    }

     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
        assert(CB->getFunction() && "Function must be non-null");
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Dominators.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
CallInst* createCallInst(Function& F, Module& M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 1)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(&F, Args, "", nullptr);
    return CI;
}

 
Function* createFunction(Module& M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    return F;
}

 
int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    Function *F = createFunction(M);
    CallInst *CI = createCallInst(*F, M);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CI must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow(false);
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(&F, {}, "", nullptr);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && AMII->isAtomic() && !AMII->hasVolatileOrdering() && "Must be atomic unordered memory intrinsic");

     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", *Mod);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, I, "", BB);

     
    Use &U = F->getBasicBlockList().front().back().use_begin();
    U.getUser()->dump();

     
    if (IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
            std::cout << "CallInst is a memory intrinsic" << std::endl;
             
        }
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test", &TheModule);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Args[1] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&TheModule, Intrinsic::memset), Args, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), nullptr);
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID ID = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)->getIntrinsicID();
        if (ID == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
            CI->setArgOperand(2, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0));
        }
    }

     
    F->print(errs());
    BB->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", F);
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, AttributeSet::ReturnIndex, Attribute::Returned);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, Callee, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_intrinsic;  
    Value *IntrArg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *ICall = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), {IntrArg}, "", BB);

     
    if (ICall->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Intrinsic call does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
     

    std::cout << "Test case created successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", M);

     
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg1");

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memset), {F->arg_begin()}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setOnlyAccessesStack();

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(F->onlyAccessesStack() && "Function should only access stack");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CtxI = CI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CtxI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*F, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must be callsite argument");

     

    std::cout << "All assertions passed!\n";

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *One = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *Two = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICMP_ULT, Zero, Two, "", BB->getTerminator());
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = FPMathOperator::createFNeg(FCeil(FAbs(One)), "", BB->getTerminator());
    InsertElementInst *IEI = new InsertElementInst(TrueVal, TrueVal, Zero, "", BB->getTerminator());

     
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB->getTerminator());

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::memset, {Zero}, 0, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(SI);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Constants.h"
#include "llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h"

using namespace llvm;

 
void createFunctionWithIntrinsic(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &C = M.getContext();
  
   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
  
   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(C, "", F);
  
   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::abs, {}, "", BB);
  
   
  CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(C));
  
   
  F->setNotTailCall();
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->setUnwind(false);
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("module", Context);
  
  createFunctionWithIntrinsic(M);
  
   
  std::cout << M;
  
  return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, true);
    BB->addArgument(Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context), false);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call\n";
    }
    
     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        errs() << "Context instruction is a CallBase instance\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Context instruction is not a CallBase instance\n";
    }
    
     
    delete M;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4);
    Value *Arg2 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 8);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {Arg1, Arg2}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memmove) {
             
            Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
            assert(cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->isNonPositive() || cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().ugt(1) && "NumBytes must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
        } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomic_load || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomic_store) {
             
            Value *Ptr = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
            Type *IntPtrTy = PointerType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
            Ptr = CastInst::Create(Instruction::BitCast, Ptr, IntPtrTy, "", BB);
            CI->setArgOperand(0, Ptr);
        }
    }

     
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "Context instruction must have at least one use");

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {CI}, "", BB);

     
    if (auto *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        AMII->setAtomicOrdering(llvm::AtomicOrdering::Unordered);
        AMII->setSyncScopeID(llvm::SyncScope::System);
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &module);
    func->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1)}, "", bb);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setUnwindBehavior(Function::UnwindNone);

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked as nounwind.");

     
    legacy::PassManager Passes;
    Passes.add(createSimplifyLibCallsPass());
    Passes.run(module);

    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());

    CallInst *CI2 = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), II), {}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI2) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "Passed: CallInst has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Failed: CallInst does not have at least one use.\n";
    }

     

    return 0;

    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
            std::cout << "Intrinsic check passed." << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "Not an intrinsic call as expected." << std::endl;
        }
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

    IntrinsicInst *AnyMemIntrinsic = IntrinsicInst::Create(Instruction::Call, CI, {Arg}, "", BB);

void exampleFunction(Function &F) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = F.getContext();
  IRBuilder<> Builder(&F.getEntryBlock(), F.begin());

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
  FunctionCallee Callee = F.getParent()->getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memset.p0i8.i64", FTy);
  std::vector<Value *> Args;
  Args.push_back(Builder.CreatePointerCast(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx), 0), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Ctx)));
  Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx), 1));
  Args.push_back(Builder.CreatePointerCast(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx), 0), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Ctx)));
  CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, Args);

   
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CI must have at least one use");

   
  F.setDoesNotThrow();
  CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

   
  IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
  assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "Call must be an intrinsic");

   
  if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
    Value *NumBytes = Args[1];
    assert(cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->isZero() || !cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().isMultipleOf(8), "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic must have non-positive length or not a multiple of element size");
  }

   
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "exampleFunction", M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

   
  exampleFunction(*F);

   
  M->print(outs(), nullptr);

  delete M;
  return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;   
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        auto *IMI = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        std::cout << "Intrinsic call detected: " << IMI->getIntrinsicID() << "\n";
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Not an intrinsic call\n";
    }

     
    auto *IRP = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CI);
    if (IRP.isValid()) {
        std::cout << "IRPosition is valid\n";

    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

        assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "CI must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

        assert(!Pos.isNull() && "IRPosition must be valid");

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "The function containing the CallInst must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "The CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    Value *NumBytes = AMII->getArgOperand(1);
    assert(cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->isZero() && "For atomic unordered memory intrinsics, the length must be non-positive");
    
     
    Value *CtxI = CI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CtxI) && "The context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    auto IRP = IRPosition::callsite_argument((const CallInst &)*CI, 0);
    assert(IRP.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "The IRPosition must have a position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");
    
     
    Function *Funct = IRP.getAssociatedFunction();
    assert(Funct != nullptr && "The function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");
    
     
     
    
     
    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Basic Block: " << BB->getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>

#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>
#include <llvm/ADT/Statistic.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
class TreeEntry {
public:
    enum State { SplitVectorize, Vectorize };
     
};

class ScalarEvolution {};

class InstructionCost {
public:
    static const int getInvalid() { return -1; }
};

class FPClassTest {};

class Value {
public:
    virtual ~Value() = default;
};

class Type : public Value {
public:
    bool isVectorTy() const { return true; }
    unsigned getScalarSizeInBits() const { return 32; }
};

class IntegerType : public Type {
public:
    unsigned getBitWidth() const { return 32; }
};

class CallBase : public Value {
public:
    virtual ~CallBase() = default;
};

class IntrinsicInst : public CallBase {
public:
    bool doesNotThrow() const { return true; }
    Function *getFunction() const { return nullptr; }
    Type *getType() const { return new IntegerType(); }
    Value *getArgOperand(unsigned idx) const { return nullptr; }
};

class CallInst : public CallBase {
public:
    bool use_empty() const { return false; }
    Function *getFunction() const { return nullptr; }
    Type *getType() const { return new IntegerType(); }
    Value *getCalledOperand() const { return nullptr; }
};

class SelectInst : public Value {
public:
    Value *getCondition() const { return nullptr; }
    Value *getTrueValue() const { return nullptr; }
    Value *getFalseValue() const { return nullptr; }
    Type *getType() const { return new IntegerType(); }
};

class BasicBlock : public Value {
public:
    virtual ~BasicBlock() = default;
};

class Loop : public Value {
public:
    bool isSafeToClone() const { return true; }
    BasicBlock *getLoopPreheader() const { return nullptr; }
    BasicBlock *getLoopLatch() const { return nullptr; }
    BasicBlock *getHeader() const { return nullptr; }
    bool hasAddressTaken() const { return false; }
};

class ScalarEvolutionExpander : public LoopPass {
public:
    void getAdjustedIterationCount(Value *&IterCnt, const SimplifyQuery &SQ) const {}
};

class TargetLibraryInfoImpl : public PassInfoMixin<TargetLibraryInfoImpl> {
public:
    bool isMathFunc(const Function *F) const { return false; }
};

class LoopPassManager : public PassInfoMixin<LoopPassManager> {
public:
    void addPass(Pass *P) {}
};

class ScalarEvolutionNode {
public:
    class NodeTy {};
    NodeTy *getScalar() const { return nullptr; }
};

class LoopInfoBase {
public:
    virtual ~LoopInfoBase() = default;
};

class FunctionPass : public PassInfoMixin<FunctionPass> {
public:
    void addPass(Pass *P) {}
};

class PassManagerBuilder {
public:
    void setOptLevel(unsigned level) {}
    void populate(FunctionPass &FPM) {}
};

class SimplifyQuery {};

 
void exampleFunction(CallInst &CI, ScalarEvolution &SE, LoopInfoBase *LI, TargetLibraryInfoImpl &TLI, DataLayout &DL, unsigned Depth, FPClassTest DemandedMask, Value *Known) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return;

     
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow() || !CI.doesNotThrow()) return;

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (!II || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) return;

     
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test", Context);
    FunctionPassManager FPM;
    PassManagerBuilder PMB;
    PMB.setOptLevel(0);
    PMB.populate(FPM);

     
    CallInst CI;
    ScalarEvolution SE;
    LoopInfoBase LI;
    TargetLibraryInfoImpl TLI;
    DataLayout DL(&module);
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    Value *Known = nullptr;

    exampleFunction(CI, SE, &LI, TLI, DL, 0, DemandedMask, Known);

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test_module", Context);
    Function *func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &module);
    BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);
    
     
    std::vector<Type *> argTypes;
    FunctionType *fnTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), argTypes, false);
    Function *intrinFunc = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic, fnTy->params());
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(intrinFunc, {}, "", bb);
    
     
    Use &use = CI->use_begin();
    assert(!use.getUser()->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(func->isNoUnwind() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked as nounwind");
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *intrinInst = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(intrinInst && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *anyMemIntrin = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(intrinInst);
    assert(anyMemIntrin && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    
     
    unsigned NumBytes = anyMemIntrin->getNumElements();
    if (NumBytes > 0) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Atomic unordered memory intrinsics must have non-positive length or not a multiple of the element size" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    CallBase *ctxI = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(ctxI && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    IRPosition pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument((*bb->begin()).getTerminator(), 0);
    assert(pos.positionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT position kind");
    
     
    Function *funcAssoc = pos.getAssociatedFunction();
    assert(funcAssoc && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");
    
     
     
    
    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createTestFunction(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &C = M.getContext();
  
   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), {}, false);
  
   
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
  
   
  Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memset;  
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {}, "", F);
  
   
  CI->addUse(F->getValueSymbolTable());
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Ctx;
  Module M("testModule", Ctx);
  
  createTestFunction(M);
  
  for (auto &F : M) {
    if (!F.isIntrinsic()) continue;
    
     
    if (!F.doesNotThrow() && F.getFnAttribute("nounwind").hasAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) {
      std::cout << "Function contains an intrinsic that does not throw but is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
      return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (Intrinsic::isMemSet(CI)) {
      uint64_t NumBytes = getNumElements(CI->getArgOperand(2)) * getTypeStoreSize(CI->getType());
      if (NumBytes <= 0) {
        std::cout << "Intrinsic call has zero-length operation or non-positive length." << std::endl;
        return 1;
      }
    }
  }
  
  std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
  return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Verifier.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", F);
    Arg->setParamAttrs(AttributeSet::get(Context, {Attribute::Returned}));

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrId = Intrinsic::fabs;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrId), Arg, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == IntrId && "Expected a specific intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);

     
    for (const Argument &A : F->args()) {
        if (A.hasParamAttr(Attribute::Returned)) {
            break;
        }
    }

     
    assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase");
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic call");

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &outs())) {
        errs() << "Verification failed!\n";
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "Test passed successfully!\n";
    return 0;
}

    F->setUnwindDest(&M.getNonexistentBlock());

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memset) {
        II->setArgOperand(1, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0));
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memcpy) {
        Value *Dest = Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 16));
        II->setArgOperand(0, Dest);
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memmove) {
        Value *Dest = Builder.CreateAlloca(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 16));
        II->setArgOperand(0, Dest);
    } else {
        assert(false && "Expected a memory intrinsic");
    }

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkCallInst(const CallInst &CI) {
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow() || func->hasFnAttr("nounwind")) return false;
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) return false;
    Intrinsic::ID id = cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)->getIntrinsicID();
    if (id != Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) return false;
    if (id == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && CI.getNumArgOperands() <= 0) return false;
    return true;
}

bool checkSelectInst(const SelectInst &SI) {
    Value *CondVal = SI.getCondition();
    Value *TrueVal = SI.getTrueValue();
    Value *FalseVal = SI.getFalseValue();
    if (!CondVal || !TrueVal || !FalseVal) return false;
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    if (!SelType) return false;
    return true;
}

bool checkLoop(const Loop &L) {
    if (!L.getLoopPreheader() || !L.getLoopLatch()) return false;
    if (!L.isSafeToClone()) return false;
    if (L.getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) return false;
    return true;
}

bool checkUnrollCount(const UnrollLoopOptions &ULO, unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth) {
    if (ULO.Count <= 0) return false;
    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    CallInst *CI = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {});
    CI->setCalledFunction(F);

     
    if (checkCallInst(*CI)) {
        outs() << "CallInst satisfies all constraints.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not satisfy some constraints.\n";
    }

     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), APInt(1, 0));
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 42));
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 24));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    if (checkSelectInst(*SI)) {
        outs() << "SelectInst satisfies all constraints.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "SelectInst does not satisfy some constraints.\n";
    }

     
    BasicBlock *Preheader = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    BasicBlock *Latch = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Latch->moveBefore(BB);
    BranchInst *BI = new BranchInst(BB, Preheader, Latch, BB);
    Loop *L = new Loop(&*F->begin(), &LI);

     
    if (checkLoop(*L)) {
        outs() << "Loop satisfies all constraints.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Loop does not satisfy some constraints.\n";
    }

     
    UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    if (checkUnrollCount(ULO, 10)) {
        outs() << "UnrollLoopOptions satisfies all constraints.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "UnrollLoopOptions does not satisfy some constraints.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

    F->setNoUnwind();

        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {
             
        }

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/Casting.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
     
    Function *F = createFunction();  
    CallInst *CI = createCallInst(F);  

    if (!CI->use_empty() || !F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) {
        std::cerr << "Constraints not met!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (!II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) {
            std::cerr << "Not an AnyMemIntrinsic!" << std::endl;
            return 1;
        }
         
    }

     
    for (auto &arg : F->args()) {
        if (arg.hasReturnedAttr()) {
            std::cout << "Function has a returned argument." << std::endl;
        }
    }

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    auto *L = getLoop();  
    if (!L || !L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) {
        std::cerr << "Invalid loop structure!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    if (!L->isSafeToClone()) {
        std::cerr << "Loop is not safe to clone!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    LoopUnrollInfo ULO;
    if (ULO.Count <= 0) {
        std::cerr << "Unroll count must be greater than zero!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *I = nullptr;  
    if (!I || !isIntegerType(I->getType())) {
        std::cerr << "Invalid instruction type!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    uint64_t NLZ = getUnusedHighBits(CI);
    if (NLZ > 0) {
         
    }

    std::cout << "All constraints met!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {CI}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(II) && "Must be an intrinsic call");

     
    II->setDoesNotThrow();
    II->setDoesNotUnwind();

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    F->addParamAttr(0, AttributeForArgument(Arg));

     
    F->setHasReturned();

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateNeg(Builder.CreateFabs(TrueVal));
    SelectInst *SI = Builder.CreateSelect(Builder.CreateICmpULT(TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type must be integer");
    assert(SI->getCondition()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Condition type must be integer");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "TrueVal type must be integer");
    assert(SI->getFalseValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "FalseVal type must be integer");

     
     

    std::cout << "Module:\n" << M;

    return 0;
}

    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    if (AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
         
        unsigned NumBytes = 0;  
        if (NumBytes > 0 && !isMultiple(NumBytes, sizeof(int))) {
             
        }
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Expected a call base instruction");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB);
    assert(Pos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "Expected call site argument position");

     
    Function *Funct = Pos.getFunction();
    assert(Funct && "Expected a non-null function");

     

    return 0;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB->getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgOperand(0));

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;
    if (auto *BBI = dyn_cast<BasicBlock>(CI)) {
        L = LI.getLoopFor(BBI);
    }

    UnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;  
    if (L) {
        LoopUnroll(L, ULO, nullptr, nullptr, false);
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

void ensureCallInstHasAtLeastOneUse(Function &F) {
    for (auto &BB : F) {
        for (auto &I : BB) {
            if (auto *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(&I)) {
                if (!CI->use_empty()) {
                    return;  
                }
            }
        }
    }
    errs() << "Function does not contain a CallInst with at least one use.\n";
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    ensureCallInstHasAtLeastOneUse(*F);

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

 
void manipulateCFG(vector<vector<int>> &graph, int node) {
    assert(!graph.empty() && "Graph should not be empty");
    assert(node >= 0 && node < graph.size() && "Node should be within the bounds of the graph");

     
    if (graph[node].size() == 1) {
         
        int next_node = graph[node][0];
        cout << "Adding unconditional jump from node " << node << " to node " << next_node << endl;
    } else if (graph[node].size() > 1) {
         
        int true_branch = graph[node][0];
        int false_branch = graph[node][1];
        cout << "Adding conditional jump from node " << node << " to nodes " << true_branch << " and " << false_branch << endl;
    } else {
         
        cout << "Node " << node << " is a terminal block." << endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    vector<vector<int>> graph = {{1}, {2}, {3}, {}, {}};

     
    for (size_t i = 0; i < graph.size(); ++i) {
        manipulateCFG(graph, i);
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testfunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::abs), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "Intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    if (AMII->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset || AMII->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
        int NumBytes = 16;  
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % sizeof(int) != 0, "For atomic unordered memory intrinsics, length must meet the condition");
    }

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    Value *Arg = &*AI;
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Return);

     
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
    auto *IRP = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CI);
    assert(IRP.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT, "IRPosition should have the correct kind");

     

    Mod->print(errs(), nullptr);
    return 0;
}

    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    FunctionType *IntrinsicType = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt64Ty(Context)});
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(IntrinsicType, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Value::use_empty());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
            Value *NumBytes = II->getOperand(2);
            if (!isZero(NumBytes)) {
                IntegerType *IntTy = cast<IntegerType>(NumBytes->getType());
                int64_t BitWidth = IntTy->getBitWidth();
                if (BitWidth <= 0 || BitWidth % 8 != 0) {
                     
                    Builder.CreateCall(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::trap), {});
                }
            }
        }
    }

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallBase *CB = CI;

     
    if (isa<CallInst>(CB)) {
        CallInst *CI = cast<CallInst>(CB);
        FunctionType *FTy = dyn_cast<FunctionType>(CI->getType());
        if (!FTy) continue;

         
        Value *CondVal = Builder.CreateICmpULT(CI, ConstantInt::get(Context, APInt(32, 2)));
        Value *TrueVal = CI;
        Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateCall("ctpop", {CI});
        Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();

         
        if (CondVal && TrueVal && FalseVal && SelType) {
            SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

             
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
                SI = Builder.CreateSelect(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
            }
        }
    }

     
    if (F->arg_size() > 0 && F->getArg(0)->hasAttr(Attribute::Returned)) {
         
    }

    std::cout << "Module: " << *Module << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
    Argument *A1 = new Argument(FuncTy->getParamType(0), Arg1->getName(), F);
    F->addArgument(0, A1);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, FunctionCallee("llvm.fabs.f32", FuncTy), {A1}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::fabs, "Expected llvm.fabs intrinsic");

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow(), "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    Arg->setName("arg");

    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be nounwind");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CI, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type must be integer");

     
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, F->arg_begin(), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SI->setCondition(CondVal);
    SI->setTrueValue(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1));
    SI->setFalseValue(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0));

     
    F->print(outs());

    return 0;

    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = &*(F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *AnyMemCI = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(AnyMemCI && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &outs())) {
        errs() << "Verification failed!\n";
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "Test module created successfully with a CallInst that meets your criteria.\n";
    return 0;
}
