int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, true);
    Arg->setName("arg");
    BB->addArgument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
         
        F->setDoesNotThrow();
        F->setUnwind(false);

         
        if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
            Intrinsic::ID IID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
            if (IID == Intrinsic::memcpy || IID == Intrinsic::memmove || IID == Intrinsic::memset) {
                 
                Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, true);
                if (!CI->use_empty() && F->doesNotThrow() && dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && (NumBytes->isZero() || !((int)NumBytes % sizeof(void*)))) {
                     
                    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
                         
                        IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CI, 0);
                        assert(Pos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition kind should be callsite argument");

                         
                        Function *Func = Pos.getFunction();
                        assert(Func && "Function should not be null");

                         
                        TreeEntry *E = nullptr;
                        if (E) {
                            Value *ScalarTy = E->Scalars.front();
                            int Size = E->Scalars.size();

                             
                            DenseMap<TreeEntry*, Type*> MinBWs;
                            if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
                                Type *Ty = MinBWs[E];
                                assert(Ty->isIntegerTy() && "Type should be integer");
                            }

                             
                            if (E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize) {
                                 
                                assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "Exactly two entries should be present");

                                 
                                if (!E->isGather() && !(E->State & TreeEntry::TransformedToGatherNodes)) {
                                     
                                    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
                                    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
                                    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Instruction::getUnaryOpcode(Instruction::FNeg, TrueVal->getType()), TrueVal, "", BB);
                                    Type *SelType = FalseVal->getType();

                                     
                                    if (SelType && SelType->isIntegerTy()) {
                                         
                                        Value *X = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
                                        Value *AbsVal = CallInst::Create(Instruction::getUnaryOpcode(Instruction::FNeg, X->getType()), X, "", BB);
                                        FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Instruction::getUnaryOpcode(Instruction::FNeg, AbsVal->getType()), AbsVal, "", BB);

                                         
                                        Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
                                        if ((CondType->isIntegerTy() && SelType->isIntegerTy()) || (CondType->isVectorTy() && SelType->isVectorTy())) {
                                             
                                            if (E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement) {
                                                 
                                                Value *LastOperand = E->getOperand(1)->back();
                                                assert(!lastOperand->getType()->isVectorTy() && "Last operand should not be a vector type");

                                                 
                                                Type *ScalarTy = VL[0];
                                                assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy should be a valid element type");

                                                 
                                                DenseMap<TreeEntry*, Type*> MinBWs;
                                                if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
                                                    Type *Ty = MinBWs[E];
                                                    assert(Ty->isIntegerTy() && "Type should be integer");
                                                } else if (E->Idx == 0 && isReducedBitcastRoot()) {
                                                     
                                                }

                                                 
                                                Value *I = CallInst::Create(Instruction::getUnaryOpcode(Instruction::FNeg, X->getType()), X, "", BB);
                                                assert(isa<FNegInst>(I) && "I should be a FNegInst");
                                                Value *XAbs = CallInst::Create(Instruction::getUnaryOpcode(Instruction::FABS, X->getType()), X, "", BB);
                                                assert(isa<CallInst>(XAbs) && "XAbs should be a call to fabs");
                                                assert(XAbs->hasOneUse() && "fabs(x) should have exactly one use");

                                                 
                                                FPClassTest Known = FPClassTest::getEmpty();
                                                assert(Known.isUninit() && "Known should be uninitialized");

                                                 
                                                int Depth = 0;
#define MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth 10
                                                assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth should not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

                                                 
                                                Type *ScalarType = ScalarTy;
                                                assert(ScalarType->isIntegerTy() && "ScalarType should be integer");
                                                int BitWidth = ScalarType->getIntegerBitWidth();
                                                FPClassTest DemandedMask = FPClassTest::getEmpty();
                                                assert(DemandedMask.getBitWidth() == BitWidth && "DemandedMask bit width should match ScalarTy type");

                                                 
                                                int SliceSize = 0;
                                                int Part = 0;
                                                Type *MaskBase = computeMaskBase(SliceSize, Part);
                                                assert(MaskBase && "MaskBase should be computed");
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0));
    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 16));  
    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1));   
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(*F->arg_begin());

     
    if (IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
            F->setDoesNotThrow();
            F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

             
            if (NumBytes > 0 && NumBytes % ElementSize == 0) {
                std::cerr << "Error: NumBytes must not be a multiple of ElementSize for atomic unordered memory intrinsics." << std::endl;
                return -1;
            }

             
        }
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memcpy.p0i8.p0i8.i32",
                                                  FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context),
                                                                     {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 4)},
                                                                     false));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {Arg, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 4)}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    assert(!CI->getFunction()->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not have a 'nothrow' attribute");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << CI->getFunction()->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopPass.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar/SimplifyCFG.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setArgNo(0);
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst* MemCpy = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), CI->getType(), { CI }, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MemCpy) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");

     
    legacy::PassManager PM;
    PM.add(createInstructionCombiningPass());
    PM.run(*F->getParent());

    std::cout << "Module after simplification: " << F->getName() << "\n";

    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

    Instruction *InsElt = InsertElementInst::Create(Vec, Vec, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), "", BB);

     
    assert(InsElt->getType()->isVectorTy() && "Insert element instruction must be a vector");

     
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, InsElt, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "", BB);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat::fltNaN());  
    Instruction *SelInst = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SelInst->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Select instruction must be of integer type");

     

    std::cout << "Test setup completed." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());
  BasicBlock *EntryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", F);
  BasicBlock *LoopBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "loop", F);
  BranchInst::Create(LoopBB, EntryBB);

   
  Value *Cond = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
  ICmpInst *ICmp = new ICmpInst(*EntryBB, ICmpInst::FCMP_OLT, ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 0.0), ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0));
  LoopVectorizationPlan Plan;
  if (!LoopUnrollPass(*EntryBB->getParent(), &Plan)) {
    std::cerr << "Loop unrolling failed!" << std::endl;
    return -1;
  }

   
  unsigned int MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
  LoopInfo LI(*F);
  for (auto &BB : *F) {
    if (LI.isLoopHeader(&BB)) {
      Loop *L = LI.getLoopFor(&BB);
      if (L && L->isVectorized()) {
        unsigned Count = 4;  
        LoopUnrollResult ULO(Count, LoopUnrollCost::Exact);
        if (!L->unroll<ULO>()) {
          std::cerr << "Loop unrolling failed for some reason!" << std::endl;
          return -1;
        }
      }
    }
  }

   
  Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);

  return 0;
}

    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    
     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
             
            if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
                Value *Length = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
                II->setArgOperand(2, Length);  
            }
        }
    }
    
     
     
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyIndVar.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *EntryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Func->getFunctionType(), Func, {});
    EntryBB->getInstList().push_back(CI);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *AnyMemIntrin = IntrinsicInst::createMemoryTransfer(Context, CI, {}, "anymemintr");
    EntryBB->getInstList().push_back(AnyMemIntrin);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
     
     

     
     
    if (CI->getNumUses() > 0) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use, triggering potential simplification.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }

     
     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    new StoreInst(Arg, (AllocaInst*)Func->arg_begin(), EntryBB);

     
    Func->addAttribute(0, Attribute::Returned);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::abs, {Arg->getType()}), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "CallInst throws.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not throw.\n";
    }

     
    F->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::makeICmp(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    
     
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(FalseVal, TrueVal, TrueVal, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!SI->use_empty() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(SI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(SI);
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);  
        assert(NumBytes->getLimitedValue() <= 0 && "NumBytes must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }
    
     
     

    std::cout << "Test case generation completed successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    Module M("module", Context);

    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind but call instruction does not throw");

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->simplify();
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument* Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setArgAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::memcpy), { ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 4) }, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function is not marked as nounwind or CallInst throws\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    if (!II->isAnyMemory()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value* Simplified = nullptr;
    bool SimplifiedSuccess = SimplifyInstruction(CI, Simplified);
    assert(SimplifiedSuccess && "Failed to simplify CallInst");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed successfully!\n";
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", M);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {}, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getVoidTy(Context));
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getVoidTy(Context));
    }

     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 10)}, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        auto *MI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        assert(MI && "CI must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

         
        if (auto NumBytes = MI->getLength()) {
            assert(*NumBytes <= 0 || *NumBytes % 8 != 0 && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
        }
    }

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->setNoUnwind();

     
    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID ID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
        if (ID == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
            Value* NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);  
            if (NumBytes->getSExtValue() <= 0 || NumBytes->getSExtValue() % sizeof(int) != 0) {
                std::cerr << "Length is valid for atomic unordered memory intrinsic handling" << std::endl;
            } else {
                std::cerr << "Invalid length for atomic unordered memory intrinsic" << std::endl;
            }
        }
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::unique_ptr<CallBase> SimplifiedCI = simplifyCall(CI);
        if (SimplifiedCI) {
            CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(SimplifiedCI.get());
        }
    }

     
    Module->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

void generateTestFunction() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("testModule", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    
     
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg1");
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    
     
    Value *IntrinsicArg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    IntrinsicInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, llvm::Intrinsic::memcpy), {IntrinsicArg}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind.");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrinsicID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
    if (Intrinsic::isMemCmp(IntrinsicID)) {
        assert(CI->getNumArgOperands() > 0 && "Memory intrinsic must have non-zero length.");
    } else if (Intrinsic::isAtomic(IntrinsicID)) {
        Value *NumBytes = CI->getOperand(2);
        assert(cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().ule(0) || !cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().isMultipleOfElementSize(), "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size.");
    }
    
     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";
}

int main() {
    generateTestFunction();
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyIndVar.h>

using namespace llvm;

std::optional<Instruction *> simplifySelectInst(SelectInst &SI) {
  Value *CondVal = SI.getCondition();
  Value *TrueVal = SI.getTrueValue();
  Value *FalseVal = SI.getFalseValue();

   
  if (!CondVal || !TrueVal || !FalseVal) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }

  Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
  Type *TrueType = TrueVal->getType();
  Type *FalseType = FalseVal->getType();

   
  if (CondType != TrueType || CondType != FalseType) {
    return std::nullopt;
  }

   
  if (isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal) && isa<FPExtInst>(TrueVal) && isa<FPTruncInst>(FalseVal)) {
     
    Value *AbsValue = BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(BinaryOperator::CreateFABS(TrueVal), "", &SI);
    SI.replaceAllUsesWith(AbsValue);
    return &SI;
  }

   
  return std::nullopt;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test_module", Context);
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

   
  Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
  Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
  Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
  SelectInst *SI = Builder.CreateSelect(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", &SI);

   
  if (auto Simplified = simplifySelectInst(*SI)) {
    std::cout << "Simplified instruction successfully." << std::endl;
  } else {
    std::cout << "Failed to simplify instruction." << std::endl;
  }

  return 0;
}

    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = &*(F->arg_begin());
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(&*F->begin());

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    if (II) {
        II->setArgOperandToTypeAt(0, Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    }

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    auto *AII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
    assert(AII && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    
     
    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
    CB->getCalledValue();
    
     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB);
    assert(IRPos.getKind() == IRPOK_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct kind");
    
     
    auto *AssocFunc = F;
    assert(AssocFunc && "Associated function must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry *, Type *> MinBWs;
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getIntegerBitWidth() > 0 && "MinBWs entry must provide a valid bit width");
    }
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize && E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2);
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::getTrue(Context);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Instruction::FNeg, TrueVal, "", BB);
    Type *SelType = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    
     
    assert(!isa<SelectInst>(CI) || !simplifySelectInst(cast<SelectInst>(CI)) || 
           !canonicalizeSelectToShuffle(cast<SelectInst>(CI)) || 
           !canonicalizeScalarSelectOfVecs(cast<SelectInst>(CI)));
    
     
    assert(FalseVal->getOpcode() == Instruction::FNeg && "FalseVal must be a fneg operation");
    ICmpInst *ICmp = dyn_cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal);
    assert(ICmp && ICmp->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && "CondVal must be an icmp ult comparison");
    
     
    Type *SelType = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && "SelType must be an integer type or an integer vector type");
    
     
    Type *CondType = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    assert((CondType->isIntegerTy() || CondType->isVectorTy()) && "CondType must be a scalar or vector type");
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement);
    
     
    Value *LastOperand = E->getOperand(1).back();
    assert(!LastOperand->getType()->isVectorTy() && "The type of the last operand must not be a vector type");
    
     
    Type *ScalarTy = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy must be a valid element type");
    
     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getIntegerBitWidth() > 0 && "MinBWs entry must provide a valid bit width");
    } else if (E->Idx == 0 && isReducedBitcastRoot(E)) {
         
        assert(isReducedBitcastRoot(E) && "isReducedBitcastRoot must return true");
    }
    
     
    Instruction *I = CallInst::Create(Instruction::FNeg, TrueVal, "", BB);
    assert(isa<FNegInst>(I) && "I must be a fneg instruction");
    Value *Operand = I->getOperand(0);
    assert(Operand->hasOneUse() && "The operand of the fneg instruction must have exactly one use");
    
     
    FPClass Known;
    assert(Known == FPClass() && "Known must be in an uninitialized state");
    
     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    
     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    assert(DemandedMask.isValid() && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");
    
     
    DenseMap<BasicBlock *, BlockEdgeWeights> BlocksSchedules;
    assert(!BlocksSchedules.empty() && "BlocksSchedules map must contain valid entries");
    
    std::cout << "All assertions passed." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool generateTestFunction(Function &F) {
     
    if (F.arg_size() == 0) return false;
    
     
    Argument *Arg = nullptr;
    for (auto &A : F.args()) {
        if (A.hasReturnedAttr()) {
            Arg = &A;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!Arg) return false;

     
    IRBuilder<> Builder(&F);
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    Args.push_back(Arg);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&F, Intrinsic::anymem_start), Args);
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) return false;

     
    F.setDoesNotThrow();
    F.setNoUnwind();

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) return false;
    auto *AnyMem = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
    if (!AnyMem) return false;

     
    uint64_t NumBytes = AnyMem->getNumElements();
    if (NumBytes <= 0 || (NumBytes % 8 != 0)) return true;  

     
    
    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Builder.getInt32Ty(), {}, false);
    Function &F = *Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    Argument *Arg1 = F.addArg(Builder.getInt32Ty(), "arg1");
    Arg1->addAttribute(AttributeSet::ReturnIndex, Attribute::get(*Context, Attribute::Returned));

    if (generateTestFunction(F)) {
        std::cout << "Test function generated successfully!\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Failed to generate test function.\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
     
    Function *F = nullptr;  
    CallInst *CI = nullptr;  
    Value *CondVal = nullptr, *TrueVal = nullptr, *FalseVal = nullptr;  

    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
         
        CI->addUse(Type::getFloatTy(*F->getContext()), "example_use");
    }

    if (F && !F->doesNotThrow()) {
         
        F->setDoesNotThrow();
    }

    if (IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
             
            if (!AMII->isZeroLength()) {
                 
                errs() << "Zero-length operation detected.\n";
            }
        }
    }

     
    if (AtomicRMWInst *ARMI = dyn_cast<AtomicRMWInst>(CI)) {
        int NumBytes = ARMI->getSizeInBytes();
        if (NumBytes > 0 && NumBytes % getElementTypeByteWidth(ARMI->getType()) != 0) {
             
            errs() << "Atomic unordered memory intrinsic with undefined behavior.\n";
        }
    }

     
    if (SelectInst *SI = dyn_cast<SelectInst>(CI)) {
        Type *SelType = SI->getType();
        Value *CondType = SI->getCondition()->getType();
        if ((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && (CondType->isIntegerTy() || CondType->isVectorTy())) {
             
            errs() << "Select instruction has valid properties.\n";
        }
    }

     
    if (FNegInst *FNI = dyn_cast<FNegInst>(CI)) {
        Value *Op = FNI->getOperand(0);
        if (BinaryOperator *BO = dyn_cast<BinaryOperator>(Op)) {
            if (BO->getOpcode() == Instruction::FAbs) {
                Value *X = BO->getOperand(0);
                if (X->hasOneUse()) {
                     
                    errs() << "Valid fneg(fabs(x)) pattern detected.\n";
                }
            }
        }
    }

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    if (L && L->getLoopPreheader() && L->getLoopLatch()) {
         
        errs() << "Loop has valid preheader and latch blocks.\n";
    }

    UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;  
    if (ULO.Count > 0) {
         
        errs() << "Unroll count is valid.\n";
    }

     
    Value *I = nullptr;  
    Type *Ty = I->getType();
    if (Ty->isIntegerTy() && Ty->getScalarSizeInBits() == getBitWidth(KnownFPClass())) {
         
        errs() << "Instruction type and bit width are valid.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Builder.getInt32Ty());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);

        IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {
             
            Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &Mod);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Value::use_empty());  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    if (!II) return -1;

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "Expected a memory intrinsic");
    if (!AMII) return -1;

     
    Value *TrueVal = Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    ICmpInst *Cmp = new ICmpInst(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(Cmp, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "Expected at least one use of the select instruction");
    if (!SI->hasOneUse()) return -1;

     
    Mod.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->getArg(0);
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgNo());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind();
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be marked as doesNotThrow");

     
    IntrinsicInst *AII = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!AII || !AII->isAnyMemory()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", M);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setParamAttribute(0, AttributeSet::get(Context, {Attribute::Returned}));

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value* X = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value* Y = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), -2.0);
    ICmpInst::Predicate Pred = ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT;
    Value* CondVal = new ICmpInst(Pred, X, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    FNegInst *TrueVal = FNegInst::Create(FabsInst::Create(X), "", BB);
    FNegInst *FalseVal = FNegInst::Create(FabsInst::Create(Y), "", BB);

     
    Type* FloatTy = Type::getFloatTy(Context);
    SelectInst *Sel = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    if (!Sel->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "SelectInst must have at least one use to trigger simplification.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (Sel->hasOneUse() && Sel->getOperand(0)->getType()->isVectorTy()) {
        std::cout << "SelectInst has been simplified correctly as expected.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Simplification of SelectInst did not occur as expected.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function must be marked as nounwind to test this case.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    X->eraseFromParent();
    Y->eraseFromParent();
    CondVal->eraseFromParent();
    TrueVal->eraseFromParent();
    FalseVal->eraseFromParent();
    Sel->eraseFromParent();

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Value::use_empty() ? 1 : 0);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &errs())) {
        errs() << "Error: Module failed verification!\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

from llvm import *
from llvm.core import *
import llvm.transforms.scalar as scalar

# Helper function to create a new module
def create_module():
    return Module(None)

# Helper function to create a basic block in a module
def create_basic_block(module):
    func = Function(module, Type.get_void_ty(module.context), [], "entry")
    bb = BasicBlock("entry", func, module.context)
    return bb

# Main function to generate test cases based on constraints
def generate_test_cases():
    # Create a new LLVM module
    mod = create_module()
    
    # Create the entry basic block
    entry_bb = create_basic_block(mod)
    
    # Generate some IR (pseudo-code, as actual LLVM IR generation is complex)
    builder = Builder.create_builder(entry_bb, module=mod)
    
    # Example: Create a CallInst with specific constraints
    call_inst = CallInst.create_call("intrinsic", [], "nounwind")  # Placeholder values
    
    # Add the CallInst to the entry block (simplified representation)
    builder.position_at_end(entry_bb)
    builder.create_store(Value(), call_inst)
    
    # SimplifyCall and other transformations can be triggered here
    scalar.SimplifyPass().run(mod)
    
    # Print the module to verify (this would typically be part of a testing framework)
    print(str(mod))

# Entry point for generating test cases
if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate_test_cases()

    Passes.add(createInstructionSimplifierPass());
    Passes.run(*F);

    for (auto &BB : *F) {
        for (auto &I : BB) {
            if (&I == CI) {
                simplified = true;
                break;
            }
        }

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = Argument::Create(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", nullptr, F);
    Arg->setReturnValue();

     
    CallInst *CI;
    if (F->getName() == "testFunc") {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);
    } else {
         
        CI = nullptr;
    }

     
    if (CI) {
        Value *User = CI->use_begin();
        assert(User != CI->use_end() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    if (CI) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic");
        assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::makeICmp(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(FalseVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(TrueVal && "TrueVal must be a valid Value");
    assert(FalseVal && "FalseVal must be a valid Value");
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType && "SelectInst type must be correctly retrievable");

     
    if (SI) {
        ICmpInst *Cond = new ICmpInst(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
        Value *CondVal = Cond;
        assert(CondVal && "CondVal must be a valid Value");
    }

     
    LoopInfo LI(*F);
    if (LI.getLoopsInPreorder().empty()) {
        BasicBlock *LoopHeader = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "loop.header", F);
        BasicBlock *LoopLatch = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "loop.latch", F);
        LoopBlocksDFS LBD(LoopHeader, &LI, LI.getBase());
        LoopStandardPreheadersGapper PGR(&LBD);
        if (PGR.preheader() && PGR.latch()) {
             
            assert(LoopHeader->getParent() == F && "Loop header must have a non-null parent function");
            assert(LoopLatch->getParent() == F && "Loop latch must have a non-null parent function");
        }
    }

     
    Loop *L = *(LI.getLoopsInPreorder().begin());
    if (L) {
        UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
        ULO.Count = 2;
        assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");
    }

     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

    return 0;
}

    return func;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

Module* createModule() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "dummy", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::sqrt), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::sqrt, TrueVal, "", BB);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1)), TrueVal, "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindPredecessor(BB);

    return M;
}

int main() {
    Module *M = createModule();
    std::cout << "Module created successfully with a function containing a CallInst and SelectInst." << std::endl;
    delete M;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void recursiveFunction(int depth, int maxDepth) {
  if (depth >= maxDepth) {
    return;
  }
   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(*getContext(), "entry", createFunction("testFunc"));
  IRBuilder<> builder(BB);
  Value *Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(*getContext()), 0);
  Value *One = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(*getContext()), 1);
  Value *Add = BinaryOperator::CreateAdd(Zero, One, "", BB);
  builder.CreateBr(BB);  
  recursiveFunction(depth + 1, maxDepth);
}

Function *createFunction(const std::string &name) {
  Module *M = new Module("testModule", getContext());
  FunctionType *FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(*getContext()), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, name, M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(*getContext(), "entry", F);
  IRBuilder<> builder(BB);
  recursiveFunction(0, 10);  
  return F;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("testModule", Context);
  Function *F = createFunction("testFunc");
  F->dump();
  return 0;
}

    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::memcpy;  
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, IID), Args, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));
    
     
    if (verifyModule(*M, &std::cerr)) {
        std::cerr << "Module failed verification.\n";
        return 1;
    }
    
    delete M;
    return 0;

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::sqrt, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    CallInst *AnyMemIntrinsicCI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {}, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 10)}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(AnyMemIntrinsicCI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(AnyMemIntrinsicCI) && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    BB->insert(BB->begin(), AnyMemIntrinsicCI);

     
    legacy::PassManager PM;
    PM.add(createPrintModulePass([](raw_ostream &OS, const Module &M) { OS << M; }));
    PM.run(*F->getParent());

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

 
void createTestFunction(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &C = M.getContext();

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(C, "", F);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), 10);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), -10);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(!SI->use_empty() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(SI) && isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(SI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");
     

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(SI);
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

    createTestFunction(M);

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyLibCalls.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg = &*(F->arg_begin());
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), { Arg }, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->getArgNo(0));
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::None);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID IID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
        assert((IID == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "Expected AnyMemIntrinsic"));
        
         
        if (IID == Intrinsic::atomicrmw || IID == Intrinsic::cmpxchg) {
            Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);  
            assert(NumBytes->getLimitedValue() <= 0 && "Expected non-positive length or not a multiple of element size");
        }
    }
    
     
    
    std::cout << "Module built successfully with test call instruction." << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopPass.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createCallInst(Function &F) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = F.getContext();
  Module *M = F.getParent();

   
  Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;
  CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(IntrID, {}, "", F.back());

   
  F.setDoesNotThrow();
  F.setNoUnwind();

   
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
}

 
void createLoop(Function &F) {
  BasicBlock *Entry = BasicBlock::Create(F.getContext(), "", &F);
  BranchInst::Create(Entry, Entry);  

  Loop *L = new Loop();
  L->initialize(Entry);

   
  assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop must be safe to clone");
  assert(L->getLoopPreheader() != nullptr && "Loop must have a preheader block");
  assert(L->getLoopLatch() != nullptr && "Loop must have a latch block");
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test", Context);
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function &F = *Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

   
  createCallInst(F);

   
  createLoop(F);

  return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool generateTest(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();   
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) return false;

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (!isa<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) return false;
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic) return false;

     
    Value *NumBytes = II->getArgOperand(1);   
    if (!isa<ConstantInt>(NumBytes) || cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->isZero()) return false;

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) return false;

     

    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M(std::string("testModule"), Context);

    if (generateTest(M)) {
        std::cout << "Test generation successful!" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Test generation failed." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;

    Module M("testModule", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked with no-throw");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), -1.0);

    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType && "SelectInst type must be correctly retrievable");

     
    F->eraseFromParent();
    M.clear();

    return 0;

}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkForAtomicMemIntrinsic(CallInst &CI) {
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomicrmw || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomic_load) {
            return !II->use_empty();  
        }
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::abs, Type::getInt32Ty(Context)), Args, "", BB);

    if (checkForAtomicMemIntrinsic(*CI)) {
        outs() << "Found an atomic memory intrinsic with at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "No suitable intrinsic found or insufficient uses to trigger simplification.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instruction.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *VecVal = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    ConstantInt *Index = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Instruction *InsElt = InsertElementInst::Create(VecVal, VecVal, Index, "", BB);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat::fltNaN());
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat::fltZero());
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::Create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    SI->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    assert(!SI.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(SI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(SI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/IRBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkCallInst(CallInst &CI) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;

     
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow()) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) return false;
    Intrinsic::ID intrinsicID = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)->getIntrinsicID();
    if (intrinsicID != Intrinsic::memcpy && intrinsicID != Intrinsic::memmove && intrinsicID != Intrinsic::memset) {
        return false;
    }

     

    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M->getOrInsertFunction("memset", FTy);
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    Args.push_back(Builder.CreatePointerCast(ConstantExpr::getBitCast(Arg, Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));
    Args.push_back(Arg);
    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, Args, "");

    if (checkCallInst(*CI)) {
        std::cout << "The CallInst meets all the constraints." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The CallInst does not meet some of the constraints." << std::endl;
    }

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

    CI->addUse(1);  

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        outs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    F->print(outs());
    CI->print(outs());

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("input");

     
    ConstantInt *ConstVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));

     
    Value *Vec[4] = { ConstVal, ConstVal, ConstVal, ConstVal };
    ArrayType *AType = ArrayType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4);
    Constant *InitVals[] = {ConstVal};
    GlobalVariable *GV = new GlobalVariable(Mod, AType, false, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage,
                                             ConstantArray::get(AType, InitVals));
    Value *Indices[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)};
    Instruction *Insert = Builder.CreateInsertElement(GV, ConstVal, Indices[0]);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->addUse(F);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *Intr = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (Intr && Intr->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
         
        Value *Ptrs[] = {Arg, Arg};
        Value *Sizes[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4)};
        CallInst *MemCpy = Builder.CreateMemCpy(Ptrs[0], Ptrs[1], Sizes[0], Align(4));
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstVal;
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateFNeg(Builder.CreateFAbs(TrueVal));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal);

     
    SI->setCondition(ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)));
    SI->setTrueValue(TrueVal);
    SI->setFalseValue(FalseVal);

     

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic) {
            std::cout << "Intrinsic call detected and verified." << std::endl;
        }
    }

     
    if (auto *MMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        int NumBytes = MMI->getNumMemOperands();
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes, 1) && "Zero-length or not a multiple of element size");
    }

     
    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;   
    std::vector<Value *> Args = {Arg};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);

     
    Value *NumBytes = AMII->getArgOperand(1);   
    assert(!NumBytes || isa<ConstantInt>(NumBytes) && cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->isZero(), "Expected zero-length operation");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Expected a call base instruction");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CI);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "Expected call site argument position");

     
    Function *Func = F;   
    assert(Func && "Expected a valid function");

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << Func->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    F->addFnAttr(llvm::Attribute::ReturnsTwice);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *AnyMemCI = IntrinsicInst::get(Context, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, { CI }, "", BB);

     
    F->getBasicBlockList().push_back(BB);

     
    M->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

    F->setDoesNotThrow();

    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::ctlz && "Expected llvm.ctlz intrinsic");

     
    simplifyCall(CI);

     
    Value *Cond = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);

    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(Cond, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type must be integer");

     
    simplifySelectInst(SI);

    std::cout << "Test cases generated successfully!" << std::endl;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Use.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Args[0];
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, Args, {}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected a memory intrinsic");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    
     
    if (AMII->isAtomic() && !AMII->isVolatile()) {
        uint64_t NumBytes = AMII->getArgOperand(2)->getZExtValue();
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % 8 != 0, "Expected non-positive length or not a multiple of element size");
    }
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
        assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase instruction");
        
         
        auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
        Value *CtxI = CB;
        assert(isa<CallBase>(CtxI) && "Expected CtxI to be a CallBase");
        
         
         
    }
    
     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::makeICmp(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(TrueVal, FalseVal, true, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(SI->getCondition() && "Expected a valid condition");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue() && "Expected a valid true value");
    assert(SI->getFalseValue() && "Expected a valid false value");
    
     
    if (auto *ICmp = dyn_cast<ICmpInst>(SI->getCondition())) {
        if (ICmp->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && ICmp->getOperand(0) == TrueVal && isa<ConstantInt>(ICmp->getOperand(1))) {
            auto *Cst = cast<ConstantInt>(ICmp->getOperand(1));
            assert(Cst->getZExtValue() == 2, "Expected specific constant for ICMP");
        }
    }
    
     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    Type *CondType = SI->getCondition()->getType();
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && (CondType->isIntegerTy() || CondType->isVectorTy()), "Expected integer or vector types");
    
     
     
    
    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    if (verifyModule(*Mod, &outs())) {

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *Mod = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    AllocaInst *Alloca = new AllocaInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, "arg_alloca", BB->getTerminator());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Alloca}, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {CI}, "", BB);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        std::cout << "Intrinsic call is a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Intrinsic call is not a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = CI;
    if (CallBase *CBCtx = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CB)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;
    if (BB->getTerminator()->isConditional()) {
        L = LI.AllocateLoop();
        L->initialize(BB);
    }

     
    if (L->getLoopPreheader() && L->getLoopLatch()) {
        std::cout << "Loop has valid preheader and latch blocks." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop does not have valid preheader and latch blocks." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (L->isSafeToClone()) {
        std::cout << "Loop is safe to clone." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop is not safe to clone." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) {
        std::cout << "Loop header's address is not taken." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop header's address is taken." << std::endl;
    }

     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    if (ULO.Count > 0) {
        std::cout << "Loop unroll count is greater than zero." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop unroll count is not greater than zero." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, {TrueVal}, "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    if (SI->getCondition() && SI->getTrueValue() && SI->getFalseValue()) {
        std::cout << "Select instruction has valid condition, true value, and false value." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Select instruction does not have valid condition, true value, or false value." << std::endl;
    }

     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    if (SelType) {
        std::cout << "Select instruction has a correct type." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Select instruction does not have a correct type." << std::endl;
    }

     
    delete SI;
    delete Mod;
    return 0;
}
