int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, Args, "", BB);

     
    Use &U = CI->use_begin();
    Value *User = U.getUser();
    assert(User && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    Intrinsic::ID Intr = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getIntrinsic(Intr, {}), Args, "", BB);
    assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::fabs, {TrueVal->getType()}), TrueVal, "", BB);
    ICmpInst *Cond = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(Cond, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be created successfully");

     
     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkCallInstConstraints(const CallInst &CI) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;

     
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow()) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) return false;
    Intrinsic::ID id = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)->getIntrinsicID();
    if (id != Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) return false;

     
    if (auto *MI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(&CI)) {
        int NumBytes = MI->getNumMemOperands();
        if (NumBytes > 0 && !(NumBytes % sizeof(int) == 0)) return false;  
    }

     
    return true;
}

int main() {
    std::cout << "Starting test generation based on constraints...\n";

     
    BasicBlock *BB = nullptr;
    Instruction *I = nullptr;
    CallInst CI(I, {}, "", BB);

    if (checkCallInstConstraints(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst satisfies all constraints.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not satisfy some constraints.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;

    return 0;

    assert(!UserVal && "CI must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->removeFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::not_intrinsic;
    if (Function *F = M.getFunction("llvm.memset.p0i8.i64")) {

    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "", F->getEntryBlock().getFirstNonPHI());
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
    FunctionType* FuncType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
    CallBase* CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "", BB);
    
     
    BB->push_back(CI);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    assert(dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic.");
    
     
    CallBase* CtxCI = dyn_cast<CallBase>(BB->front().getTerminator());
    assert(CtxCI && "Context instruction must be a CallBase.");
    
     
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test", Context);
  
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
  
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  Instruction *I = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
  
   
  assert(!I->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

   
  F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
  assert(!F->hasFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function should be marked as nounwind");

   
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(I)) {
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be a memset intrinsic");
  } else {
    errs() << "Not an intrinsic call\n";
    return -1;
  }

   
  Loop *L = nullptr;  
  assert(L && "Loop must be initialized");
  assert(L->isLoopExitBasicBlock(BB) && "Loop exit block should be set correctly");

   
  assert(!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop header must not have its address taken");
  unsigned UnrollCount = 4;
  assert(UnrollCount > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

   
  Type *Ty = F->getReturnType();
  assert((Ty == Type::getInt32Ty(Context)) && "Function return type should be i32");

   

  outs() << "All assertions passed!\n";
  return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Value::use_empty() ? Value() : CI);  

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
            Value *NumBytes = nullptr;  
            if (!NumBytes || (NumBytes && cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->isZero())) {
                std::cerr << "Error: Invalid or zero length operation for memset intrinsic." << std::endl;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Error: The call instruction is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Module->print(llvm::outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *VecTy = VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4);
    Constant *C0 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Instruction *InsElem = InsertElementInst::Create(UndefValue::get(VecTy), C0, C0, "", BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), InsElem->getType(), insertelement(UndefValue::get(VecTy), C0, 0), "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setFnAttr("nounwind", true);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument((Value *)CI);
    assert(Pos.getKind() == IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");

     
    Function *Func = Pos.getAssociatedFunction();
    assert(Func && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");

     
     
     
    TreeEntry *E = new TreeEntry();
    E->Scalars.push_back(VecTy);
    MinBWs[E] = 32;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() != nullptr && "Loop must have a valid preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() != nullptr && "Loop must have a valid latch block");
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop must be safe to clone");
    assert(!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop header's address must not be taken");

     
    UnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

     
     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/KnownBits.h>

using namespace llvm;

class Test {
public:
    void run() {
         
        Function *func = nullptr;  
        CallBase CI(*func);  

        if (!CI.use_empty()) {
            std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use.\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
        }

         
        if (func->doesNotThrow()) {
            std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind.\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
        }

         
        Intrinsic::ID intrinsicType = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
        CallInst *intrinCall = CallInst::Create(Type::getVoidTy(*func->getContext()), intrinsicType, {});
        if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(intrinCall)) {
            std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
        }

         
        Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(*func->getContext()), 1.0);
        Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(*func->getContext()), -1.0);
        ICmpInst *CondVal = new ICmpInst(ICmpInst::FCMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(*func->getContext()), 2.0));
        SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal);

         
        Type *SelType = SI->getType();
        if (SelType->isFloatTy()) {
            std::cout << "SelectInst type is valid.\n";
        } else {
            std::cout << "SelectInst type is not valid.\n";
        }

         
    }
};

int main() {
    Test t;
    t.run();
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrinsicId = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), IntrinsicId), {}, "", Func->getEntryBlock().getFirstInsertionPt());
    
     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    
     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);
    
     
    if (IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (AnyMemIntrinsic *AMIntr = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
             
            uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
            if (NumBytes > 0 && !isMultiple(NumBytes, Func->getFunctionType()->getParamType(0)->getScalarSizeInBits())) {
                errs() << "Intrinsic call meets constraints.\n";
            } else {
                errs() << "Intrinsic call does not meet atomic unordered memory intrinsic conditions.\n";
            }
        }
    }
    
     
    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, AttributeKind::Returned, Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;  
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    Args.push_back(Arg);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == IntrID && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    if (II->isMemIntrinsic()) {
        Value *NumBytes = II->getArgOperand(1);  
        assert(!isa<ConstantInt>(NumBytes) || cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().ule(0), "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }

     
    F->print(errs());
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Args[] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1) };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::memcpy, Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Args, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        auto *IMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        assert(IMI && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

         
        if (IMI->isAtomic() && !IMI->isVolatile()) {
            int64_t NumBytes = IMI->getLength();
            assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % sizeof(int8_t) != 0, "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
        }
    }

     
    if (auto *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB);
        assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT, "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    }

     

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;

    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "foo", &M);

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Instruction *I = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);

     
    I->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(I);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "Expected memset intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(I);
    assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase instruction");
    if (CB->arg_size() > 0) {
        Value *Arg = CB->getArgOperand(0);
         
    }

     

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);  

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    Instruction *Call = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    Call->addUse(Value *(), nullptr);

     
    Instruction *CtxI = Call;

     

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CtxI)) {
        std::cerr << "Expected a CallBase instruction." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CtxI);
    if (!II || !II->isLifetimeStartOrEnd()) {
        std::cerr << "Expected a lifetime start or end intrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Loop *L = createLoopFor(BB);
    if (!L) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to create a loop from the basic block." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    llvm::UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    if (ULO.Count <= 0) {
        std::cerr << "Unroll count must be greater than zero." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test setup completed successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Pass.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>

using namespace llvm;

class TestPass : public Pass {
public:
  static char ID;
  TestPass() : Pass(ID) {}

  bool runOnFunction(Function &F) override {
     
    for (auto &BB : F) {
      for (auto &I : BB) {
        if (auto *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(&I)) {
          if (!CI->use_empty()) continue;  
          Function *CalleeF = CI->getCalledFunction();
          if (!CalleeF || CalleeF->doesNotThrow()) continue;  
          if (!isa<IntrinsicInst>(CI) || !dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) continue;  

          auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
          if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
            unsigned NumBytes = 0;  
            if (NumBytes > 0 && NumBytes % sizeof(int) != 0) continue;  
          }

           
          for (auto &Arg : CalleeF->args()) {
            if (Arg.hasParamAttribute(0, Attribute::Returned)) {
               
              auto *L = nullptr;
              for (auto it = loop_begin(&BB), et = loop_end(&BB); it != et; ++it) {
                L = &*it;
                if (!L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) continue;  
                if (!L->isSafeToClone()) continue;  
                if (L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) continue;  
              }

               
              auto *ULO = new LoopUnrollOptions();
              ULO->Count = 2;  
              if (ULO->Count <= 0) continue;

               
              Value *Operand = CI->getArgOperand(0);
              if (!Operand || !isa<FNegInst>(Operand)) continue;
              auto *FI = dyn_cast<FNegInst>(Operand);
              auto *AbsV = CallInst::CreateFNeg(CallInst::CreateFABS(FI->getOperand(0)), "", FI);

               
              APFloat Zero(0.0);
              KnownBits Known(32);
              if (Known != KnownFPClass()) continue;

               
              Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::getTrue(Context, 1);
              Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(*Context), 1.0);
              Value *FalseVal = CallInst::CreateFNeg(CallInst::CreateFABS(FI->getOperand(0)), "", FI);
              if (!CondVal || !TrueVal || !FalseVal) continue;
              Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
              if (!SelType->isIntegerTy()) continue;

               
              IntegerType *ScalarTy = dyn_cast<IntegerType>(E->getOperand(1).back()->getType());
              if (!ScalarTy || !isValidElementType(ScalarTy)) continue;

               
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
};

char TestPass::ID = 0;
static RegisterPass<TestPass> X("test-pass", "Test Pass for LLVM IR Simplification");

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {Arg0, Arg1}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not throw." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst throws." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createFunctionWithIntrinsicCalls() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("testModule", Context);
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "main", &module);
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);

     
    Value *zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, Intrinsic::abs, { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }), { zero }, "", entryBB);

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

    return func;
}

int main() {
    Function *func = createFunctionWithIntrinsicCalls();
    if (!func) {
        errs() << "Failed to create function with intrinsic calls.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    func->print(outs());

    return 0;
}

    assert(func->doesNotThrow() && "Function should be marked as nounwind");
    assert(isa<IntrinsicInst>(ci) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *intrinsic = cast<IntrinsicInst>(ci);
    assert(intrinsic->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy || intrinsic->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset, "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");

    }

    Value *trueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *falseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    SelectInst *sel = SelectInst::Create(condVal, trueVal, falseVal, "", bb);
    assert(sel != nullptr && "SelectInst should be non-null");

     
    Type *selType = sel->getType();
    assert(selType->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type should be integer");

    Instruction *fabsInst = CallInst::CreateFABS(x, "", bb);
    assert(fabsInst != nullptr && "fabs instruction should be created");
    Instruction *fnegInst = CallInst::CreateFNEG(fabsInst, "", bb);
    assert(fnegInst != nullptr && "fneg instruction should be created");

    assert(known == KnownFPClass() && "Known must be in an uninitialized state");

    const int MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;

    assert(!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop header's address should not be taken");

    ULO.Count = 2;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    if (CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, F->getArg(0), "", BB);

     
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::load || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::store) {
         
        Value *Ptr = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
        LoadInst *LI = new LoadInst(PointerType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), Ptr, "", BB);
        LI->setAlignment(MaybeAlign(1));  
    }

    std::cout << "Test program generated successfully!\n";
    return 0;
}

    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses. Test setup failed." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow() || CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function or CallInst does not meet the nounwind condition. Test setup failed." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic or not an AnyMemIntrinsic. Test setup failed." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test setup completed successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "The CallInst itself should not be nounwind.");
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function must be marked as nounwind.");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic.");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance.");

     
    auto IRPos = CB->getCalledOperand()->getValueID();
    assert(IRPos == Value::InstructionVal && "The IRPosition must have a position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT.");

     
    Function *Func = CB->getFunction();
    assert(Func && "The function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null.");

     
    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Basic Block: " << BB->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

    std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;

    SimplifyIndvar(CI);
  }

  return 0;

    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *AnyMem = Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic;  
    CallInst *IntrCall = CallInst::Create(AnyMem, {CI}, "", BB);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind and does not throw");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(IntrCall) && "Intrinsic call must be of type AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    new SimplifyCFGPass( ).run(*BB, *F);

    std::cout << "Test case generated successfully!" << std::endl;
    return 0;

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

void generateTestCode(LLVMContext &context, Module &module) {
     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(context), {}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", module);

     
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(context, "", func);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(context)}, {}, "", entryBB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(context));
    }

     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        AnyMemIntrinsic *anyMem = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        if (anyMem) {
            int NumBytes = 0;  
            if (NumBytes > 0 && !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes, elementSize)) {
                 
                CI->setArgOperand(2, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(context), NumBytes));
            }
        }
    }

     
    Argument *arg = func->args().begin();
    arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext context;
    Module module("testModule", context);
    generateTestCode(context, module);
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->setParamAttribute(0, AttributeSet::ReturnIndex, Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(*F->arg_begin());
    }
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);
    
     
    if (!dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        CI = new AnyMemIntrinsic(CI->getOpcode(), Type::getInt8Ty(Context), {Arg}, "", BB);
    }
    
     
    assert(!F->hasFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind) && "Function should be marked as nounwind");
    
     
    M->print(errs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {PointerType::getInt8PtrTy(Context), PointerType::getInt8PtrTy(Context)}, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is a valid memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not a valid memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        Value *SimplifiedValue = CI;  
        if (SimplifiedValue != CI) {
            std::cout << "CallInst simplified." << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << "CallInst could not be simplified." << std::endl;
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Use.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 5);
    Argument *A1 = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg1", nullptr, &M);
    A1->addIncoming(Arg1, BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, {A1}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be marked as nounwind");
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function should now be marked as nounwind");

     
    Intrinsic::ID MemIntrinsicID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *MemCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, MemIntrinsicID), CI->getType(), {CI}, "", BB);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MemCI)) {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(MemCI)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

    F->setNoUnwind();

    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    
     
    uint64_t NumBytes;
    bool isNonPositiveOrNotMultipleOfElementSize = true;  
    assert(isNonPositiveOrNotMultipleOfElementSize && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

    assert(AI.hasAttr(Attribute::Returned) && "Function should have at least one argument with the Returned attribute");

    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    assert(Pos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition should have the CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT kind");
    
     
    Function *Func = Pos.getFunction();
    assert(Func && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry should have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry *, Type *> MinBWs;
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getPrimitiveSizeInBits() > 0 && "MinBWs entry should provide a valid bit width");
    }
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize && E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "TreeEntry State must be SplitVectorize and CombinedEntriesWithIndices should contain exactly two entries");
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat::fltNaN());
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 0.0);
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(isa<ConstantExpr>(TrueVal) && cast<ConstantExpr>(TrueVal)->getOpcode() == Instruction::FNeg && "TrueVal should be a fneg operation");
    assert(isa<ConstantExpr>(FalseVal) && cast<ConstantExpr>(FalseVal)->getOpcode() == Instruction::FABS && "FalseVal should be a fabs operation");
    assert(isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal) && cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal)->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && "CondVal should be an icmp ult comparison");
    
     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && "SelectInst type should be integer or vector integer type");
    Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
    assert((CondType->isIntegerTy() || CondType->isVectorTy()) && "Condition type should be scalar or vector integer type");
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement && "TreeEntry State must be Vectorize and opcode must be InsertElement");
    
     
    assert(!E->getOperand(1).back()->getType()->isVectorTy() && "Last operand of E->getOperand(1) should not be a vector type");
    
     
    Type *ScalarTy = getElementType(*VL.begin());
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy should be a valid element type");
    
     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        Type *PrecomputedSmallerType = MinBWs[E];
        assert(PrecomputedSmallerType->getPrimitiveSizeInBits() > 0 && "Precomputed smaller type should have a valid bit width");
    } else if (E->Idx == 0 && E->isReducedBitcastRoot()) {
         
        assert(E->isReducedBitcastRoot() && "E should be a reduced bitcast root");
    }
    
     
    Instruction *I = nullptr;  
    assert(isa<FNegInst>(I) && "Instruction should be a fneg instruction");
    
     
    FPClassKnown FPClassInfo = {};  
    assert(FPClassInfo == FPClassKnown() && "KnownFPClass should be in an uninitialized state");
    
     
    unsigned Depth = 0;  
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth should not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    
     
    FPClassTest Mask = {};  
    assert(Mask.isValid() && "DemandedMask should be a valid FPClassTest value");
    
     
    Value *VL[1] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0) };
    Value *Mask[1] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0) };
    uint64_t SliceSize, Part;

    std::cout << "All assertions passed." << std::endl;
    return 0;

    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

        assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Expected CallInst to be an intrinsic call\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;

    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(FT, F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst* MemCpyCall = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, ID), CI, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(MemCpyCall) && "Must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(MemCpyCall) && "Must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic* MemIntrinsic = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(MemCpyCall);
    int NumBytes = 0;  
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !((NumBytes % 8) == 0) && "Must be non-positive or not a multiple of element size");

     

    std::cout << "Module: " << *M << std::endl;

    delete M;
    return 0;

    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "myfunc", Module.get());

    Instruction *Inst = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);

     
    Inst->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

    if (!Inst->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "The CallInst has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    if (Func->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Function is marked as nounwind.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(Inst)) {
        errs() << "The instruction is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The instruction is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>
#include <vector>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Function *IntrinFunc = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset, { Arg->getType() });
    std::vector<Value *> Args = { Builder.CreatePointerCast(Arg, IntegerType::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt64Ty(Context), 1) };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(IntrinFunc, Args, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
         
        if (Intrinsic::memset == CI->getIntrinsicID()) {
            Value *Length = Builder.CreateZExt(ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt64Ty(Context), 0), IntegerType::getInt8Ty(Context));
            CallInst *MemSetCall = CallInst::Create(CI, Length, "", BB);
        }
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty() && isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
         
        simplifyCall(CI);
    }

     
    Loop *L = new Loop(*BB, nullptr);
    L->initializeLoopInfo();

     
    if (L->getLoopPreheader() && L->getLoopLatch()) {
         
        llvm::UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
        ULO.Count = 2;
        unrollLoopWithMetadata(*F, *L, ULO);
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked as nounwind");
    CI->setIsNoUnwind();  
    assert(CI->isNoUnwind() && "CallInst must be marked as nounwind");

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CI->setCalledFunction(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID));
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    if (AMII->isAtomic() && !AMII->isUnordered()) {
        uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !(NumBytes % AMII->getElementSize()), "For atomic unordered memory intrinsics, length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     

    return 0;
}

            outs() << "Function is marked as nounwind.\n";

            errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
        }
    } else {
        errs() << "Function does not exist.\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        outs() << "CallInst does not throw.\n";

        errs() << "CallInst throws.\n";

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI;
    if (true) {   
        CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::sqrt, {}, "", BB);
    } else {
        CI = CallInst::CreateCall({}, "someOtherInstr", BB);
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must have at least one use to trigger simplification.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic.\n";
    } else {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "BasicBlock: " << BB->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    std::vector<Value *> Args = { Arg1 };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, Args, "", BB);
    
     
    Use &U = CI->use_begin();
    assert(!U.getUser()->isLandingPadInst() && "Use is not a landing pad instruction");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemset && "Not an anymemset intrinsic");
    } else {
        assert(false && "CI is not an intrinsic call");
    }
    
     
    
    std::cout << "Test case constructed successfully!\n";
    return 0;
}

            }
        }
    }

    return 0;

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkAndUpdate(const IRPosition &pos, const DataLayout &DL) {
   
  return true;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module module("test_module", Context);
  FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *mainFunc = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "main", &module);
  BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", mainFunc);

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&module, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", entryBB);

   
  CI->addUse(Value::use_iterator(), Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

   
  mainFunc->setDoesNotThrow();
  mainFunc->setNoUnwind();

   
  if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
    errs() << "CI is an intrinsic call\n";
  } else {
    errs() << "CI is not an intrinsic call\n";
  }

   
  if (checkAndUpdate(IRPosition::callsite_argument(*mainFunc, CI), module.getDataLayout())) {
    errs() << "Constraints satisfied\n";
  } else {
    errs() << "Constraints not satisfied\n";
  }

  return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "main", M);
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
    SmallVector<Value*, 0> Args;
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, Args, "", BB);
    
     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(CI);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    } else {
        std::cerr << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    
     
    outs() << "All constraints satisfied\n";
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg1 = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg1", (Function *)0);
    Arg1->setArgNo(0);
    F->getArgumentList().push_back(Arg1);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg1}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {Arg1}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(II) && "The instruction must be an intrinsic call");

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII->getLength() <= 0 && "For atomic unordered memory intrinsics, the length must be non-positive");

     
    CallBase *CB = CI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CB) && "The context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRExp = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CI);
    assert(IRExp.isValid() && "IRPosition must be valid");

     
    Function *Func = IRExp.getAnchorScope();
    assert(Func && "The function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");

     

    std::cout << "All conditions satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be created successfully");

     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    SI->setOperand(0, CondVal);
    SI->setOperand(1, TrueVal);
    SI->setOperand(2, FalseVal);

     
    assert(!SI->isUndef() && "SelectInst should not be undefined");

     
    Loop *L = new Loop(*BB, nullptr);
    BasicBlock *PreHeader = BB;
    BasicBlock *Latch = BB;
    L->setLoopPreheader(PreHeader);
    L->setLoopLatch(Latch);

     
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop must be safe to clone");
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() != nullptr && "Loop must have a preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() != nullptr && "Loop must have a latch block");

     
    UnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    LoopUnroller LU(&ULO, &M);
    LU.unrollLoop(L);

     
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();

     
    Value *Vec = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    Vec = InsertElementInst::Create(Vec, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), "", BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->setCalledFunction(F);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {Vec}, "", BB);
    II->setArgOperand(0, Vec);

     
    ConstantInt *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), -1);
    II->setArgOperand(1, NumBytes);

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(II);

     
    if (CB) {
        IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB->getCalledOperand(), 0, &M);
        assert(!Pos.isNull() && "IRPosition should not be null");

         
        Function *Func = Pos.getFunction();
        assert(Func && "Function should not be null");

         
    }

     
    Loop *L = new Loop(&BB->front(), &M, nullptr, BB);
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop preheader should be non-null");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop latch should be non-null");

     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, TrueVal, "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, CmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Select type should be integer");
    assert(SI->getCondition()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Condition type should be integer");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "True value type should be integer");
    assert(SI->getFalseValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "False value type should be integer");

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    unsigned NumBytes = 0;
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
        Value *LenVal = II->getArgOperand(2);
        ConstantInt *LenCI = dyn_cast<ConstantInt>(LenVal);
        assert(LenCI && "Length must be a constant integer");
        NumBytes = LenCI->getZExtValue();
    }
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes) && "Atomic unordered memory intrinsics with non-positive length or not a multiple of element size should trigger undefined behavior handling code path");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRPosition::CallSiteArgument && "IRPosition must have a position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     
    Function *Func = IRPos.getAnchorScope();
    assert(Func && "Function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");

     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry object must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E].hasValue() && "MinBWs map entry for E must provide a valid bit width");
    }

     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize && "TreeEntry state must be SplitVectorize");
    assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");

     
    SelectInst *SI = dyn_cast<SelectInst>(CI);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be structured such that the simplification does not occur");
    Value *CondVal = SI->getCondition();
    Value *TrueVal = SI->getTrueValue();
    Value *FalseVal = SI->getFalseValue();
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(CondVal && TrueVal && FalseVal && SelType && "SelectInst must have valid CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, and SelType");

     
    ICmpInst *ICmp = dyn_cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal);
    assert(ICmp && ICmp->getPredicate() == ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT && "Condition must be an icmp ult comparison");
    ConstantInt *Cst = dyn_cast<ConstantInt>(ICmp->getOperand(1));
    assert(Cst && Cst->isZero() && "icmp ult condition must compare TrueVal with integer constant 2");

     
    Type *CondType = ICmp->getType();
    assert((CondType->isIntegerTy() || CondType->isVectorTy()) && (SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && "SelectInst types must be compatible");

     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement && "TreeEntry state must be Vectorize and opcode must be InsertElement");

     
    Value *LastOp = E->getOperand(1)->back();
    assert(!LastOp->getType()->isVectorTy() && "The type of the last operand of E->getOperand(1) must not be a vector type");

     
    Type *ScalarTy = getElementTypeOrSelf(VL[0]);
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy derived from VL[0] must be a valid element type");

     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E].hasValue() && "MinBWs map must contain an entry for E");
    } else if (E->Idx == 0 && isReducedBitcastRoot()) {
         
        updateScalarTypeFromReducedBitcast();
    }

     
    Instruction *I = dyn_cast<Instruction>(CI);
    assert(I && I->getOpcode() == Instruction::FNeg && "Input instruction must be of type FNeg");
    Value *Op = I->getOperand(0);
    if (auto *AbsInst = dyn_cast<UnaryOperator>(Op)) {
        Op = AbsInst->getOperand(0);
    }
    assert(isOneUse(Op) && "Operand must have exactly one use");

     
    FPClass Known;
    assert(Known == KnownFPClass() && "Known must be in an uninitialized state");
    int Depth = 0;
    const int MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    assert(DemandedMask.isValid() && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");
    Type *IType = I->getType();
    assert((IType->isIntegerTy() || IType->isVectorTy()) && IType->getScalarSizeInBits() == DemandedMask.bitWidth() && "DemandedMask must match the type of I");

     
    Value *SliceSize = nullptr;  
    Value *Part = nullptr;  
    uint64_t MaskBase = computeMaskBase(SliceSize, Part);
    assert(MaskBase != UINT_MAX && "MaskBase must be correctly computed");

    std::cout << "All assertions passed." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = Argument::Create(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", F);
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, AttributeSet::get(Context, 0, Attribute::Returned));

     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, (Value *)F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindBehavior(Function::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Type::getVoidTy(Context), Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {}, BB);
    II->addOperand(CI);

     
    II->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Mod.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    Module M("my_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::sqrt;  
    std::vector<Value *> Args = {Arg};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Builder.getInt32Ty());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected a memory intrinsic");

     
    Value *TrueVal = Builder.getInt32(1);
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.getInt32(0);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Builder.getInt32Ty(), 2), "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(TrueVal->getType() == Builder.getInt32Ty());
    assert(FalseVal->getType() == Builder.getInt32Ty());
    assert(CondVal->getType() == Builder.getInt1Ty());

     
    Loop *L = new Loop(&BB, nullptr);
    UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;  
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

     
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && !L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken());

     
    assert(CI->getNumUses() > 0 && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be nounwind and call does not throw");
    assert(II->isMemoryInstruction() && "Expected a memory intrinsic");
    assert(CondVal->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Condition type must be integer");

     
    CI->eraseFromParent();
    SI->eraseFromParent();
    delete L;

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context), false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    AllocaInst* AI = new AllocaInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, "arg", BB->getFirstInsertionPt());
    
     
    LoadInst* LI = new LoadInst(AI, "", false, BB->getFirstInsertionPt());
    
     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(LI, {}, "", BB->getLastNonDebugInstruction());
    
     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    
     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic or not a memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    Value* TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
    Value* FalseVal = ICmpInst::makeICmp(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst* SI = new SelectInst(FalseVal, TrueVal, TrueVal, "", BB->getLastNonDebugInstruction());
    
     
    if (!SI || !TrueVal->getType()->isIntegerTy() || !FalseVal->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        std::cerr << "SelectInst does not have valid operands or type." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (!TrueVal || !FalseVal) {
        std::cerr << "Invalid TrueVal or FalseVal in SelectInst." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     

     
    if (verifyModule(*Module, &outs())) {
        errs() << "Module verification failed!\n";
        return 1;
    }

    outs() << "Test module successfully created.\n";
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();  
    Instruction *CallInst = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::abs), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    Use &U = CallInst->use_begin();
    U.getUser()->print(errs()); errs() << "\n";

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CallInst);
    if (II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::abs) {
        std::cout << "Intrinsic check passed!\n";
    } else {
        std::err << "Intrinsic check failed!\n";
    }

     
    if (!CallInst->use_empty()) {
        CallInst->replaceAllUsesWith(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42));
        CallInst->eraseFromParent();
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);
    
     
    Value *Args[1] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0) };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Func->getFunctionType(), Func, makeArrayRef(Args), "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(CI->getType());
    
     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (const auto *AnyMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
            if (AnyMI->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
                 
                ConstantInt *LengthCI = cast<ConstantInt>(AnyMI->getArgOperand(2));
                if (LengthCI->isZero()) {
                     
                    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
                    Func->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
                    
                     
                    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memset.p0i8.i64", FunctionType::get(Builder.getVoidTy(), {PointerType::get(IntegerType::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), IntegerType::getInt8Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt64Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt1Ty(Context)}, false));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {ConstantExpr::getBitCast(Arg, PointerType::get(IntegerType::getInt8Ty(Context), 0)), ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt8Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt64Ty(Context), 8), ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt1Ty(Context), false)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    uint64_t NumBytes = 8;
    assert(NumBytes <= 0 || (NumBytes % sizeof(int8_t) != 0) && "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");

     
    legacy::PassManager Passes;
    Passes.add(createInstructionCombiningPass());
    Passes.run(*F);

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Value* createIntrinsicCall(LLVMContext &Ctx, Module &M) {
    Function *F = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {}, "", nullptr);
    return CI;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("test_module", Ctx);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = cast<Function>(M.getOrInsertFunction("test_func", FTy));
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    CallInst *CI = createIntrinsicCall(Ctx, M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    Builder.CreateRet(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0));

     
    BB->begin()->insert(BB->begin(), CI);
    assert(!CI.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    assert((F->getFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind) || F->doesNotThrow()) && "Function must be marked as nounwind or call should not throw");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_intrinsic;
        if (!CI->getIntrinsicID(IID) || IID != Intrinsic::memcpy) {
            std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not a memory intrinsic or does not match expected type." << std::endl;
            return 1;
        }
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->getArg(0);
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *VecTy = VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4);
    Instruction *InsertElem = InsertElementInst::Create(UndefValue::get(VecTy), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), "", BB);

     
    assert(InsertElem->getNumOperands() == 3 && "InsertElementInst should have three operands");
    assert(InsertElem->getOperand(0)->getType()->isVectorTy() && "First operand should be a vector");
    assert(InsertElem->getOperand(1)->getType()->isIntegerTy(32) && "Second operand should be an integer");
    assert(InsertElem->getOperand(2)->getType()->isIntegerTy(32) && "Third operand should be an integer");

     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst should have at least one use");
    assert(!F->hasFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind) && !CI->doesNotThrow() && "Function and CallInst must be marked nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst should be an intrinsic call for memory operations");

     

     
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::memset;  
    Value *MemSetIntrin = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)});
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(MemSetIntrin, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
         
        if (!II->isZeroLength()) {
            int NumBytes = 4;  
            II->setArgOperand(0, ConstantExpr::getZExt(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), NumBytes), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));
        }
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
