int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());

     
    Argument *Arg = F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *IntrinsicArgs[] = {Arg};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(getIntrinsicID(Intrinsic::memcpy), IntrinsicArgs, {}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(...);  
    }

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be nounwind");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "Expected an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
        assert(II->getNumOperands() > 0 && "Expected at least one operand for intrinsic");
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test case generated successfully!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createFunctionWithCallInst(Module &M) {
  LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();

   
  Type *VoidTy = Type::getVoidTy(Ctx);
  std::vector<Type *> ArgTys;
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(VoidTy, ArgTys, false);

   
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

   
  Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 42);
  F->arg_begin()->setName("arg1");

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg1}, "", BB);

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->setUnwindPredecessor(BB);

  return F;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Ctx;

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test", Context);

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
  assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must not be marked as nounwind");
  assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
  IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
  assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II) && "Intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");

   
  F->setDoesNotThrow();
  F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
  F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

   
  CallBase *CB = CI;
  assert(isa<CallBase>(CB) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

   
  auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CI);
  assert(IRPos.isValid() && "IRPosition must be valid");
  assert(IRPos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition kind must be CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

   
  if (!CI->use_empty()) {
    SimplifyQuery SQ;
    Value *Simplified = simplifyCall(CI, F->getReturnType(), CI->getArgList(), &SQ);
    if (Simplified) {
      CI->replaceAllUsesWith(Simplified);
      CI->eraseFromParent();
    }
  }

   
  M.print(errs(), nullptr);

  return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test_module", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::anymemset), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    assert(Func->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    IntrinsicInst *AII = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(AII->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemset && "Must be anymemset intrinsic");

     
    if (!AII->isZeroLength()) {
        std::cerr << "Intrinsic call must have a non-zero length" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    FunctionType *FTy = cast<FunctionType>(Func->getFunctionType());
    if (FTy->getNumParams() == 0) {
        Func->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);
    }

    std::cout << "Module: " << Module->getName().str() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Function: " << Func->getName().str() << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

                }
            }
        }
    }

    }

     
    Module->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;

    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "The context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

    return 0;

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool isCallInstUsed(const CallInst &CI) {
  return !CI.use_empty();
}

bool isFunctionNounwind(const Function &F) {
  return F.doesNotThrow();
}

bool isIntrinsicCall(const CallInst &CI) {
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) {
    return II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic;
  }
  return false;
}

bool hasAtLeastOneArgumentWithReturnedAttr(const Function &F) {
  for (auto &Arg : F.args()) {
    if (Arg.hasRetainedAttr()) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Context;
  Module M("test_module", Context);

   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

   
  Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
  CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(F->getFunctionType(), Callee, "", BB);

   
  assert(hasAtLeastOneArgumentWithReturnedAttr(*F) && "Function must have at least one argument with returned attribute");

   
  assert(isCallInstUsed(*CI) && "CallInst must have at least one use");
  assert(isFunctionNounwind(*F) && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
  assert(isIntrinsicCall(*CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

  std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;

  return 0;
}

#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instruction.h"

#include "llvm/IR/IRBuilder.h"

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Use &U = F->back().use_begin();
    Instruction *User = cast<Instruction>(U.getUser());
    assert(User && "CallInst must have at least one user");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "Intrinsic must be memcpy");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

        return 1;

            assert(AII && "CallInst must be an AtomicCmpXchgInst");

                return 1;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    BB->getInstList().push_back(ConstantExpr::getBitCast(Zero, Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));

     
    CallBase *CI = CallBase::Create(FTy, Zero, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->use_begin();

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(&M.getContext());

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic;  
    CallBase *IntrCall = CallBase::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), IID, {}, "", BB);

     
    IntrCall->setDoesNotThrow();
    IntrCall->setUnwindDest(&M.getContext());

     
    Value *One = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    BB->getInstList().push_back(BinaryOperator::CreateAdd(Zero, One, "", BB));

     
    CallBase *CtxCI = cast<CallBase>(BB->front());

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->simplify();
    }

     
    assert(F && "Function should be non-null");

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(SelectInst::Create(ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Zero, One), Zero, One, "", BB));

     
    SelectInst *SI = cast<SelectInst>(BB->getInstList().back());
    Value *CondVal = SI->getCondition();
    Value *TrueVal = SI->getTrueValue();
    Value *FalseVal = SI->getFalseValue();
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();

     
    assert(CondVal && TrueVal && FalseVal && SelType && "SelectInst should be valid");

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(TrueVal, "", BB));

     
    KnownFPClass Known;
    assert(Known.isUnknown() && "Known should be in an uninitialized state");

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::fabs, TrueVal, {}, "", BB));

     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth should not exceed maximum allowed recursion depth");

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, TrueVal, {}, "", BB));

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Callee, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Instruction::IntToPtr, CI, "", BB);
    assert(II && "Failed to create intrinsic instruction");

     
    II->addUse(*CI);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 2);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI, TrueVal, "cond", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Select type must be integer");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue()->getType() == SI->getFalseValue()->getType() && "True and false values must have same type");

     
    Loop *L = new Loop();
    L->addBlockToList(BB);

     
    BasicBlock *PreHeader = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    BasicBlock *Latch = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    L->setLoopPreheader(PreHeader);
    L->setLoopLatch(Latch);

     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

     
    Value *X = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Instruction *FNegInst = new FNegInst(X, "", BB);

     
    KnownFPClass Known;
    assert(Known == KnownFPClass() && "Known must be in an uninitialized state");

     
    LegacyPassManager Passes;
    Passes.add(createInstructionCombiningPass());
    Passes.run(*F);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "main", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindPredecessor(BB);

     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be created successfully.");

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;
    if (LoopInfo LI(*F)) {
        L = &*LI.begin();
    }
    assert(L && "Loop must exist in the function.");

     
    BasicBlock *PreHeaderBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    BasicBlock *LatchBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    L->setLoopLatch(LatchBB);
    L->addPredecessor(PreHeaderBB);
    L->addSuccessor(LatchBB);
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop must have a preheader block.");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have a latch block.");

     
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && !L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop must be safe to clone and header should not have its address taken.");

     
    M.print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

  F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

    std::cout << "Intrinsic call detected." << std::endl;

    std::cout << "No intrinsic call detected." << std::endl;

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(F->getReturnType());
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        return 1;  
    }

     

    std::cout << "Module:\n" << M << "\n";
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Vec = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    Vec = InsertElementInst::Create(Vec, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), "", BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), Vec, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 4), "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "The intrinsic call must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    if (AMII->isAtomic() || AMII->hasZeroLength()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Atomic or zero-length operation detected\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "The context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CI);
    assert(IRPos.getKind() == IRPOsition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "The IRPosition must have a position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");

     
    Function *Funct = IRPos.getFunction();
    assert(Funct && "The function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");

     
     

    std::cout << "Test passed successfully!\n";
    return 0;
}

    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.memcpy.p0i8.p0i8.i64", Type::getVoidTy(Context),
                                                 PointerType::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0),
                                                 PointerType::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0),
                                                 ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 8));
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, {Arg, Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(*F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call\n";
    }

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        if (II->getNumElements() <= 0 || II->getNumElements() % 8 != 0) {
            errs() << "Length condition met\n";
        } else {
            errs() << "Length condition not met\n";
        }
    }

     
    M.print(errs(), nullptr);
}

CallInst* createIntrinsicCall(LLVMContext &Ctx, Module *M) {
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "intrinsic_call", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::abs), {}, "");
    return CI;
}

    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("module", Ctx);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = createIntrinsicCall(Ctx, &M);
    assert(!CI.use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        assert(isAnyMemIntrinsic(CI) && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic.");
    }

    return 0;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, {Arg1}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);

     
    SimplifyCFGOptions Options;
    FunctionPassManager FPM;
    PassBuilder PB;
    PB.registerFunctionAnalyses(FPM);
    FPM.addPass(createSimplifyCFGPass(Options));
    FPM.run(*F);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty() && dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst meets constraints." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not meet constraints." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {

            if (NumBytes > 0 && !isMultiple(NumBytes, F->getParamType(0)->getScalarSizeInBits())) {
                 
            }
        }
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        SimplifyCallInst(CI);
    }

     
    std::cout << "Generated IR: \n" << *F << "\n";

    return 0;
}

        assert(AC->isUnordered() && "Expected unordered atomic operation");
    }

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    if (CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        assert(CB && "Expected a CallBase instruction");
    } else {
        llvm_unreachable("Expected a CallBase instruction");

    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    Argument *Arg = new Argument(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", Func);
    Arg->setAttr(AttributeIndex, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&Mod, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Value *User = CI;
    if (User.use_empty()) {
        User = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
        CI->replaceAllUsesWith(User);
    }

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) {
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (auto *SimplifiedCI = simplifyCall(CI)) {
        CI->replaceAllUsesWith(SimplifiedCI);
        delete CI;
        CI = SimplifiedCI;
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    if (!CB) {
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setName("input");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memcpy;  
    Function* MemCpyFunc = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, ID);
    std::vector<Value*> Args;
    Args.push_back(ConstantExpr::getPointerNull(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));
    Args.push_back(ConstantExpr::getSizeOf(Type::getInt32Ty(Context)));
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(MemCpyFunc, Args, "", F->getEntryBlock().getFirstInsertionPt());

     
    CI->addUse(*F);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        errs() << "The CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::unique_ptr<CallBase> SimplifiedCI = CI->simplify();
        if (SimplifiedCI) {
            errs() << "The CallInst has been simplified.\n";
        } else {
            errs() << "The CallInst could not be simplified.\n";
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createModule(Module &M) {
   
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(M.getContext()), {}, false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "main", M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(M.getContext(), "", F);

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
  assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
  assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
  assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
  IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
  assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be memcpy intrinsic");

   
  if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
    Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(M.getContext()), 16);
    assert(cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().isNonNegative() && "NumBytes must be non-negative for memcpy intrinsic");
  }

   
  Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(M.getContext()), APInt(32, 1));
  Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(M.getContext()), APInt(32, 2));
  SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(ConstantInt::getTrue(), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
  assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst must be of integer type");
  assert(SI->getCondition()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Condition of SelectInst must be an integer type");
  assert(SI->getTrueValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "True value of SelectInst must be an integer type");
  assert(SI->getFalseValue()->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "False value of SelectInst must be an integer type");

   
  ICmpInst *Cmp = ICmpInst::Create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(M.getContext()), 2), "", BB);
  SI->setCondition(Cmp);

   
  assert(!isa<SelectInst>(SI) && "simplifySelectInst should not have simplified the SelectInst");
  assert(!isSimpleValsForShuffle(SI) && "canonicalizeSelectToShuffle should not have transformed the SelectInst");
  assert(!isScalarOfVecs(SI) && "canonicalizeScalarSelectOfVecs should not have transformed the SelectInst");

#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "Specific intrinsic must be memcpy");

     
    FunctionType *FT = F->getFunctionType();
    if (FT->getNumParams() > 0) {
        FT->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test function created with necessary intrinsic call and attributes.\n";
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    CallBase *CI;
    if (Intrinsic::isSupportedCPU(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic)) {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);
    } else {
         
        std::cerr << "Unsupported intrinsic type" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    }
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic) {
             
            Value *NumBytes = II->getArgOperand(0);
            if (!isa<ConstantInt>(NumBytes) || cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->isZero()) {
                std::cerr << "Zero-length operation detected" << std::endl;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    } else {
        std::cerr << "Not an intrinsic call" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function does not have the 'nounwind' attribute" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    M->print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    Argument *Arg = F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Arg->getType(), Arg->getType()}, {Arg, Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(Builder.CreateICmpULT(Arg, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "SelectInst must have at least one use");
    Type *CondType = SI->getCondition()->getType();
    Type *TrueType = SI->getTrueValue()->getType();
    Type *FalseType = SI->getFalseValue()->getType();
    assert(CondType == TrueType && CondType == FalseType && "SelectInst operands must have the same type");

     
     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy->getPointerTo(), F, { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memset || II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memcpy) {
         
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);  
        CI->setArgOperand(2, NumBytes);
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::memmove) {
         
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);  
        CI->setArgOperand(2, NumBytes);
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::atomic_load || II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::atomic_store) {
         
        Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), -1);  
        CI->setArgOperand(2, NumBytes);
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::fabs) {
         
        Value *X = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
        CI->setArgOperand(0, X);
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::fneg) {
         
        Value *X = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
        CI->setArgOperand(0, X);
    } else if (II->getIntrinsicID() == llvm::Intrinsic::ctpop) {
         
        Value *X = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
        CI->setArgOperand(0, X);
    }

     

    return 0;
}

struct MyPass : public FunctionPass {
  static char ID;
  MyPass() : FunctionPass(ID) {}

  bool runOnFunction(Function &F) override {
    for (auto &BB : F) {
      for (auto &I : BB) {
        if (auto *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(&I)) {

          }
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
};

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Args[1] = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0) };
    CallBase *CI = CallBase::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), Intrinsic::memset, Args, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemory()) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to create a valid AnyMemIntrinsic" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow() || F->isUnwindEnabled()) {
        std::cerr << "Function marking failed" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    F->print(llvm::outs());
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] ========== sample =========
[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

bool satisfiesConstraints(CallInst &CI) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;

     
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func->doesNotThrow() || func->isDeclaration()) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) return false;
    Intrinsic::ID id = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)->getIntrinsicID();
    if (id != Intrinsic::memcpy && id != Intrinsic::memset) return false;

     
    if (auto *MI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(&CI)) {
        uint64_t NumBytes = MI->getNumElements() * MI->getElemSizeInBits();
        if (NumBytes > 0 && NumBytes % 8 == 0) return false;
    }

     

     
    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", M->getFunction("main"));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, BB);

    if (satisfiesConstraints(*CI)) {
        errs() << "Constraints satisfied!\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Constraints not satisfied.\n";
    }

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

        ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0),
        ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1),
        ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 4)
    };

    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::Local);

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use, triggering simplification attempt." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses, cannot trigger simplification." << std::endl;
    }

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Passes/PassBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/Passes/PassPlugin.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createTestModule(LLVMContext &ctx, Module *mod) {
     
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), {}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", mod);
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    func->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    BasicBlock *entryBB = BasicBlock::Create(ctx, "", func);
    IRBuilder<> builder(entryBB);
    Value *arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 1);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(funcType, Intrinsic::memset, {arg}, "", entryBB->getTerminator());

     
    CI->addUse(func->getArg(0));

     
    Value *trueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 1);
    Value *falseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 0);
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CmpInst::create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, CI, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), 2)), trueVal, falseVal, "", entryBB->getTerminator());

     
    Loop *loop = new LoopInfoWrapperPass().getLoopInfo(*func).CreateLoop(entryBB, nullptr);
    UnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    ScalarEvolution SE(*func);
    LoopUnrollAnalysis LUA(SE, loop, ULO);
    if (!loop->isLoopVectorizable()) {
         
        return;
    }

     
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext ctx;
    Module mod("testModule", ctx);
    createTestModule(ctx, &mod);

    std::cout << "Module created with test function and constraints.\n";
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    Value *Callee = nullptr;  
    std::vector<Value *> Args = {Arg};
    CallBase *CI = CallBase::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), Callee, Args, "", BB);

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind while CallInst is not doesNotThrow.");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic) {
            int NumBytes = 0;  
            assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % getElementTypeSize(Arg->getType()) != 0);
        }
    }

     
    CI->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "foo", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, Callee, {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindPredecessor(BB);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, {CI}, "", BB);

     
    if (auto *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        if (!AMII->isZeroLength()) {
            errs() << "Intrinsic has non-zero length.\n";
        }
    } else {
        errs() << "Not an AnyMemIntrinsic.\n";
    }

     

    return 0;
}

            }

        }
    }

     

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *CtxI = CI;
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CtxI)) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
     

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateNeg(Builder.CreateFabs(Arg));
    Type *SelType = FalseVal->getType();
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(Builder.CreateICmpULT(Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal);

     
    if (!TrueVal || !FalseVal || SelType->isVectorTy()) {
        std::cerr << "SelectInst does not meet the required conditions. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!TrueVal->getType()->isIntegerTy() || !FalseVal->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        std::cerr << "SelectInst types do not meet the required conditions. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Loop *L = new Loop();
    L->addBasicBlockToLoop(BB, LI);
    if (!L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) {
        std::cerr << "Loop does not have a valid preheader or latch block. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!L->isSafeToClone() || L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken()) {
        std::cerr << "Loop does not meet safety criteria for cloning. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    UnrollOptions ULO(2);
    if (ULO.Count <= 0) {
        std::cerr << "Unroll count must be greater than zero. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Instruction *I = CI;
    if (!I || !I->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        std::cerr << "Input instruction does not meet the required conditions. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    int Depth = 5;
    if (Depth > MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth) {
        std::cerr << "Recursion depth exceeds maximum allowed. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    KnownFPClass Known;
    if (DemandedMask.getBitWidth() != Known.getBitWidth() || DemandedMask.getBitWidth() != I->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits()) {
        std::cerr << "Demanded mask bit width does not match known or input instruction type bit width. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    unsigned NLZ = 8;
    if (NLZ <= 0) {
        std::cerr << "No unused high bits for wrap flag disabling. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    TreeEntry *TE = nullptr;
    if (TE->Idx == 0 || TE->UserTreeIndex == UINT_MAX) {
        std::cerr << "TreeEntry does not meet the required conditions. Aborting." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    unsigned SliceSize = 4;
    unsigned Part = 2;
    Value *MaskBase = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);

    std::cout << "All conditions met. Test passed." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, { Arg }, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked as nounwind");
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *AII = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(AII && AII->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    
     
    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
    
     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct kind");
    
     
    Function *Funct = IRPos.getFunction();
    assert(Funct && "Function must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry*, Type*> MinBWs;
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getScalarSizeInBits() > 0 && "Precomputed type must have a valid bit width");
    }
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize && "TreeEntry state must be SplitVectorize");
    assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");
    
     
    if (!E->isGather() || !E->TransformedToGatherNodes) {
        assert(E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && "TreeEntry state must be Vectorize for specific opcode");
    }
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::getTrue(Context);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::CreateFNeg(CallInst::CreateFABS(TrueVal, "", BB), "", BB);
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    assert(CondVal && TrueVal && FalseVal && SelType && "SelectInst must have valid condition, true value, false value, and type");
    
     
    ICmpInst *ICmp = ICmpInst::Create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    CondVal = ICmp;
    
     
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && (CondVal->getType()->isIntegerTy() || CondVal->getType()->isVectorTy()));
    
     
    assert(!E->getOperand(1)->getType()->isVectorTy() && "Last operand must not be a vector type");
    
     
    Type *ScalarTy = nullptr;  
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy must be a valid element type");
    
     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        ScalarTy = MinBWs[E];
    } else if (E->Idx == 0 && E->isReducedBitcastRoot()) {
         
        ScalarTy = getTypeForScalarization(*E);
    }
    
     
    Instruction *I = nullptr;  
    assert(I->getOpcode() == Instruction::FNeg && "Instruction must be a FNeg");
    
     
    FPClassKnownBits Known;
    assert(Known.isZero() && "Known must be in an uninitialized state");
    
     
    int Depth = 0;
    const int MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    
     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    assert(DemandedMask.isValid() && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");
    
     
    DenseMap<BasicBlock*, ScheduleState> BlocksSchedules;
    assert(!BlocksSchedules.empty() && "BlocksSchedules map must contain valid entries");
    
     
    std::vector<TreeEntry*> VectorizableTree;
    for (auto &TE : VectorizableTree) {
        assert(!TE->isGather() && !TE->isDeleted() && TE->State != TreeEntry::CombinedVectorization && "Nodes must not be gathered or deleted");
    }
    
     
    Instruction *ReductionRoot = nullptr;  
    assert(ReductionRoot->getParent() && "ReductionRoot must have a parent block");
    
     
    std::vector<std::pair<Value*, APFloat>> VectorValuesAndScales;
     
    
     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->getLoopPreHeader() && L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have a valid preheader and latch block");
    
    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Arg->getType(), Arg}, Arg, "", BB);

     
    Value *User = CI;
    assert(!User.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "CI must be a memset intrinsic");
    } else {
        llvm_unreachable("CI must be an intrinsic call");
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->setArgOperand(0, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    }

     
    legacy::PassManager Passes;
    Passes.add(createPrintModulePass(&llvm::outs()));
    Passes.run(M);

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

 
Value *generateTestCode(Function &F, LLVMContext &Ctx) {
   
  Module M("test", Ctx);
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Ctx), {}, false);
  Function *Func = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

   
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", Func);
  IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

   
  Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::sqrt;  
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {}, "", BB);

   
  CI->addUse(Func->arg_begin());  

   
  Func->setDoesNotThrow();
  Func->setNoUnwind();

   
  if (auto *II = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
    Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Ctx), -1);  
    II->setAtomicOrdering(AtomicOrdering::NotAtomic);
    if (II->isUnordered()) {
       
      if (*NumBytes > 0 && *NumBytes % CI->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() == 0) {
        return nullptr;  
      }
    }
  }

   
  if (CI->getNumUses() > 0 && !CI->use_empty()) {
     
  }

  return CI;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext Ctx;
  generateTestCode(Function(), Ctx);
  return 0;
}

    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());

        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::abs), {}, "", EntryBB);
    } else {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::sqrt), {}, "", EntryBB);
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has uses.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have enough uses.\n";
    }

     
    if (Func->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not throw.\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst throws.\n";
    }

    return 0;

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
  

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/LoopUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument* Arg = &(*F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::memcpy;  
    std::vector<Value*> Args;
    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0));  
    Args.push_back(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), sizeof(int)));  
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), IntrID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(*F);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    if (IntrID == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
        ConstantInt* Length = cast<ConstantInt>(Args[1]);
        int NumBytes = Length->getSExtValue();
         
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % sizeof(int) != 0);
    }

    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);

    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    Use &U = F->back().front().addUse(*CI);

    } else {
        errs() << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }
    
     
    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test_module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    
     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 42));
    Arg = Builder.CreateAlloca(Arg->getType(), nullptr, "arg_ptr");
    Builder.CreateStore(Arg, Arg);
    
     
    LoadInst *Load = Builder.CreateLoad(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Arg);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, { Load }, "", BB->getTerminator());
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setOnlyRetainsAttr("nounwind");
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->isAnyMemoryIntrinsic() && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    if (II->isAtomic()) {
        Value *NumBytes = II->getArgOperand(1);
        assert(cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getValue().isNonNegative() && "NumBytes must be non-positive");
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*II, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have a callsite argument position kind");
    
     
    Function *Funct = II->getFunction();
    assert(Funct && "Associated function must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        auto &entry = MinBWs[E];
        assert(entry.hasValue() && "MinBWs entry must provide a valid bit width");
    }
    
     
    if (E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize) {
        assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");
    } else if (E->isGather() || E->State == TransformedToGatherNodes) {
         
    }
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    Value *FalseVal = Intrinsic::fabs(TrueVal);
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB->getTerminator());
    
     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(SelType->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst must be an integer type");
    
     
    unsigned Depth = 0;  
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    
     
    FPClassTest KnownFPClass();  
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;   
    assert(DemandedMask.getBitWidth() == KnownFPClass().getBitWidth() && "DemandedMask and Known must have the same bit width");
    
     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop must be safe to clone");
    assert(!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop header's address must not be taken");
    
     
    UnrollOption ULO;  
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");
    
     
    Instruction *I = nullptr;  
    assert(I && "Instruction *I must be non-null");
    assert(I->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "I must be an integer or integer vector type with a scalar size in bits equal to the bit width of DemandedMask and Known");
    
     
     
    
    return 0;
}

    F->setNoUnwind();

Function *createFunctionWithCall(LLVMContext &Ctx) {
  Module *M = new Module("test", Ctx);
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

  Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;

  assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
  assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
  assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "Intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");

   

  return F;
}

 
void simplifySelectInst() {
  LLVMContext Ctx;
  Module *M = new Module("test", Ctx);
  FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), false);
  Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "simplifySelectFunc", M);
  BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

  Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), APInt(32, 1));
  Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), APInt(32, 0));
  SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

  assert(isa<SelectInst>(SI) && "SelectInst must be a valid select instruction");

   
  if (auto *SE = SI->hasOneUse()) {
    SI->replaceAllUsesWith(TrueVal);
    SI->eraseFromParent();
  }
}

  LLVMContext Ctx;
  Function *F = createFunctionWithCall(Ctx);
  simplifySelectInst();

   

  std::cout << "Module created with function having call instruction.\n";
  return 0;
}

    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", M);
    
     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument* Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(FT, F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindExceptionHandling();
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CallInst* IntrCall = CallInst::Create(FT, Intrinsic::getIntrinsic(ID), {}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrCall) && "The call must be an intrinsic call");
    
     
    AnyMemIntrinsic* MemIntr = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(IntrCall);
    assert(MemIntr && "The intrinsic must be a memory intrinsic");
    if (MemIntr) {
        int NumBytes = 0;  
        MemIntr->setArgOperandNoWrap(NumBytes);
    }
    
     
    CallBase* CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "The context instruction must be a CallBase");
    
     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    assert(Pos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT kind");
    
     
    Function* FAssoc = Pos.getAssociatedFunction();
    assert(FAssoc && "The function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry* E = nullptr;  
    ScalarTypePtr ScalarTy = getElementType(*E->Scalars.begin());
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy must be a valid element type");
    
     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry*, Type*> MinBWs;
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        IntegerType* IntTy = dyn_cast<IntegerType>(MinBWs[E]);
        assert(IntTy && "Precomputed smaller type must be an integer type");
    }
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement && "TreeEntry must be in Vectorize state with InsertElement opcode");
    
     
    Value* CondVal = ConstantInt::getTrue(Context);  
    Value* TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);  
    Value* FalseVal = CallInst::Create(FT, Intrinsic::ctpop, { TrueVal }, "", BB);  
    Type* SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    assert(SelType && "SelectInst type must be correctly retrievable");
    
    SelectInst* SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(!SI->isConstantSelectedValue() && !SI->isUndefOrPoison() && "SelectInst should not simplify or transform");
    
     
    assert(isa<FPExtInst>(TrueVal) || isa<FPTruncInst>(TrueVal) || isa<UIToFPInst>(TrueVal) || isa<SIToFPInst>(TrueVal) && "TrueVal must be a fpext, fp trunc, uitofp, or sitofp");
    
     
    Type* CondType = CondVal->getType();
    assert((CondType->isIntegerTy() || CondType->isVectorTy()) && (SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && "SelectInst types must be compatible");
    
     
    unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;  
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth must not exceed maximum allowed");
    
     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    assert(DemandedMask.isValid() && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");
    
     
    Loop* L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have non-null preheader and latch blocks");
    
     
    UnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;  
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");
    
     
    Instruction* I = nullptr;  
    Type* Ty = I->getType();
    unsigned BitWidth = Ty->getScalarSizeInBits();
    assert(BitWidth == DemandedMask.bitwidth() && BitWidth == SelType->getScalarSizeInBits() && "Instruction type and bit width must match demanded mask and known properties");
    
     
    unsigned NLZ = 1;  
    assert(NLZ > 0 && "There must be unused high bits for disabling wrap flags");
    
     
    assert(E->Idx != 0 && E->UserTreeIndex.has_value() && "TreeEntry must have a non-zero Idx and valid UserTreeIndex");
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallBase *CI = nullptr;

     
    if (F->empty()) {
        BB = new BasicBlock(Context, "entry", F);
        CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", BB);
    } else {
        auto &BBs = F->getBasicBlockList();
        for (auto &B : BBs) {
            if (&B != BB && !B.empty()) {
                CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", &*std::prev(&B.end()));
                break;
            }
        }
    }

     
    Value *User = nullptr;
    if (CI) {
        User = CI;
        for (auto &U : CI->users()) {
            User = &U;
            break;
        }
    }
    assert(User && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (CI) {
        Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
        if (IntrID == Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic) {
            CI->setCalledFunction(nullptr);
            auto *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(CI->getType(), IntrinsicID::get(Context, IntrID), {});
            CI->replaceAllUsesWith(II);
        }
    }

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
        auto *AM = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
        assert(AM && "Intrinsic call must be AnyMemIntrinsic");
    }

     
    F->print(errs());
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context) }, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    AllocaInst* ArgAlloca = new AllocaInst(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0, "", BB);
    Value* ArgPtr = Builder.CreatePointerCast(ArgAlloca, Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context));

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), { ArgPtr }, "", BB);

     
    Use& U = *CI->user_begin();

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && CI->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
         
        F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::NoCapture);

         
        legacy::FunctionPassManager FPM(&M);
        FPM.add(createPromoteMemoryToRegisterPass());
        FPM.run(*F);
    }

    std::cout << "Module after optimization:\n" << M;

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::Local);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
     
    Loop *L = new Loop(*BB, LI);
    L->setLoopForall(*BB);
    if (L) {
        UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
        ULO.Count = 2;  
        llvm::UnrollLoop(L, ULO);
    }

     
    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && !CI->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be nounwind and CallInst must not throw.");

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memset;
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = Intrinsic::getAnyMemoryIntrinsic(CI, ID);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic.");

     
    if (AtomicMemIntrinsic *AIMI = dyn_cast<AtomicMemIntrinsic>(AMII)) {
        Value *Ptr = AIMI->getPointerOperand();
        uint64_t NumBytes = AIMI->getNumElements() * AIMI->getElementType()->getPrimitiveSizeInBits() / 8;
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 || (NumBytes % AIMI->getElementType()->getPrimitiveSizeInBits()) != 0 && "For atomic unordered memory intrinsics, the length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size.");
    }

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg0 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, {Arg0}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow() || CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Function or CallInst does not meet the required conditions." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test program completed successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Type *IntTy = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(IntTy, 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(IntTy, 2);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB->getTerminator());

     
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB->getTerminator());

     
    assert(SI && "Select instruction creation failed");
    assert(SI->getType() == IntTy && "Select instruction type mismatch");
    assert(SI->getTrueValue()->getType() == IntTy && "True value type mismatch");
    assert(SI->getFalseValue()->getType() == IntTy && "False value type mismatch");

     
    assert(isa<ICmpInst>(CondVal) && "Condition must be an ICMP_ULT instruction");
    auto *ICI = cast<ICmpInst>(CondVal);
    assert(ICI->getOperand(0) == TrueVal && "First operand of ICMP_ULT must be TrueVal");
    assert(isa<ConstantInt>(ICI->getOperand(1)) && "Second operand of ICMP_ULT must be a constant integer");
    auto *CII = cast<ConstantInt>(ICI->getOperand(1));
    assert(CII->getValue() == 2 && "Second operand of ICMP_ULT must be the integer value 2");

     
    assert(SI->isConditional() && "Select instruction must have a conditional structure");

    std::cout << "All assertions passed!" << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI;
    if (true) {  
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), { Arg }, "", BB);
        CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must have at least one use." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    if (!F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Function must be marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 0));
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 2)), "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction must be a CallBase." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Value::use_empty());

     
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->setAttributes(AttributeList::get(Context, { Attribute::NoUnwind }));
    CI->addAttribute(AttributeList::get(Context, {}));

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not throw." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst throws." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setCallingConv(CallingConv::C);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::memcpy, { CI, Arg }, "", BB);
    II->setOperand(0, CI);
    II->setOperand(1, Arg);
    II->setArgOperandUse(2, 0);  

     
    BinaryOperator *BO = BinaryOperator::CreateAdd(CI, CI, "", BB);
    StoreInst *SI = new StoreInst(CI, (AllocaInst *)BB->getTerminator(), false, BB);

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}
