    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {Arg->getType()}, {Arg, Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt8Ty(Context)), Constant::getIntegerValue(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), APInt(64, 10))}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    Value *CtxI = CI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CtxI) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
    assert(F != nullptr && "Function must be non-null");
    assert(!Arg->getParent()->getReturnTypeList().empty() && "Function must have at least one argument marked as returned");

     
    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar/SimplifyCFGPass.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopPass.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/TargetLibraryInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
std::unique_ptr<Module> createModule() {
  auto Context = std::make_unique<LLVMContext>();
  auto M = std::make_unique<Module>("test", *Context);

  FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(*Context), {}, false);
  Function* F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "foo", M.get());

  BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(*Context, "", F);
  Instruction* CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::sqrt, {ConstantFP::get(*Context, APFloat(1.0))}, "", BB);

  return M;
}

 
void simplifyCFG(Function& F) {
  PassManager PM;
  PM.add(createSimplifyCFGPass());
  PM.run(F);
}

int main() {
  auto M = createModule();
  if (!M->getFunction("foo")) {
    llvm::errs() << "Error: Function 'foo' not found!\n";
    return 1;
  }

  Function& F = *M->getFunction("foo");
  simplifyCFG(F);  

   

  return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    Argument *Arg = F->getArg(0);
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, ID), {}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow() && !CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind, but CallInst does not have a noexcept attribute." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function or CallInst does not meet the specified conditions." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "The context instruction is a CallBase." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
    }

     
    F->dump();
    CI->dump();

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("testmod", Context);
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testfunc", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Type* Int32Ty = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    std::vector<Type*> ArgTys = {Int32Ty, Int32Ty};

     
    FunctionType* IntrinsicFuncTy = FunctionType::get(Int32Ty, ArgTys, false);
    Intrinsic::ID IntrinsicID = Intrinsic::pow;  

     
    Value* Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Int32Ty, 1), ConstantInt::get(Int32Ty, 2)};
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::Create(IntrinsicFuncTy, Intrinsic::getIntrinsic(IntrinsicID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemory()) {
        errs() << "Not a valid memory intrinsic!\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Mod->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Call instruction is an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Call instruction is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "The CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic && "The intrinsic must be AnyMemIntrinsic.");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "The context instruction must be a CallBase.");

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Basic Block: " << BB->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("testModule", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context))}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwind(false);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemory()) {
        errs() << "Not a memory intrinsic!\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
     

     
    legacy::PassManager PM;
    PM.add(createPrintModulePass([](const Module &M) { return false; }));
    PM.run(*cast<Module>(&M));

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have 'nothrow' attribute." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst has 'nothrow' attribute." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *EntryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(EntryBB);

     
    FunctionCallee Callee = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic);
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "", EntryBB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!Func->doesNotThrow()) {
        return 2;
    }

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        return 3;
    }

     
    auto *L = new LoopInfoWrapperPass();
    L->doInitialization(*Func);
    for (auto &BB : *Func) {
        L->runOnFunction(BB.getParent());
    }

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        return 4;
    }

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), APFloat(1.0));
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "", EntryBB);
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(Builder.getInt1(true), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", EntryBB);

     
    if (!TrueVal || !FalseVal || !SelType) {
        return 5;
    }

     
    auto *E = new TreeEntry();
    E->State = TreeEntry::SplitVectorize;
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(std::make_pair(nullptr, 0));
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(std::make_pair(nullptr, 1));

     
    if (E->State != TreeEntry::SplitVectorize || E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() != 2) {
        return 6;
    }

     
     

    std::cout << "Test passed successfully!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(F->getParamType(0));
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
        CI->setCalledFunction(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, static_cast<Intrinsic::ID>(ID)));
    }

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h"
#include "llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h"
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

bool testFunction(Module &M, LLVMContext &Ctx) {
    Function *F = createFunctionInModule(M, Ctx);  
    if (!F) return false;

    CallInst *CI = insertCallInstruction(*F);  
    if (CI->use_empty()) return false;  

     
    if (!F->doesNotThrow() || F->hasFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind)) return false;

    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !II->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) return false;  

    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
    Value *CtxI = CB;  

     
    if (!CtxI) return false;

     
    Loop *L = getLoopForFunction(*F);
    if (!L || !L->getLoopPreheader() || !L->getLoopLatch()) return false;

    UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 4;  
    if (ULO.Count <= 0) return false;

     

    std::cout << "Test function passed all constraints." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("testModule", Ctx);
    if (testFunction(M, Ctx)) {
         
    } else {
         
    }
    return 0;
}

bool generateTest(LLVMContext &Ctx, Module &M) {
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

        return false;
    }

     
     

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        return false;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test generation complete." << std::endl;
    return true;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Arg->getName(), nullptr, &M);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg}, "", BB);
    CI->addUse(F);  

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    IntrinsicInst *AII = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!AII || !AII->isMemIntrinsic()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not a memory intrinsic!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Loop *L = new Loop();
    L->initializeStandardLoopInfo(*F);

     
    unsigned int UnrollCount = 2;

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(TrueVal, FalseVal, TrueVal, "", BB);

     
    if (!SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() || !SI->getCondition()->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        std::cerr << "SelectInst does not have a valid integer type!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!SI->getTrueValue() || !SI->getFalseValue() || !SI->getCondition()) {
        std::cerr << "SelectInst operands or condition are invalid!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    SI = simplifySelectInst(SI, BB);
    if (isa<SelectInst>(SI)) {
        std::cerr << "SelectInst simplification failed!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    L->setLoopAlreadyUnrolled();  

     
    unsigned int MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    if (MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth < 1) {
        std::cerr << "Maximum analysis recursion depth is too small!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask(FPClassTest::Zero);  
    FEConditionInfo Known(FEConditionInfo::Unordered);

    if (!isValidElementType(SI->getType())) {
        std::cerr << "Invalid element type for SelectInst!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (NLZ > 0) {
         
    }

     
    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function* func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &module);
    
     
    BasicBlock* bb = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", func);
    
     
    Argument* arg = &*(func->arg_begin());
    arg->setName("arg");
    arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, {}, "", bb);
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
    func->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    Value* trueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
    Value* falseVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 2));
    SelectInst* sel = new SelectInst(CI->getType(), CI, trueVal, falseVal, "", bb);
    
     
    if (!sel->getCondition() || !sel->getTrueValue() || !sel->getFalseValue() || !sel->getType()->isIntegerTy()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: SelectInst does not have valid operands or type." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }
    
     
     
    
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memset), {Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context))}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset && "Expected memset intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    assert(!Pos.isNull() && "IRPosition should not be null");
    assert(Pos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "Expected IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT position kind");

     
    CB->simplifyCall();

    return 0;
}

    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::fabs;
    Value *Op = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, IntrID), {Op}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == IntrID && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    CallBase *CB = cast<CallBase>(CI);

     
    CB->simplify();

     

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg1 = new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg1", F);
    Arg1->setParamAttr(0, AttributeSet::getWithReturned(&M));

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, {Arg1}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *Intrin = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::alloca, {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)});
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(Intrin) && "The intrinsic must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    Builder.CreateStore(Intrin, BB->getInsertBlock()->getFirstNonPHI());

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 5);
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    F->print(outs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createTestFunction(LLVMContext &C) {
    Module M("test", C);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(C), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(C, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(C), Type::getInt8PtrTy(C), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(C), 10)}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  

    return F;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("test", Ctx);
    Function *F = createTestFunction(Ctx);

     
    if (!F->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "Function has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function does not have any uses.\n";
    }

     
    for (auto &BB : *F) {
        for (auto &I : BB) {
            if (CallInst *CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(&I)) {
                if (!CI->getFunction()->isNounwind() || CI->doesNotThrow()) {
                    errs() << "Function is not marked as nounwind or call instruction throws.\n";
                } else {
                    errs() << "Function is marked as nounwind and call instruction does not throw.\n";
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {}, {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "The CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    SimplifyCFG(F);

    std::cout << "Test function with intrinsic call created." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    Value *Arg = &*(F->arg_begin());
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Arg, Arg}, {}, "");

     
    BB->getInstList().push_back(CI);
    assert(!CI.use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind while CallInst is not.");

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
            assert(true && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic.");
        }
    }

     
     

    std::cout << "Test program completed successfully." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::memcpy, {}), Arg, "", BB);

     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->addUse(CI->getType());

    F->setUnnamedAddr(GlobalValue::UnnamedAddr::Local);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, ID), {}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        if (const auto *AMIntr = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
             
            unsigned NumBytes = AMIntr->getNumElements() * sizeof(int);
            if (NumBytes <= 0) {
                std::cerr << "Invalid number of bytes for intrinsic call." << std::endl;
                return 1;
            }
        }
    }

     
    CI->addUse(F->getArg(0));

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    assert(II && "Expected an intrinsic instruction");

        AMII->setArgOperandNum(0, Constant::getNullValue(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));
        AMII->setArgOperandNum(1, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0));
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/TargetLibraryInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);
    
     
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    
     
    Func->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Callee, {}, "");
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(ICmpInst::create(Instruction::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)), TrueVal, FalseVal);
    
     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type must be integer");
    
     
    SI->setName("selectInst");
    CI->addUse(SI);
    
     
    Loop *L = new Loop();
    L->initializePredecessorsAndSucessors({BB});
    L->setLoopPreheader(BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func));
    L->setLoopLatch(BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func));
    
     
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop must have a preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have a latch block");
    
     
    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");
    
     
     

    std::cout << "Module: " << *Module << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testfunc", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *EntryBB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    Value *ConstVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 42));

     
    Instruction *InsertPt = ReturnInst::Create(Context, ConstVal, EntryBB);

     
    if (!Func->empty()) {
        IRBuilder<> Builder(EntryBB);
        Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 1));
        CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Func, Callee, "", InsertPt);

         
        CI->addUse(CI->getType(), CI);

         
        assert(!Func->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind) && !CI->doesNotThrow() && "Function or CallInst should be nounwind");

         
        if (verifyModule(*Module, &std::cerr)) {
            std::cerr << "Module verification failed!\n";
            return 1;
        }
    }

    std::cout << "Module successfully created with constraints.\n";
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Vec = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    Value *Idx = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Instruction *InsElt = InsertElementInst::Create(Vec, Vec, Idx, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!Vec->getType()->isVectorTy() && "Vec should not be a vector type");
    assert(InsElt->getType()->isVectorTy() && "InsElt should be a vector type");
    
     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::fabs;
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), Vec, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CI must have at least one use");
    assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as !nounwind");
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CI must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "CI must be a memory intrinsic");
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");
    
     
    std::cout << "Module: " << M.getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Basic Block: " << BB->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "Call Instruction: " << *CI << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::InternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&Mod, Intrinsic::memset), {Arg1}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        F->setDoesNotThrow(false);
        std::cout << "Function marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (verifyModule(Mod, &outs())) {
        std::cerr << "Module verification failed!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Module verified successfully." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");
    Arg->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallBase *CI;
    if (true) {  
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {Arg}, "", BB);
        assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
        assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must not be nounwind");
        assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
        IntrinsicInst *II = cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic) {
             
            Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);  
            if (NumBytes->isNonPositive() || !NumBytes->getValue().isMultipleOf(1)) {
                assert(!F->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be nounwind");
            }
        }
    }

     

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *Mod = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        Intrinsic::ID ID = CI->getIntrinsicID();
        if (ID == Intrinsic::memcpy || ID == Intrinsic::memmove || ID == Intrinsic::memset) {
             
        } else if (ID == Intrinsic::atomic_load || ID == Intrinsic::atomic_store || 
                   ID == Intrinsic::atomic_rmw_add || ID == Intrinsic::atomic_rmw_sub || 
                   ID == Intrinsic::atomic_cmpxchg) {
             
            Value *Ptr = CI->getArgOperand(0);
            uint64_t NumBytes = cast<ConstantInt>(CI->getArgOperand(2))->getZExtValue();
            assert(NumBytes <= 1 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes) && "Atomic unordered memory intrinsics must have non-positive length or not a multiple of element size");
        }
    }
    
     
    if (CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB);
        assert(Pos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have position kind of IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT");
        
         
    }
    
    return 0;
}

bool inInterval(double val, double low, double high) {
    return val >= low && val <= high;
}

int main() {
     
    std::vector<double> vals = {-1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 2.0};
    
     
    double low = -0.5;
    double high = 1.5;
    
    for (double val : vals) {
        bool result = inInterval(val, low, high);
        std::cout << "Value " << val << " in interval [" << low << ", " << high << "]: " << (result ? "True" : "False") << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    double trueVal = 1.0;
    double falseVal = -1.0;
    int condVal = 1;  
    
    double selectResult = (condVal == 0) ? trueVal : falseVal;
    std::cout << "Select result: " << selectResult << std::endl;
    
     
    int MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    int Depth = 5;
    if (Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth) {
        std::cout << "Loop is safe to unroll within recursion depth limit." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop exceeds the allowed recursion depth for unrolling." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    bool hasAddressTaken = false;
    if (!hasAddressTaken) {
        std::cout << "Loop header's address is not taken, safe to unroll." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Loop header's address is taken, cannot unroll." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
     
     
     
     
     
     

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallBase *CI = CallBase::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    if (IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");
        
         
        if (AtomicOrdering ord = II->getAtomicOrdering()) {
            assert(ord == AtomicOrdering::NotAtomic || !isMultipleOfElementSize(II->getNumOperands()));
        }
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CtxI = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CtxI && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CtxI);
    assert(Pos.getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct kind");
    
     
    Function *Func = Pos.getFunction();
    assert(Func && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry *, Type *> MinBWs;  
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getIntegerBitWidth() > 0 && "MinBWs entry must provide a valid bit width");
    }
    
     
    if (E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize) {
        assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");
    } else if (E->isGather() || E->in(TransformedToGatherNodes)) {
         
    }
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = Intrinsic::ctpop(TrueVal);
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!isSimplified(SI) && !isTransformedToShuffleOrScalarOfVecs(SI) && "SelectInst should not be simplified or transformed");
    
     
    Value *X = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *AbsVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::fabs, X, "", BB);
    Value *NegVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::fneg, AbsVal, "", BB);
    
     
    FPClassTest KnownFPClass();  
    assert(KnownFPClass.isUninit() && "Known must be in an uninitialized state");
    
     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;  
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    
     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask();  
    assert(DemandedMask.isValid() && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");
    
     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && !L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop must be safe to clone and header address must not be taken");
    
    unsigned UnrollCount = 2;  
    assert(UnrollCount > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");
    
     
    Instruction *I = new CallInst(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic), {}, "", BB);
    assert(I->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "Instruction must be of an integer or integer vector type");
    
     
    Type *ScalarTy = I->getType();
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy) && "ScalarTy derived from VL[0] must be a valid element type");
    
     
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getIntegerBitWidth() > 0 && "MinBWs entry must provide a valid bit width");
    } else {
        ReductionRoot *RR = nullptr;  
        assert(RR->getParent() && "ReductionRoot must have a non-null parent block");
    }
    
     
    VectorValuesAndScalesType VVAS;  
    assert(!VVAS.empty() && "VectorValuesAndScales must be a valid array reference");
    
    return 0;
}

    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

    Arg->setAttr(AttributeList::ReturnIndex, Attribute::Returned);

    Args.push_back(Arg);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, Args, "", BB);

    F->setFnAttr("nounwind", Attribute::NotPromote);
    assert(!CI.doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be marked as doesNotThrow");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);

    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");

     
    Function *Func = IRPos.getAssociatedFunction();
    assert(Func && "Function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");

    std::cout << "BasicBlock: " << BB->getName() << "\n";

    delete M;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, "", BB);

     
    Value *User = nullptr;
    for (auto &U : CI->users()) {
        User = U;
        break;
    }
    assert(User && "CI must have at least one use");

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be nounwind");
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::not_intrinsic;
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        ID = II->getIntrinsicID();
    }
    assert(ID == Intrinsic::anymemset || ID == Intrinsic::anymemcpy || ID == Intrinsic::anyread || ID == Intrinsic::anywrite && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    if (ID == Intrinsic::anymemset || ID == Intrinsic::anymemcpy) {
        Value *NumBytes = nullptr;
        for (auto &Arg : F->args()) {
            if (Arg.getType() == Type::getInt32Ty(Context)) {
                NumBytes = &Arg;
                break;
            }
        }
        assert(NumBytes && "Function must have at least one argument with the returned attribute");
        int64_t ByteSize = cast<ConstantInt>(NumBytes)->getSExtValue();
        assert((ByteSize <= 0 || ByteSize % sizeof(int32_t) != 0) && "NumBytes must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be CallBase");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB);
    assert(!Pos.isNull() && "IRPosition should not be null");
    Function *Func = F;
    assert(Func && "Function should not be null");

     
     
     

     
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    unsigned Depth = 5;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    FPClassFlags Known;
    assert((DemandedMask.getBitWidth() == Known.getBitWidth()) && "DemandedMask and Known must have the same bit width");

     
    DenseMap<BasicBlock *, BlockEdge> BlocksSchedules;
    for (auto &Entry : BlocksSchedules) {
        assert(Entry.first && "BlocksSchedules entry should not be null");
    }

     
    SmallVector<TreeEntry, 8> VectorizableTree;
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;
    unsigned Idx = 1;
    assert(Idx != 0 && "Idx must be non-zero");

     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::makeICmp(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst should be valid");

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;
    UnrollLoopOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

     
    Instruction *I = SI;
    Type *Ty = I->getType();
    int BitWidth = cast<IntegerType>(Ty)->getBitWidth();
    assert(BitWidth == DemandedMask.getBitWidth() && "Instruction type must have a scalar size in bits equal to the bit width of DemandedMask");

     
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

     
    assert((DemandedMask.getBitWidth() == Known.getBitWidth()) && "DemandedMask and Known must have the same bit width");

    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F->getFunctionType(), {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMII && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = CI;
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CB) && "Context instruction must be a CallBase");

     
    Value *SimplifiedValue = CB->simplify();
    if (SimplifiedValue) {
        CB->replaceAllUsesWith(SimplifiedValue);
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <iostream>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F->getFunctionType(), F, {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage);

     
    CallInst *IntrinsicCI = CallInst::create(F->getFunctionType(), Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, llvm::Intrinsic::memcpy), {Arg}, "", BB);

    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrinsicCI)) {
        std::cerr << "The instruction is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *CtxI = CI;
    if (!isa<CallBase>(CtxI)) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test program successfully created." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "foo", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    std::vector<Value *> Args;
    Args.push_back(Arg1);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, F->getName(), Args, "", BB);

     
    Use &U = CI->use_begin();
    if (!U) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow(true);

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst is not an intrinsic.\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    Value *Zero = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *AtomicCmpXchg = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, llvm::Intrinsic::atomic_cmpxchg, {CI->getType()});
    AtomicCmpXchg->setArgOperand(2, Zero);  

     
    M->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallBase *CI = CallBase::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), {Value::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = Intrinsic::create(Intrinsic::fabs, {TrueVal}, "", BB);
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    Type *SelType = Type::getFloatTy(Context);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be valid");
    SI->setType(SelType);

     
    assert(TrueVal->getType() == SelType && "TrueVal type must match SelType");
    assert(FalseVal->getType() == SelType && "FalseVal type must match SelType");
    assert(CondVal->getType() == Type::getInt1Ty(Context) && "CondVal type must be i1");

     
     

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/Cloning.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopPass.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
void createTestCallInst(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0)}, "", BB);

     
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    Value *Arg = &*AI;
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CI) && "CI must be a CallBase");

     
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("testModule", Context);

    createTestCallInst(M);

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("testmodule", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testfunc", Mod.get());

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrinID = Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic;  
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(IntrinID, {}, "", F);

     
    CI->addUse(F->getParamType(0));  

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "Intrinsic should not be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!II || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        std::cerr << "Not an AnyMemIntrinsic" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
         
        CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    }

    std::cout << "Module: " << *Mod << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/Casting.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/UnrollLoop.h>
#include <llvm/ADT/SmallVector.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
class TreeEntry {
public:
    enum State { SplitVectorize, Vectorize };
    int Idx;
    State State;
     
};

class SelectInst {
public:
    Value *CondVal;
    Value *TrueVal;
    Value *FalseVal;
    Type *SelType;
     
};

 
bool isValidElementType(Type *) { return true; }
int getScalarSizeInBits(Type *) { return 32; }
class IntrinsicInst : public Instruction {
public:
    IntrinsicInst(Value *Callee, Type *RetTy, std::initializer_list<Value *> Ops) : Instruction(Callee, RetTy, ops.begin(), ops.end()) {}
};

 
bool satisfiesConstraints(CallInst &CI) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;

     
    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
    if (!func || func->doesNotThrow()) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI) || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(&CI)) return false;

     
     

    return true;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module module("test", Context);
    FunctionType *fnTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *fn = cast<Function>(module.getOrInsertFunction("test_func", fnTy));

     
    Value *callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst CI(&module, Intrinsic::memset, {callee}, "", fn->getEntryBlock().getFirstNonPHI());

    if (satisfiesConstraints(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Constraints satisfied!\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << "Constraints not satisfied.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FT, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst must not be marked as nounwind.");
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        auto *IMI = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
        assert(IMI && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
        
         
        if (IMI->isAtomic() && IMI->getNumElements() > 0) {
            auto NumBytes = IMI->getMemSizeInBits();
            assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % 8 != 0, "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size.");
        }
    }
    
     
     
    
    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);
    Function* F = cast<Function>(M->getOrInsertFunction("foo", Type::getVoidTy(Context), nullptr));
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    Value* Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    CallInst* CI = Builder.CreateCall(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memset), {Arg}, "", BB);
    
     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->addUse(Builder.getInt32Ty(), Arg);
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        return -1;  
    }

     

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg1 = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg1->setName("arg1");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg1}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use.");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrinID = Intrinsic::sqrt;
    CallInst *IntrinCI = CallInst::Create(Type::getVoidTy(Context), Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrinID), {}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(IntrinCI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call.");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(IntrinCI) && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic.");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(IntrinCI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance.");

     

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1)}, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst *AII = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(AII && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    
     
    if (AII->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
        ConstantInt *Len = cast<ConstantInt>(AII->getArgOperand(2));
        assert(Len->isZero() && "Length must be non-positive for atomic unordered memory intrinsics");
    }
    
     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    auto IRRet = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*CB);
    assert(IRRet.getPositionKind() == IRPosition::CallSiteArgument && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");
    
     
    Function *Funct = IRRet.getFunction();
    assert(Funct && "Associated function must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry *E = new TreeEntry();
    E->Scalars.push_back(Type::getInt32Ty(Context));
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry *, Type *> MinBWs;
    MinBWs[E] = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    assert(MinBWs.find(E)->second->isIntegerTy() && "MinBWs must provide a valid bit width");
    
     
    E->State = TreeEntry::SplitVectorize;
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(E);
    E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.push_back(new TreeEntry());
    assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::Predicate::ICMP_ULT, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), CI);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getHalfTy(Context), APFloat(1.0));
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create("ctpop", TrueVal, "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    
     
    assert(!isa<Simplifyable>(SI) && "SelectInst should not be simplified");
    
     
    Value *X = ConstantFP::get(Type::getHalfTy(Context), APFloat(1.0));
    Value *FABS = CallInst::Create("fabs", X, "", BB);
    Value *FNEG = CallInst::Create("fneg", FABS, "", BB);
    assert(isa<CallInst>(FNEG) && "FalseVal must be a ctpop operation of fabs(x)");
    
     
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    Type *CondType = CondVal->getType();
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && (CondType->isScalarTy() || CondType->isVectorTy()));
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::Vectorize && E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement);
    
     
    Value *Op = E->getOperand(1).back();
    assert(!Op->getType()->isVectorTy());
    
     
    Type *ScalarTy = E->Scalars.front();
    assert(isValidElementType(ScalarTy));
    
     
    if (!MinBWs.count(E)) {
        assert(E->Idx == 0 && E->isReducedBitcastRoot());
    }
    
     
    Instruction *I = CallInst::Create("fneg", CallInst::Create("fabs", CI), "", BB);
    assert(isa<FNegInst>(I));
    
     
    FPKnown FPK;
    assert(FPK == FPKnown());
    
     
    unsigned Depth = 0;
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth);
    
     
    FPClassTest DM;
    adjustDemandedMaskFromFlags(DM, F->getFastMathFlags());
    
     
    DenseMap<BasicBlock *, Schedule> BS;
    assert(!BS.empty() && "BlocksSchedules must contain valid entries");
    
     
    assert(VectorizableTree.size() > 0);
    
     
    Instruction *ReductionRoot = CallInst::Create("reduction_root", "", BB);
    assert(ReductionRoot->getParent());
    
     
    std::vector<Value *> VVS;
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

bool checkConstraints(CallInst &CI) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty()) return false;

    Function *func = CI.getFunction();
     
    if (!func->doesNotThrow() || func->hasFnAttribute(Attribute::NoUnwind)) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI) || !isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(&CI)) return false;

    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
     
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy) {
        Value *Length = II->getOperand(1);
        if (!Length || !isa<ConstantInt>(Length)) return false;
        int64_t NumBytes = Length->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits();  
        if (NumBytes > 0 && !(NumBytes % sizeof(int))) return false;
    }

     
    for (Argument &arg : func->args()) {
        if (arg.hasAttribute(Attribute::Returned)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock &BB = *(BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F));
    IRBuilder<> Builder(&BB);
    Value *Callee = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, "call_inst");

    if (checkConstraints(*CI)) {
        std::cout << "Constraints satisfied!" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Constraints not satisfied." << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "myfunc", getModule());

    Instruction* CI = CallInst::Create(F, {}, "", BB);

        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;

    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "Function F is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function F is not marked as nounwind or CallInst throws." << std::endl;
    }

     

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType* FuncTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *ZeroVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    Value *VecVal = UndefValue::get(VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4));
    Value *InsertedVal = InsertElementInst::Create(VecVal, ZeroVal, ZeroVal, "", BB);
    
     
    CallBase* CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {InsertedVal}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();
    
     
    IntrinsicInst* II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    AnyMemIntrinsic* AMI = cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II);
    assert(AMI && "CallInst must be an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    
     
    if (AMI->isAtomic() || AMI->hasZeroLength()) {
         
    }
    
     
    CallBase* CBC = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CBC && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");
    
     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB);
    assert(IRPos.getPositionKind() == IRPosition::CallSiteArgument && "IRPosition must have the correct position kind");
    
     
    Function* Funct = IRPos.getAnchorScope();
    assert(Funct && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");
    
     
    TreeEntry* E = nullptr;  
    assert(!E->Scalars.empty() && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    
     
    DenseMap<TreeEntry*, IntegerType*> MinBWs;  
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E]->getBitWidth() > 0 && "MinBWs entry must provide a valid bit width");
    }
    
     
    assert(E->State == TreeEntry::SplitVectorize && E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "TreeEntry must be in SplitVectorize state with exactly two combined entries");
    
     
    Value *CondVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt1Ty(Context), true);
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::fabs, {TrueVal}, "", BB);  
    FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::ctpop, {TrueVal}, "", BB);  
    Type *SelType = TrueVal->getType();
    
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be valid");
    
     
    unsigned Depth = 0;  
    const unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    
     
    FPClassTest *DemandedMask = nullptr;  
    FPMathOperator *I = nullptr;  
    assert(DemandedMask && "DemandedMask must be a valid FPClassTest value");
    
     
    DenseMap<BasicBlock*, BlockEdge*> BlocksSchedules;  
    assert(!BlocksSchedules.empty() && "BlocksSchedules map must contain valid entries");
    
     
    std::vector<TreeEntry*> VectorizableTree;  
    assert(!VectorizableTree.empty() && "VectorizableTree must contain non-gathered, non-deleted TreeEntry objects");
    
     
    Instruction *ReductionRoot = nullptr;  
    assert(ReductionRoot && "ReductionRoot must be a valid Instruction object with a parent block");
    
     
    std::vector<std::pair<Value*, APFloat>> VectorValuesAndScales;  
    assert(!VectorValuesAndScales.empty() && "VectorValuesAndScales parameter must be well-formed");
    
     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop must have a valid preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have a valid latch block");

    LoopUnrollOptions ULO;
    ULO.Count = 1;  
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");
    
     
    Instruction *InstrI = nullptr;  
    Type *InstrType = InstrI->getType();
    assert(InstrI && InstrType->isIntegerTy() && InstrType->getScalarSizeInBits() == DemandedMask->getBitWidth());
    
    return 0;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        errs() << "CallInst is an intrinsic call.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call.\n";
    }

     
    M.print(errs());

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), {}, "", BB);

     
    Value *User = *(CI->user_begin());
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "CallInst has at least one use.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "CallInst does not have any uses.\n";
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memset) {
        errs() << "Intrinsic call is a memset.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Not an intrinsic call or not a memset.\n";
    }

     
    Function::arg_iterator AI = F->arg_begin();
    if (AI != F->args().end()) {
        errs() << "Function has an argument with the returned attribute.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "Function does not have any arguments with the returned attribute.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    ConstantInt *CI0 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *Args[] = { CI0 };
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(CI->getType());

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    CallInst *IntrCI = CallInst::Create(Type::getVoidTy(Context), Intrinsic::getIntrinsic(IntrID, {}), {}, "", BB);

     
    CallBase *CtxI = CI;

     
     
     

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "foo", &M);

    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Instruction *CallInst = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::sqrt), {}, "", BB);

     
    CallInst->addUse(*F);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CallInst)) {
        errs() << "The CallInst is an intrinsic.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The CallInst is not an intrinsic.\n";
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setUnwindDest(nullptr);

     
    if (F->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "The function is marked as nounwind.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "The function is not marked as nounwind.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module *M = new Module("test", Context);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI;
    if (true) {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "call_inst");
        CI->setOperand(0, ConstantExpr::getBitCast(ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));  
        CI->setOperand(1, ConstantExpr::getBitCast(ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));  
        CI->setOperand(2, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0));  
    } else {
        CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(M, Intrinsic::atomicrmw_add_fetch_8), {}, "call_inst");
        CI->setOperand(0, ConstantPointerNull::get(Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context)));  
        CI->setOperand(1, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt8Ty(Context), 0));  
    }

     
    F->arg_begin()->addAttr(Attribute::Returned);

     
     

     
    Loop *L = new Loop();
    L->addBasicBlockToLoop(BB, BB->getDomTree());
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Preheader should be set");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Latch should be set");

     
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop should be safe to clone");

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst has at least one use." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

    return 0;
}

#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Constants.h"
