#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }

     
    if (dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;

    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "foo", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, FunctionCtor::get(&Mod), {Arg1}, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());

     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be nounwind");

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::not_an_intrinsic;  
    if (auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        II->setIntrinsicID(ID);
    }

     
    assert(isa<CallBase>(CI) && "CI should be a CallBase");

     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName() << "\n";
    std::cout << "CallInst: " << *CI << "\n";

    return 0;
}

    Instruction *Call = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, {Arg}, "", BB);

    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

    if (!CB) {
        std::cerr << "Context instruction is not a CallBase!" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     

    return 0;
}

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("testModule", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    BB->addArgument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *AnyMemCI = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (!AnyMemCI || !AnyMemCI->isMemory()) {
        errs() << "Error: CallInst is not a memory intrinsic!\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        errs() << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses!\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg1 = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    F->arg_begin()->setName("arg1");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, {Arg1}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic, {Arg1}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(II) && "Must be an intrinsic call");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
    ICmpInst *Cmp = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Arg1, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(Cmp, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    assert(SI->hasOneUse() && "SelectInst must have one use");
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type must be integer");

     
    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &Mod);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&Mod, Intrinsic::anymemintrinsic), { Arg }, "", BB);

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must have at least one use to trigger simplification." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "CallInst must be an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    SimplifyQuery SQ(F->getContext());
    Value *Simplified = llvm::simplifyInstruction(CI, SQ);

    if (!Simplified) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to simplify CallInst." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

     
    Simplified->print(outs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), Type::getInt32Ty(Context), false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    FunctionCallee Callee = M.getOrInsertFunction("llvm.abs", FTy);
    CallInst *CI = Builder.CreateCall(Callee, Arg, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);

     
    Intrinsic::ID ID = Intrinsic::abs;  
    CallInst *AnyMemCI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, ID), Arg, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(AnyMemCI) && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(dynamic_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic*>(AnyMemCI) && "CallInst must be a memory intrinsic");

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() && "Loop must have a preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() && "Loop must have a latch block");
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && "Loop must be safe to clone");
    assert(!L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop header address must not be taken");

     
    LoopInfo LI(*F);
    L = &LI.getLoopsInPreorder()[0];
    unsigned unrollCount = 2;
    llvm::llvm_unroll<2>(*L, unrollCount);

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = Builder.CreateNeg(Builder.CreateFabs(Arg));
    ICmpInst *CondVal = new ICmpInst(*BB, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2));
    SelectInst *SI = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(!E->getOperand(1).back()->getType()->isVectorTy() && "Last operand of E->getOperand(1) must not be a vector type");

     
    assert(isa<ConstantInt>(SI->getTrueValue()) && isa<FNegInst>(SI->getFalseValue()) && "FalseVal must be a ctpop operation of TrueVal");
    assert(isa<ICmpInst>(SI->getCondition()) && "CondVal must be an icmp ult comparison");

     
    TreeEntry *E = nullptr;  
    assert(E->Scalars.size() > 0 && "TreeEntry must have a non-empty Scalars list");
    if (MinBWs.find(E) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[E].getBitWidth() > 0 && "Precomputed type bit width must be valid");
    } else if (E->Idx == 0 && E->isReducedBitcastRoot()) {
         
    }

     
    assert(E->getOpcode() == Instruction::InsertElement && "E->State must be Vectorize");
    assert(E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices.size() == 2 && "E->CombinedEntriesWithIndices must contain exactly two entries");

     
    unsigned MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth = 10;
    FPClassTest KnownFPClass();
    Depth = 5;  
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;
    adjustDemandedMaskFromFlags(DemandedMask,  );

     
    VectorizableTree.emplace_back(E);
    assert(!E->isGather() && !E->isDeleted() && "VectorizableTree entries must not be gathered or deleted");

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instruction.h"

#include "llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolutionExpander.h"
#include "llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h"
#include "llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h"

using namespace llvm;

 
Value* createInsertElement(LLVMContext &Ctx) {
    Module M("module", Ctx);
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    Value *Vec = UndefValue::get(ArrayType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 2));
    Value *Element = ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 1);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, "test_call", BB);
    InsertElementInst *Insert = new InsertElementInst(Vec, Element, ConstantInt::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx), 0), "", CI);

    return Insert;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("module", Ctx);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);

     
    Value *Insert = createInsertElement(Ctx);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, "test_call", BB);
    Insert->setOperand(0, CI);  

     
    if (Insert->use_empty() || F->doesNotThrow()) {
        errs() << "Constraints not satisfied!\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
     

    if (!isa<IntrinsicInst>(Insert) || !cast<IntrinsicInst>(Insert)->isAnyMemIntrinsic()) {
        errs() << "Not an AnyMemIntrinsic!\n";
        return 1;
    }

     
    F->print(errs());

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Module.get());

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();   
    Arg->setName("arg");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setCalledFunction(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic));

     
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "CallInst should not be marked as no-throw");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value *FalseVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::Predicate::ult, Arg, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CI->getType(), FalseVal, TrueVal, "cond_select", BB);

     
    assert(SI->getType()->isIntegerTy() && "SelectInst type should be integer");
    assert(!SI->getType()->isVectorTy() && "SelectInst type should not be vector");

     
    Module->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

Function *createTestFunction(LLVMContext &ctx) {
    Module *mod = new Module("testModule", ctx);
    FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(ctx), {}, false);
    Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "testFunction", mod);

     
    BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(ctx, "", func);

     
    CallInst *ci = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(mod, Intrinsic::sqrt), {}, "", bb);
    ci->setDoesNotThrow();  

     
    func->setNoUnwind();

    return func;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext ctx;
    Module *mod = new Module("testModule", ctx);
    Function *func = createTestFunction(ctx);

     
    mod->print(errs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createDummyFunction(LLVMContext &context) {
  Module *module = new Module("testModule", context);
  FunctionType *funcType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(context), {}, false);
  Function *func = Function::Create(funcType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "dummyFunc", module);

   
  BasicBlock *bb = BasicBlock::Create(context, "", func);

   
  CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", bb);

   
  CI->addUse(Type::getInt32Ty(context));

   
  assert(!func->doesNotThrow() && "Function must not be marked as nounwind");

  return func;
}

int main() {
  LLVMContext context;
  Function *func = createDummyFunction(context);

   
  if (func) {
    std::cout << "Created function: " << func->getName().str() << "\n";
    if (!func->use_empty()) {
      CallInst *CI = nullptr;
      for (auto &user : func->users()) {
        CI = dyn_cast<CallInst>(user);
        if (CI) break;
      }
      if (CI) {
        std::cout << "Found call instruction in function: " << func->getName().str() << "\n";
      } else {
        std::cout << "No call instruction found in function.\n";
      }
    } else {
      std::cout << "Function has no uses.\n";
    }
  } else {
    std::cout << "Failed to create dummy function.\n";
  }

  return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>
using namespace llvm;

 
bool hypotheticalFunction(CallBase &CI, Function &F) {
     
    if (CI.use_empty() || !F.isNoUnwind()) return false;

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI)) return false;
    auto *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(&CI);
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() != Intrinsic::memset && II->getIntrinsicID() != Intrinsic::memcpy) return false;

     
    if (II->getNumOperands() == 0 || !CI.doesNotThrow()) return false;

     
     

     
    if (!isa<CallBase>(&CI) || !F.getAttributes().hasAttribute(0, Attribute::Returns)) return false;

     

    return true;
}

int main() {
     
    CallBase *CI = nullptr;  
    Function F("example", ...);  

    if (hypotheticalFunction(*CI, F)) {
        errs() << "The function satisfies all constraints.\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "One or more constraints are not satisfied.\n";
    }

    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module* M = new Module("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FT = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function* F = Function::Create(FT, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", M);

     
    BasicBlock* BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    CallInst* CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memcpy, {Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), Type::getInt8PtrTy(Context), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 1)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow(false);

     
    CallBase* CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "CI must be an intrinsic call");

     
    IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
    assert(!Pos.isNull() && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    if (!CI->use_empty()) {
        CI->simplifyCall();
    }

     
    M->print(errs());

    delete M;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

 
void ensureNounwindAttribute(Function &F, CallInst &CI) {
     
    bool hasNounwind = F.hasFnAttr(llvm::Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    bool throws = !CI.doesNotThrow();
    
     
    if (!hasNounwind && throws) {
        F.addFnAttr(llvm::Attribute::NoUnwind);
    }
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);
    
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(nullptr, {}, "", BB);
    
     
    ensureNounwindAttribute(*F, *CI);
    
     
    F->print(outs());
    
    return 0;
}

    return 0;

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>

#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FuncTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &Mod);
    Func->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);

     
    Value *VecTy = VectorType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 4);
    Constant *ZeroIdx = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0);
    Instruction *InsertElem = InsertElementInst::Create(UndefValue::get(VecTy), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1), ZeroIdx, "", BB);

     
    assert(InsertElem->getType()->isVectorTy() && "InsertElementInst should be a vector type");
    assert(isa<ConstantInt>(ZeroIdx) && "Index must be an integer constant");

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Func, {InsertElem}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst should have at least one use");

     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->setUnwindPredecessor(BB);

     
    IntrinsicInst *AnyMemIntrinsic = IntrinsicInst::get(Intrinsic::anymem_intrinsic, {CI}, "", BB);
    assert(dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI) && "CallInst should be an intrinsic call");
    assert(isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI) && "Intrinsic should be AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    Mod.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/ScalarEvolution.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/LoopInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Analysis/TargetLibraryInfo.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), true);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 10);
    Builder.SetInsertPoint(BB->getFirstNonPHI());
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FuncTy, FunctionCtor::get(&M), {Arg}, "", BB);

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    Value *IntrinsicArgs[] = {CI};
    IntrinsicInst *II = IntrinsicInst::Create(Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic, IntrinsicArgs, "", BB);

     
    II->addUse(CI);

     

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    ICmpInst *Cond = ICmpInst::Create(Instruction::ICmp, ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, F->arg_begin(), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2), "", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(Cond, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

    assert(I->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() == Known.getBitWidth() && "Expected type match in bits");

        errs() << "Expected unused high bits in operation\n";
        return 1;
    }

    assert(TE->Idx != 0 && "Expected non-zero Idx");

    if (MinBWs.find(TE) != MinBWs.end()) {
        assert(MinBWs[TE]->getBitWidth() > 0 && "Expected valid bit width in MinBWs entry");
    } else {
         
        assert(TE->Idx == 0 && TE->isReducedBitcastRoot() && "Expected reduced bitcast root or Idx to be zero");
    }

    assert(isa<FNegInst>(I) && "Expected FNeg instruction");
    assert(FNegInst->getOperand(0)->hasOneUse() && "Expected one use of operand in fneg(fabs(x)) pattern");

    assert(Known.getBitWidth() == DemandedMask.getBitWidth() && "Expected matching bit widths for Known and DemandedMask");
    assert(I->getType()->getScalarSizeInBits() == Known.getBitWidth() && "Expected type match in bits");

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("module", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "func", &M);
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Argument *Arg = &*F->arg_begin();
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memset), { Arg }, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (F->hasFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind)) {
        std::cout << "Function is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function is not marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (!CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cout << "CallInst does not throw." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst throws." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (isa<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "CallInst is an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "CallInst is not an AnyMemIntrinsic." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (isa<CallBase>(CI)) {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is a CallBase." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Context instruction is not a CallBase." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (IRPosition::callsite_argument(CI).getKind() == IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT) {
        std::cout << "IRPosition is of call site argument type." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "IRPosition is not of call site argument type." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
    if (F) {
        std::cout << "Function associated with IRPosition exists." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Function associated with IRPosition does not exist." << std::endl;
    }
    
     
     
    
     
    struct TreeEntry {
        std::vector<Value*> Scalars;
        int Idx;
         
    };
    
    TreeEntry TE;
    TE.Scalars = { ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), APInt(32, 0)) };
    TE.Idx = 1;

    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

        assert(IID == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and specifically an AnyMemIntrinsic");
    }

     
    if (auto *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        IRPosition Pos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(CB, 0);
        assert(!Pos.getAnchor().isNull() && "Function associated with the IRPosition must be non-null");
    }

     
    Loop *L = nullptr;  
    assert(L->getLoopPreheader() != nullptr && "Loop must have a valid preheader block");
    assert(L->getLoopLatch() != nullptr && "Loop must have a valid latch block");

     
    assert(L->isSafeToClone() && !L->getHeader()->hasAddressTaken() && "Loop must be safe to clone and header's address must not be taken");

     
    LoopUnrollParams ULO;
    ULO.Count = 2;  
    assert(ULO.Count > 0 && "Unroll count must be greater than zero");

    assert(I != nullptr && "Instruction *I must be non-null");
    Type *Ty = I->getType();
    unsigned BitWidth = Ty->getScalarSizeInBits();
    assert((BitWidth == 32 || BitWidth == 64) && "Type of instruction I must have a scalar size in bits equal to the bit width of DemandedMask and Known");

     
    unsigned Depth = 0;  
    assert(Depth <= MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth && "Recursion depth must not exceed MaxAnalysisRecursionDepth");

     
    FPClassTest DemandedMask;  
    assert(DemandedMask.getBitWidth() == BitWidth && "DemandedMask and Known must have the same bit width");

     
    unsigned NLZ = 0;

    assert(TE->Idx != 0 && "TreeEntry must have a non-zero Idx");

    unsigned Part = 0;

    Argument *Arg = &*(F->arg_begin());
    Arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);
    
     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/BasicBlockUtils.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Module = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *Func = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "func", Module.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", Func);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Module.get(), Intrinsic::anymem_load), {}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");
    
     
    Func->setDoesNotThrow();
    Func->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
        assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::anymem_load && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
        
         
        if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::atomicrmw || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::cmpxchg) {
            Value *Ptr = II->getArgOperand(0);
            uint64_t NumBytes = 0;  
            assert(NumBytes <= 0 || NumBytes % getElementTypeSize(Ptr->getType()) != 0, "Length must be non-positive or not a multiple of the element size");
        }
    }
    
     
    if (auto *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI)) {
        assert(CB->getCalledFunction() != nullptr && "Function associated with the CallInst must be non-null");
        
         
    }
    
     
    std::cout << "All constraints satisfied." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>

#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>

    LLVMContext Context;
    Module Mod("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "foo", &Mod);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::CreateIntrinsic(Intrinsic::memset, {}, {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0)}, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->addUse(F->arg_begin());
    
     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setOnlyAccessesMemory();
    
     
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "Intrinsic call should not be marked as nounwind");
    
     
    if (dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI)) {
        errs() << "Intrinsic call detected\n";
    } else {
        errs() << "No intrinsic call detected\n";
    }
    
     
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function should be marked as nounwind");
    assert(!CI->doesNotThrow() && "Intrinsic call should not be marked as nounwind");
    
    return 0;
}

    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "entry", F);

     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::memcpy), {}, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    assert(F->doesNotThrow() && "Function must be marked as nounwind");

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");

     
    Value *TrueVal = ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0);
    Value *FalseVal = BinaryOperator::CreateFNeg(UnaryOperator::createFABS(TrueVal), "fneg_fabs", BB);
    SelectInst *SI = new SelectInst(CmpInst::createICMP(CmpInst::FCMP_ULT, TrueVal, ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 2.0)), TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);
    assert(SI && "SelectInst must be created");

     
    Value *CondVal = SI->getCondition();
    Type *SelType = SI->getType();
    assert(CondVal && TrueVal && FalseVal && SelType && "SelectInst values must be valid");

     
    assert((SelType->isIntegerTy() || SelType->isVectorTy()) && "SelectInst type must be integer or integer vector type");

     
    Mod.reset();
    return 0;
}

    Arg->setParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    CallBase *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, Intrinsic::memcpy), {Arg}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::NoUnwind);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call");
    assert(II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy && "CallInst must be a memcpy intrinsic");

     
    CallBase *CB = dyn_cast<CallBase>(CI);
    assert(CB && "Context instruction must be a CallBase instance");

     
    auto IRPos = IRPosition::callsite_argument(*BB, 0);
    assert(IRPos.getKind() == IRPosition::IRP_CALL_SITE_ARGUMENT && "IRPosition must have the correct kind");

     
    Function *Funct = IRPos.getFunction();
    assert(Funct && "Function associated with IRPosition must be non-null");

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>

#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>

using namespace llvm;

 
Function *createNounwindFunction(LLVMContext &Ctx, const std::string &Name) {
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, Name, &*Ctx.getContext());
    F->setDoesNotThrow();  
    return F;
}

 
CallInst *createCallInstWithoutThrow(FunctionType *FTy, BasicBlock *BB) {
    Value *Callee = Constant::getNullValue(PointerType::get(FTy, 0));
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, Callee, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();  
    return CI;
}

int main() {
    LLVMContext Ctx;
    Module M("test_module", Ctx);
    
     
    Function *F = createNounwindFunction(Ctx, "test_func");
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = createCallInstWithoutThrow(F->getFunctionType(), BB);
    
     
    std::cout << "Function: " << F->getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << (F->doesNotThrow() ? "Is nounwind\n" : "Is not nounwind\n");
    std::cout << "CallInst at BB: " << CI->getParent()->getName().str() << "\n";
    std::cout << (CI->doesNotThrow() ? "Does not throw\n" : "Throws\n");
    
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/LegacyPassManager.h>
#include <llvm/Transforms/Scalar.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32PtrTy(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);
    F->addParamAttr(0, Attribute::Returned);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IID = Intrinsic::memcpy;
    Value *Args[] = {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 0), ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt64Ty(Context), 8)};
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IID), Args, "", BB);

     
    CI->addUse(*F->arg_begin());

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setNoUnwind();

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    assert(II && "Expected a memory intrinsic");

     
    if (AnyMemIntrinsic *AMII = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(II)) {
        uint64_t NumBytes = AMII->getMemoryLength();
        assert(NumBytes <= 0 && "Expected non-positive or not a multiple of element size for atomic unordered memory intrinsic");
    }

     
    CallBase *CB = CI;

     
    std::unique_ptr<PassManager> PM(new PassManager());
    PM->add(createInstructionSimplifierPass());
    PM->run(*F);

     
    M.print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

Value* createIntrinsicCall(Module &M) {
    LLVMContext &Ctx = M.getContext();
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(IntegerType::getInt32Ty(Ctx), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "intrinsic_func", &M);
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Ctx, "", F);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(F, "", BB);
    
     
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->addUse(CI->getType());
    return CI;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType* FuncType = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncType, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_function", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    Value* Const1 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 1);
    Value* Const2 = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2);
    Value* CondVal = ICmpInst::create(ICmpInst::ICMP_ULT, Const1, Const2, "", BB);

     
    Type* Int32Ty = Type::getInt32Ty(Context);
    Value* TrueVal = ConstantInt::get(Int32Ty, 10);
    Value* FalseVal = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getName(Intrinsic::fabs), {Const1}, "", BB);
    Value* SelectInst = SelectInst::Create(CondVal, TrueVal, FalseVal, "", BB);

     
    F->getBasicBlockList().push_back(BB);
    BB->getInstList().push_back(SelectInst);

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &outs())) {
        std::cerr << "Error in module: verification failed.\n";
        return -1;
    }

     
    std::cout << "Generated function:\n" << *F << "\n";

    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instruction.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Value.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Type.h>
#include <llvm/IR/IntrinsicInst.h>
#include <llvm/IR/CallBase.h>
#include <llvm/Support/raw_ostream.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getVoidTy(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);

     
    FunctionType *IntrinsicType = Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic);
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(IntrinsicType, {}, "", BB);

     
    Use &U = F->args().begin();
    new StoreInst(ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), &(U.get()), false, BB);

     
    if (CI && !CI->use_empty()) {
         
        F->setDoesNotThrow();

         
        CI->removeAttribute(0, Attribute::NoUnwind);

         
        if (dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
             
            if (CI->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::any_mem_intrinsic) {
                Value *NumBytes = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0);
                CI->setArgOperand(0, NumBytes);  
            }
        }
    }

     
    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);

    return 0;
}

    assert(AI != F->args().end() && "Function must have at least one argument");

    return 0;

int main() {
#include <llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/BasicBlock.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>

#include <llvm/Transforms/Utils/SimplifyCFG.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    
     
    FunctionType *FTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), { Type::getInt32Ty(Context) }, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", Mod.get());
    
     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    
     
    Value *Arg = ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 42);
    new Argument(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), "arg", (Function*)F);
    
     
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(FTy, F, { Arg }, "", BB);
    CI->setDoesNotThrow();
    CI->setIsNoReturn();
    
     
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);
    F->addFnAttr(Attribute::Nounwind);
    
     
    new StoreInst(CI, ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 0), BB);
    
     
    Mod->print(outs(), nullptr);
    
    return 0;
}

#include <llvm/IR/Module.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Function.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Instructions.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Constants.h>
#include <llvm/IR/TypeBuilder.h>
#include <llvm/IR/Verifier.h>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    Module M("test_module", Context);

     
    FunctionType *FuncTy = FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {Type::getInt32Ty(Context)}, false);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FuncTy, Function::ExternalLinkage, "test_func", &M);

     
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    IRBuilder<> Builder(BB);

     
    Intrinsic::ID IntrID = Intrinsic::pow;  
    CallInst *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(&M, IntrID), {ConstantInt::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), 2)}, "", BB);
    assert(!CI->use_empty() && "CallInst must have at least one use");

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    F->setLinkage(GlobalValue::InternalLinkage);

     
    AnyMemIntrinsic *AMInst = dyn_cast<AnyMemIntrinsic>(CI);
    assert(AMInst && "CallInst must be an intrinsic call and satisfy AnyMemIntrinsic");

     
    if (verifyModule(M, &outs())) {
        errs() << "Module failed verification.\n";
        return 1;
    }

    std::cout << "Module created successfully with a function having an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
    return 0;
}

[VERBOSE] #include <iostream>
int main() {
#include "llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Module.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Function.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Instructions.h"
#include "llvm/IR/Intrinsics.h"
#include <iostream>

using namespace llvm;

int main() {
    LLVMContext Context;
    std::unique_ptr<Module> Mod = std::make_unique<Module>("test", Context);
    Function *F = Function::Create(FunctionType::get(Type::getInt32Ty(Context), {}, false), GlobalValue::ExternalLinkage, "testFunc", Mod.get());
    BasicBlock *BB = BasicBlock::Create(Context, "", F);
    Instruction *CI = CallInst::Create(Intrinsic::getDeclaration(Mod.get(), Intrinsic::abs), {ConstantFP::get(Type::getFloatTy(Context), 1.0)}, "", BB);

     
    if (CI->use_empty()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CallInst does not have any uses." << std::endl;
        return -1;
    }

     
    F->setDoesNotThrow();
    if (F->doesNotThrow() || CI->doesNotThrow()) {
        std::cerr << "Error: Function or CallInst is marked as nounwind." << std::endl;
        return -1;
    }

     
    if (!dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI)) {
        std::cerr << "Error: CI is not an intrinsic call." << std::endl;
        return -1;
    }

     
    IntrinsicInst *II = dyn_cast<IntrinsicInst>(CI);
    if (II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memcpy || II->getIntrinsicID() == Intrinsic::memmove) {
         
        Value *NumBytes = nullptr;  
        if (NumBytes && ((APInt(32, NumBytes).getSExtValue() <= 0 || !isMultipleOfElementSize(NumBytes))) {
            std::cerr << "Error: Invalid atomic unordered memory intrinsic." << std::endl;
            return -1;
        }
    }

     

    std::cout << "Test passed!" << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
